jobs.title: LEAD, MSI Warehouse
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
As a Warehouse Lead, you will be responsible for the day-to-day execution of inbound and internal warehouse operations, including receiving of materials, storage, inventory management, cycle counting and on-time fulfilment of manufacturing floor requirements. You will lead a team of warehouse associates on the shop floor, ensuring that every material is received, stored, issued and accounted for accurately in the system, and that production lines never stop due to material unavailability.
You will drive a culture of 6S, safety, discipline and continuous improvement in the warehouse, and act as the first point of contact for Production, Planning, Quality, Procurement and Finance teams on material-related matters during your shift.
1. Receiving of Materials
Plan and manage inbound dock schedule, vehicle unloading and material receipt as per PO, ASN, invoice and packing list
Ensure physical verification of quantity, part number, lot/batch, date code and packaging condition before acceptance
Ensure timely GRN / goods receipt posting in ERP/WMS (e.g., SAP) within defined TAT
Coordinate with Incoming Quality (IQC) for inspection, and segregate quarantine, hold, rejected and damaged material
Handle receiving discrepancies (shortage, excess, damage, wrong part) and raise them with Procurement, Supplier and Logistics teams
Ensure correct handling of ESD-sensitive, moisture-sensitive, temperature-controlled, shelf-life and hazardous materials as per SOP
Ensure labelling and barcode identification of all received material before put-away
2. Storage and Location Management
Ensure system-directed put-away of material to correct bin/location within defined TAT
Maintain bin location master and optimise space utilisation (racking, slotting, fast/slow movers)
Ensure storage conditions are met (temperature, humidity, ESD, dry cabinets, segregation of hazardous material)
Enforce FIFO / FEFO and monitor shelf-life and expiry of materials
Ensure safe stacking, material handling equipment usage and load-bearing limits
Identify and report slow-moving, non-moving, obsolete and expired stock for disposition
3. Inventory Management and Cycle Count
Maintain 100% system-to-physical inventory accuracy for all materials under warehouse custody
Plan and execute daily/weekly cycle counts based on ABC classification and the approved cycle count calendar
Investigate count variances, perform root cause analysis and drive corrective actions
Process inventory adjustments with proper approval and documentation as per Finance and audit requirements
Support periodic wall-to-wall physical inventory, internal audits and external/statutory audits
Monitor stock levels and raise alerts for shortages, critical parts and excess inventory to Planning and Procurement
Ensure all inventory transactions (receipt, transfer, issue, return, scrap) are recorded accurately and on time
4. Fulfilment of Manufacturing Floor Requirements
Ensure on-time and accurate issue of materials to the production floor as per work order, material requisition, kitting list and production plan
Plan picking, kitting and line-feeding / replenishment (Kanban, min-max) to ensure zero line stoppage due to material
Coordinate with Production and Planning on daily build plan, priority changes and urgent requirements
Manage return of unused, excess and rejected material from the floor with proper system transactions
Track and escalate material shortages, and follow up with Planning, Procurement and Suppliers for closure
Ensure traceability of issued material (lot/batch/reel ID) to work orders
5. 6S, Safety and Housekeeping
Implement and sustain 6S (Sort, Set in Order, Shine, Standardise, Sustain, Safety) across the warehouse
Conduct daily 6S walks and periodic 6S audits; track and close observations
Ensure visual management – floor marking, location labels, signage and display boards
Ensure compliance with EHS requirements, PPE usage, MHE (forklift, stacker, pallet jack) safety and safe material handling
Report near-misses, unsafe acts and unsafe conditions, and drive corrective actions
Ensure ESD compliance in material storage and handling areas
6. Team Leadership
Lead, allocate and monitor daily work of warehouse associates and material handlers in the shift
Conduct shift start meetings / Tier-1 huddles covering safety, priorities, KPIs and issues
Train team members on SOPs, system transactions, safety, ESD and 6S; maintain skill matrix and training records
Monitor attendance, productivity and discipline; provide feedback, coaching and recognition
Support the Supervisor in manpower planning, shift handover and performance reviews
Drive teamwork, ownership and a "right first time" culture
7. Systems, Compliance and Continuous Improvement
Follow and maintain warehouse SOPs, work instructions and documentation; support SOP updates
Ensure compliance with quality, customs/bonded warehouse (where applicable), audit and statutory requirements
Prepare and publish daily/weekly warehouse reports and KPI dashboards
Identify process gaps and lead Kaizen, Lean and error-proofing (Poka-Yoke) improvements
Support RCA and CAPA for warehouse-related incidents, customer/internal complaints and audit findings
Support system enhancements, barcode/scanner usage and digital tools (WMS, Power BI, Copilot) for efficiency
Using Artificial Intelligence
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) :
Inventory record accuracy (system vs. physical)
Cycle count plan adherence and variance closure
GRN / receiving TAT and put-away TAT
On-time, in-full material issue to production (zero line stoppage due to material)
Picking / issue accuracy
6S audit score
Safety – zero lost-time incidents; near-miss reporting and closure
Audit findings – zero major non-conformance
Team training completion and skill-matrix coverage
Education Desired :
Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Engineering, Commerce or related field
Certification in Lean, 6S, Inventory Management or Warehouse Operations is an advantage
Experience Desired :
4–7 years of experience in warehouse / stores operations in a manufacturing environment (semiconductor, electronics, automotive or similar preferred)
Minimum 2 years in a team lead / shift lead role
Hands-on experience in receiving, inventory control, cycle counting and production line feeding
Skills and Competencies :
Working knowledge of ERP/WMS (SAP MM/WM/EWM preferred), barcode and RF scanning systems
Good understanding of inventory control principles – FIFO/FEFO, ABC analysis, min-max, Kanban
Knowledge of 6S, Lean, Kaizen and basic problem-solving tools (5 Why, Fishbone, 8D)
Knowledge of ESD, MSL and safe material handling practices; MHE operation awareness
Proficiency in MS Excel and reporting; exposure to Power BI / digital tools is a plus
Strong leadership, communication and people management skills
High attention to detail, ownership and ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
Willingness to work in shifts

Job Purpose
The Facilities Operations Manager is responsible for continuous, safe, and compliant operation of all fab facilities and critical utilities supporting semiconductor manufacturing. This includes bulk and high-purity gas distribution systems, chemicals, Ultra‑Pure Water (UPW), wastewater treatment, HVAC and cleanroom environmental control, electrical systems, and building infrastructure in a 24×7,
This role directly impacts yield, uptime, safety, and customer audit outcomes.
Core Responsibilities
Fab Facilities & Critical Utilities Operations
Lead operations of bulk & specialty gas systems, chemical distribution systems, UPW, process cooling water, wastewater treatment, Electrical System, Building Infrastructure HVAC, and cleanroom environmental systems.
Ensure continuous availability of all utilities required for Manufacturing with minimal production impact.
Own facility incident response and serve as first responder for site‑wide facilities events.
2. Cleanroom & Environmental Control
Maintain clean room temperature, humidity, pressure, and contamination control within fab‑defined limits.
Coordinate filter maintenance, airflow verification, and critical environmental alarms to protect yield‑sensitive operations.
Support particulate, AMC (Airborne Molecular Contamination), and vibration control programs aligned with fab standards (as referenced in semiconductor cleanroom roles).
3. EHSS & Regulatory Compliance
Ensure full compliance with EHSS, hazardous gas, chemical safety, wastewater discharge, and environmental regulations concerning semiconductor manufacturing.
Maintain 100% EHSS training certification for all facilities staff and contractors.
Lead corrective and preventive actions following incidents, audits, or near‑miss events.
4. Team Leadership & Capability Development
Lead, mentor, and develop facilities technicians, engineers, and supervisors in a shift‑based 24×7 operation.
Drive standardization of operating procedures, maintenance practices, and commissioning processes.
Implement succession planning and skill‑depth development for critical systems ownership.
5. Maintenance, Reliability & Performance Management
Establish and govern preventive and corrective maintenance programs for all fab utilities and infrastructure.
Leverage artificial intelligence to track and drive KPIs such as uptime, MTBF, response time, safety metrics, and PM compliance
Lead root‑cause analysis (RCA) for utility‑related excursions impacting production.
6. Commissioning, Projects & Expansion Support
Lead commissioning of new fab utilities, equipment, and facility expansions supporting ramp‑up or technology node changes.
Partner with construction, operational, and equipment groups to integrate facilities systems with minimal disruption.
7. Financial & Vendor Management
Own facilities operations budget, forecasting, and cost‑optimization initiatives.
Handle strategic vendors providing gas, chemical, UPW, waste, and maintenance services.
Ensure contract compliance and SLA alignment for critically important services.
8. Customer & Audit Readiness
Represent the site during customer audits, ISO, EHSS, and certification reviews.
Act as the site’s voice in global facilities forums to align with corporate standards.
Qualifications & Experience
Required
Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical) or equivalent.
12–15+ years of experience in semiconductor fab facilities or similar high‑reliability industrial environments.
Proven understanding of gases, chemicals, UPW, wastewater systems, Electrical System, HVAC, and cleanroom facilities.
Preferred
Exposure to BMS / FMS / CMMS / SCADA systems.
Knowledge of local and international EHSS standards applicable to semiconductor fabs.
Key Competencies
Mission‑critical operations leadership
Safety‑first perspective
Incident & emergency management
Multi-functional collaboration with Manufacturing, Process, and Equipment teams
Data‑driven reliability improvement
Typical benchmarks
Fab utility uptime
Safety & EHSS compliance score
Incident response time
PM compliance rate
Cost optimization vs budget

Support energy security, grid reliability, alternate supply arrangements, and energy price risk management. Lead ISO 50001 implementation and employ Agentic AI for renewable energy dashboards.
B. Projects in Renewable Energy
Identify, evaluate, and implement renewable energy projects including Rooftop/Ground-mounted Solar PV, Wind and Solar-Wind Hybrid, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), Captive and Group-Captive Projects, Third-Party Open Access Arrangements, Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) and Environmental Attributes. Conduct technical and commercial feasibility studies by reviewing load profiles, contracted demand, grid connectivity, land availability, and future demand. Prepare project concepts, scope, specifications, generation estimates, and cases supporting project viability. Evaluate proposals based on cost, tariff savings, reliability, environmental benefits, and regulatory feasibility. Coordinate due diligence, project progress, commissioning, performance testing, monitoring, and handover. Monitor generation, availability, degradation, curtailment, contractual performance, and renewable energy claims. Maintain project register, capacity, generation, CODs, and benefits delivered.

Evaluate Physical PPAs, Virtual PPAs, Open Access PPAs, Captive/Group-Captive models, and On-site Renewable Agreements. Develop load forecasts and procurement scenarios. Prepare RFIs/RFPs and assess tariff, blocking issue, tenure, capacity, generation profile, banking, wheeling, transmission, scheduling, forecasting, and settlement. Perform financial analysis including NPV, IRR, payback, sensitivity, and landed-cost comparison. Assess regulatory, market, counterparty, curtailment, generation, credit, and change-in-law risks. Coordinate with Procurement, Finance, and Legal teams on negotiations and contracts. Review contractual clauses including capacity, tariff, term, COD, guarantees, supply commitments, payment security, change in law, force majeure, default, termination, and renewable attribute ownership. Monitor invoices, energy credits, open-access charges, and regulatory changes.

Lead the establishment, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of ISO 50001 EnMS. Define EnMS scope and boundaries, identifying static factors and variables affecting energy performance. Integrate energy considerations into the building, procurement, equipment selection, and modifications. Conduct awareness programs, training, audits, compliance reviews, management reviews, and certification audits.
Manage non-conformities, corrective actions, closure evidence, and documentation. Coordinate with corporate and site energy teams.

Evaluate VFDs, efficient motors, heat recovery, heat pumps, automation, advanced controls, power management, and demand-response systems.
F. Energy Data & Digitalization

G. Regulatory & Collaborator Management
Track electricity, renewable energy, captive power, open access, and energy-efficiency regulations. Collaborate with utilities, regulators, agencies, consultants, transmission entities, and load-dispatch centers. Job description
Function: Mechanical
Location: Sanand
Experience: 12 to 15 Years
Qualification: Mechanical Engineering, Bachelor of Engineering degree
Industry Preference: Semiconductor Plant
The role requires an experienced engineer to lead the composition coordination, quality implementation, and installation oversight for all utility hook-up systems connected to semiconductor manufacturing tools. The candidate should be capable of handling cross-functional coordination for mechanical, electrical, network, water, and gas systems while ensuring conformity with engineering standards, cleanroom requirements, Working on AI-Enabled tools (such as Copilot and Power BI), safety rules, and project timelines.
Role purpose
This position is responsible for end-to-end coordination of tool hook-up works, from building review through installation, inspection, testing, and handover. In semiconductor projects, tool hook-up is a critical integration stage because each production tool must be accurately connected to utilities such as electrical power, process gases, chilled or process water, DIW, drain system, exhaust, and communication/data systems before startup and qualification can begin.
Key responsibilities
Review tool utility requirements and coordinate hook-up development for mechanical, electrical, network, water, and gas systems.
Verify layouts, installation drawings, hook-up packages, utility routing, and interface points with tool suppliers, facility teams, and project collaborators.
Manage field implementation of tool hook-up operations and verify adherence to approved drawings, quality plans, and safety guidelines.
Coordinate installation activities related to power supply, earthing, cables, data/network connectivity, water lines, gas lines, mechanical supports, and associated utility connections.
Ensure cleanroom protocols, contamination control practices, and semiconductor installation standards are maintained during execution.
Support QA/QC activities including inspections, punch listing, leak testing, pressure testing, continuity checks, flushing, and utility verification.
Work with OEMs, construction teams, quality teams, and facility engineers during startup, commissioning support, interlock verification, and handover.
Prepare and maintain engineering documentation such as checklists, as-built drawings, progress reports, inspection records, deviation logs, and turnover dossiers.
Apply industrial engineering methods to improve workflow, resource planning, installation sequencing, productivity, and execution efficiency.
Identify execution risks, resolve field issues, and drive corrective and preventive actions to maintain schedule and quality targets.
Required qualifications
Mechanical Engineering degree
12–15 years of experience in managing projects, facilities engineering, tool installation, or tool hook-up activities is required.
Strong knowledge of building review, field execution, quality assurance, and coordination across multidisciplinary utility systems is required.
Proficiency with AI tools (such as Copilot and Power BI) is required.
Preferred experience in semiconductor plants, cleanroom environments, or high-tech manufacturing facilities.
Ability to understand engineering drawings, utility layouts, P&IDs, single-line diagrams, and hook-up documents is preferred.
Working knowledge of testing, commissioning support, turn-on documentation, and vendor coordination is required.
Good communication, planning, team coordination, and problem-solving skills are essential.
Preferred candidate profile
The ideal candidate should have direct experience with semiconductor projects and a solid understanding of facility backbone systems. These include power, water, gas, and mechanical utilities that support fab operations. Candidates with cleanroom tool hookup, OEM coordination, utility interface management, and efficiency improvement experience are especially suited. Join us to be part of an ambitious team driving world-class innovations!

jobs.title: NVMQRA Solid State Drive (SSD) Quality and Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
Job Description
As a Non-Volatile Memory QRA (NVMQRA) Solid State Drive (SSD) Quality and Reliability Engineer at Micron Technology, Inc., you will you will be responsible for managing quality and reliability of Micron SSD products as these products enter into high volume production phase of product lifecycle.
You will perform reliability testing and data analysis on material associated with sustaining qualifications through change requests, product proliferations, special work requests and conversions. You will also take part in the management of product deviation events, through participation in product containment activities and providing quality and reliability evaluation plans for risk assessment.
You will also manage the outgoing quality and reliability (OQRM) metrics. You are expected to conduct failure analysis from qualification, evaluation and OQRM failures and report the resulting data. You can expect to conduct global meetings to determine product priorities or product dispositions.
In this role you will work with various Engineering and Quality Reliability Assurance Groups to provide technical support, expertise, consultation and training. You should expect to support customers both internal and external to Micron on an on-going basis.
Responsibilities And Tasks
Manage Reliability evaluations for deviation management
Determine a reliability evaluation/trials plan
Identify and manage material for sampling
Perform data analysis of reliability tests results and/or by conducting failure analysis
Close out evaluation and provide feedback to stakeholders
Identify deviated material within Material Review Board (MRB)
Take part in containment activities
Determine a reliability evaluation/trials plan
Identify and manage material for sampling
Perform data analysis of reliability tests results and/or by conducting failure analysis
Determine disposition of materials
Close out evaluation and provide feedback to stakeholders
Manage and coordinate various inputs from various stakeholders in Quality Reliability
Collaborate with discrete component product quality and reliability team for product reliability evaluations/trials/plans
Collaborate with package quality and reliability team for package-related reliability evaluations/trials/plans
Manage Product Outgoing Quality and Reliability Monitoring
Provide the plan for operations to execute for SSD product OQRM data collection
Analyze the data from Micron Manufacturing Execution System (MES) such as MAM
Use statistical analysis tools to provide conclusions and verify results
Summarize the reult of analyzed data through a regular OQRM metrics report
Digital & AI Tool Usage
Leverage AI-powered tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, agentic AI platforms, and other generative AI solutions) to enhance engineering effectiveness, automate routine tasks, analyze large datasets, and improve decision quality.
Drive adoption of AI-enabled workflows to increase productivity, reduce cycle time, and improve knowledge sharing within the organization.
Provide Expertise, Consultation and Training
Communicate Globally with NAND, Firmware, BUs and Engineering Groups for priority management
Provide training to engineers and technicians within and outside of the group
Maintain knowledge base (lessons learned) within the group for each SSD market segment
Stay abreast of Quality and Reliability issues of Micron NAND components
Provide consultation for audits, RMA, and customer issues
Education
Required: Masters’ Degree in Electrical / Electronics/ Computer Engineering
Desired: PhD in Electrical/Electronics/Computer Engineering
Candidates without a Master's degree may also be considered if they possess relevant experience in Product Engineering Failure Analysis (EFA) and a strong semiconductor industry background
Experience
2-7 years of experience in any of the following:
Solid State Drives Product/Device engineering
Non-volatile Memory Product/Device engineering
Non-volatile Memory Process integration engineering
Quality/Reliability engineering in semiconductor area
Demonstrated ability to effectively utilize Generative AI and Agentic AI platforms (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent tools) to enhance failure analysis efficiency, automate workflows, accelerate data-driven decision making, and improve technical documentation.
Candidates should be comfortable integrating AI-assisted solutions into daily engineering activities while applying appropriate technical judgment and data governance practices.
Qualifications
Basic knowledge and understanding of wafer fabrication process
Basic knowledge and understanding of device physics
Basic knowledge and understanding of NAND device operation
Basic knowledge and understanding of solid state drive operation
Knowledge of various Solid State drive protocol standards such as SATA, PCIe, or NVMe
Strong knowledge and understanding of semiconductor reliability statistics
Good verbal and written communication skills
Good time management and multi-tasking skills

jobs.description:

Job Summary At Apple, we don t just build products - we craft experiences that enrich people s daily lives. The Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team is responsible for ensuring that mission-critical enterprise systems and customer-facing cloud services operate with high availability, resilience, and performance at scale. We are seeking a motivated Junior Site Reliability Engineer with 1-2 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Application Production Support (APS), DevOps, or Systems Engineers to join our fast-paced, agile engineering team. In this role, you will help maintain application reliability by investigating production incidents, troubleshooting application and database issues, resolving data pipeline failures, and identifying performance bottlenecks through root-cause analysis. You will collaborate with development, QA, database, data, and infrastructure teams to improve service reliability, automate operational tasks, and support modern observability practices, including AI service traceability and dependency monitoring. Responsibilities High-Availability Operations: Monitor the health, performance, and capacity of mission-critical applications and services across multi-region environments. Incident Triage Response: Act as a first-line responder to production alerts, outages, and system anomalies, participating in on-call rotations and rapid-response workflows. End-to-End Troubleshooting: Investigate and debug complex application, core system, network, and performance bottlenecks through to resolution, including environment-specific issues and differences between staging, experimental, and production configurations. Database Diagnostics: Perform database-level troubleshooting, query analysis, data verification, and performance tuning across PostgreSQL, Oracle DB, and MySQL environments. Troubleshoot ETL jobs and data pipelines, investigate processing failures, and diagnose data availability issues across relational, NoSQL, and Snowflake environments. Root-Cause Analysis (RCA): Partner with development, QA, database, and infrastructure teams to identify underlying root causes and implement permanent fixes. Observability Alerting: Build and refine telemetry dashboards, log aggregations, and alerting rules using tools such as Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, and Dynatrace. Use Langfuse and LangSmith where applicable to investigate AI traces, identify failures, and monitor service dependencies. Service Level Tracking: Track and uphold key reliability metrics (SLIs/SLOs) to minimize Time to Detect (TTD) and Time to Mitigate (TTM). Monitor AI model latency, token consumption, API quotas, and dependency health, with alerts for defined performance thresholds, including the sub-500 ms target where applicable. Toil Reduction Automation: Develop robust scripts and tools using Python, Bash, or similar languages to automate repetitive operational tasks, health checks, and routine maintenance. Release CI/CD Enablement: Support production deployments, CI/CD pipeline runs (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), build validations, and canary/smoke testing. Change Configuration Governance: Execute production change requests (CRs) in accordance with enterprise change management and risk assessment standards. Support environment configuration validation, service provisioning runbooks, certificate renewals, and secure secrets management. Continuous Improvement Modern Tooling: Leverage modern engineering practices and GenAI-assisted workflows to accelerate log analysis, incident documentation, and operational efficiency. In this role, you will keep mission-critical applications running reliably across multiple environments-triaging production incidents and debugging application, database, core system, and performance bottlenecks through to root cause and permanent remediation. You will partner cross-functionally with development, QA, database, and infrastructure teams to resolve large-scale production disruptions, eliminate operational toil through automation, and manage platform health using modern observability and emerging GenAI technologies. Responsibilities High-Availability Operations: Monitor the health, performance, and capacity of mission-critical applications and services across multi-region environments. Incident Triage Response: Act as a first-line responder to production alerts, outages, and system anomalies, participating in on-call rotations and rapid-response workflows. End-to-End Troubleshooting: Investigate and debug complex application, core system, network, and performance bottlenecks through to resolution. Database Diagnostics: Perform database-level troubleshooting, query analysis, data verification, and performance tuning across PostgreSQL, Oracle DB, and MySQL environments. Root-Cause Analysis (RCA): Partner with development, QA, database, and infrastructure teams to identify underlying root causes and implement permanent fixes. Observability Alerting: Build and refine telemetry dashboards, log aggregations, and alerting rules using tools such as Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, and Dynatrace to eliminate blind spots. Continuous Improvement Modern Tooling: Leverage modern engineering practices and GenAI-assisted workflows to accelerate log analysis, incident documentation, and operational efficiency. Requirements 1 to 2 years of experience in production support / site reliability engineering or related role. A strong foundation in Linux, relational databases, and programming. (Up to 25% international travel) Preferred Qualifications Proven ability to work independently under high pressure and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Hands-on experience with industrial robotics platforms (ABB, Fanuc, KUKA, UR) and machine vision systems (Cognex, Keyence, or similar). Designed and deployed automation solutions including pick-and-place systems and vision-guided inspection to improve manufacturing efficiency and quality. Strong knowledge of statistical validation tools (GRR, SPC, DOE, CPK) to ensure scalability and reliability of automation systems. Project management and people management experience with excellent interpersonal skills both oral and written English. nan

The role is responsible for improving product readiness, maintaining an accurate digital product definition, validating product structures and manufacturing requirements, and resolving design-to-manufacturing issues before product build. Key Responsibilities Provide day-to-day engineering support to Design and Manufacturing Engineering teams for new product introduction, product upgrades, prototype builds, pilot builds, production ramp, and sustaining activities. Review product designs for manufacturability, assembly, installation, accessibility, maintainability, and serviceability. Identify and communicate design risks, assembly constraints, tolerance concerns, clearance issues, hardware incompatibilities, and manufacturing readiness gaps. Support build issue resolution by coordinating containment, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and design or process updates with relevant stakeholders. Track engineering and manufacturing issues through closure and capture lessons learned for reuse in future designs. Master Layout and Digital Product Model Management Create, maintain, and validate Master Layouts at module and system levels for multiple product configurations. Develop and maintain accurate 3D virtual product models aligned with the released physical product configuration. Incorporate approved design changes into product models and ensure configuration consistency across affected assemblies. Create and manage parts, kits, subassemblies, and top-level assemblies in Siemens NX and Teamcenter Engineering. Apply Master Layout, assembly, modelling, drafting, and Model-Based Definition standards. Support product-option architecture, options and variants logic, effectivity, and product configuration in Teamcenter. Review electrical and mechanical schematics and translate routing requirements into NX assemblies. Create and validate mechanical, cable, and harness assembly routing within the product model. Check routing for length, bend radius, accessibility, connector interfaces, service loops, clamp locations, interference, and assembly feasibility. Coordinate with Design Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, and assembly teams to resolve routing-related issues. Support E3S drawing reviews and ensure routing deliverables meet applicable engineering and manufacturing standards. Create, revise, and release parts, assemblies, kits, drawings, and product structures through the approved Engineering Change Management process. Evaluate change impact across product models, BOMs, manufacturing documentation, options, variants, and affected configurations. Support release-readiness reviews and verify that required engineering deliverables are complete, consistent, and available to downstream users. Required Technical Skills Proficiency in Siemens NX, including solid modelling, sheet-metal design, assemblies, drafting, routing, and Model-Based Definition. Proficiency in Teamcenter Engineering and Teamcenter Visualization for product data, structure, configuration, workflow, and release management. Strong understanding of Master Layout methodology and management of complex module- and system-level assemblies. Knowledge of Design for Manufacturing, Design for Assembly, Design for Serviceability, tolerance analysis, fit and clearance validation, and assembly-sequence assessment. Ability to interpret mechanical drawings, electrical schematics, cable and harness drawings, specifications, and engineering standards. Experience with Engineering Change Management and product lifecycle release processes. Awareness of SAP, iOMS, ERP, MES, and digital-thread integration. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and structured problem-solving skills. Behavioral and Collaboration Skills Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to work effectively with Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Electrical Engineering, NPME, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, and Service teams. Strong ownership, attention to detail, prioritization, and follow-through. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced product-development and manufacturing environment. Continuous-improvement mindset with a focus on issue prevention, product quality, cycle-time reduction, and manufacturing readiness. Education and Experience Bachelors degree in mechanical engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline. Typically 1015 years of relevant experience supporting semiconductor equipment, complex electromechanical products, capital equipment, or high-technology manufacturing. Demonstrated experience supporting Design and Manufacturing Engineering teams through design release, build, issue resolution, and product change implementation. Experience in semiconductor equipment product development or manufacturing is preferred. The position requires work to be conducted within the business unit (BU) manufacturing and the development lab to learn the new products under development, gain experience on the startup and sustaining production tasks on the tool, and develop/deliver initial classroom and hands-on training on the tool. Once the tool transitions to volume production, the NPI instructor will train and certify the volume instructor, who then takes over the product from a training ownership standpoint. The position will require learning, and application of that learning, on three fronts (1) training fundamentals; (2) existing products; and (3) new product training development. Training fundamentals will cover the training methodology, tools, materials and confidence to deliver both live distance learning (LDL) and instructor-led hands-on (ILT) course delivery. Existing products start with basic operations and maintenance, followed by trouble shooting and diagnostics, and eventually mastery of the tool. Product training development will require content development and project management skills to help bring a new tool design from concept to reality, through the development of comprehensive training curriculum, student guides, and supporting materials and technologies. Due to the scheduling of PDP/NPI product development, the NPI instructor will often be researching, gaining knowledge/experience, and developing/delivering for several new tools/chambers at a time, so project management, training/presentation experience, and technical acumen (mechanical, electrical, troubleshooting, etc.) of semiconductor equipment is required. Basic breakdown of time is: ~45% learning the new tool and gaining knowledge and experience (mechanical, electrical, software, process, etc.) and developing the course materials, structure and updating of existing courses ~35% delivering training or coordinating structured factory OJT ~20% other activities Key Responsibilities: Deliver specialized New Product Introduction (NPI) technical training both in-house and at customer locations, requiring domestic and international travel. Manage classroom and lab activities to ensure course objectives are met and adhere to safety procedures. Training may occur during off-shift hours and weekends as assigned. Learn and maintain comprehensive technical knowledge of new and improved products to prepare and present defined courses. Disseminate new information to staff, complete certifications on multiple platforms and processes, including safety modules, and actively certify others. Establish new certification requirements. Follow and engage in Product Development Process (PDP) for all NPI products at Phase Gate 3 or earlier to ensure completion of NPI course to support the tool immediately prior to shipment of second tool to field. Utilize Technical Publications and System Product Business Groups to maximize documentation efficiencies. Create and augment documentation to address gaps in released materials, evaluate instructor performance, train others in standard course development processes (Instructional System Design), and oversee course design approval. Provide technical expertise and troubleshooting skills to assist with system repairs; ensures system functionality can support course objectives; ensures all safety retrofits are installed on the training systems. Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the Global Technical Training organization and operations, as well as the Applied Global Services (AGS) organization. Inform customers of additional Global Technical Training (GTT) courses and products, assist marketing in building customer relationships and selling GTT products, analyze customer issues and needs to identify future training opportunities, and present comprehensive training solutions. Provide coaching and leadership to other instructors, serving as a mentor to less senior instructors for class delivery, technical development, and certification. Anticipate, prevent, and resolve customer satisfaction issues. Manage multiple projects of diverse scope and complexity, directing project team members. Support Early Learning System (ELS) / Alpha Site engineering in-house or on engineering tools, review ECOs, and communicate with the field. Assist Global Product Support (GPS) in the generation of documentation. Develop new procedures and Best Known Methods. Collaborate with Engineering and Manufacturing on the first chamber build and participate in new product final testing. Develop technical materials working directly with Instructional Designers (ID). Observe technical activities to determine operating procedure and detail. Interview personnel to become familiar with products methods Study technical documents to integrate technology, operating procedures, production sequences, and details. Review published materials and recommend revisions. Communicate with Business Units to obtain current product information for course updates and represent GTT at product NPI meetings. Preferred - Nationally recognized certification in Instructional Design or 2 years of formal or informal experience in curriculum development and/or instructional design. Attaining Friesen, Kaye and Associates (FKA) instructional designing certification is a plus Preferred Experience with Applied Materials Semiconductor Equipment Highly desired - experience with Applied DDP equipment a plus. Apply operations research, statistical learning, and optimization techniques to solve manufacturing challenges. Contribute to hybrid solutions that combine analytics, machine learning, and simulation technologies. Design experiments and perform rigorous analysis to validate model effectiveness and business impact. jobs.description:
Experience range: 0-1 Yrs
Position: IT Security Associate - Governance, Compliance and Risk Job Description: About the Role Arrow Electronics is looking for a Governance, Risk and Compliance apprentice to join our IT Risk and Governance team in India. This role is built specifically for a student who has completed a university degree and who wants to learn how information security governance actually works inside a global technology distributor, rather than only in a textbook. You will sit with the team that owns Arrow's security certifications, risk framework and compliance programs, and you will contribute to live work from your first month. We do not expect you to arrive knowing our frameworks. We expect curiosity, care with detail, and the willingness to ask questions in a room full of experienced practitioners. Everything else is taught, and your schedule is designed around your coursework and examinations. About the Team IT Risk and Governance is part of Arrow's Enterprise Security Services organization. The team maintains the Information Security Risk Management Framework, owns the security policy and standards library, runs third-party and vendor risk assessments, and delivers the certification programs that Arrow's customers and contracts depend on. Our current portfolio includes the global ISO 27001 certification program spanning the Americas, EMEA and APAC, CMMC Level 2 readiness for our aerospace and defense business, TISAX assessments for automotive customers, and the consolidation of our GRC tooling onto a single platform. The team is deliberately small and global. Members include information security architects, IT compliance analysts, a data security analyst and project managers, working across US, EMEA and APAC time zones. The apprentice reports to the Director, IT Risk and Governance and works day to day alongside a compliance analyst and a security architect. What You Will Work On The work is real and it changes with the program calendar. Over the course of the apprenticeship you can expect to contribute to several of the following. Evidence collection and tracking for the global ISO 27001 certification program, including chasing outstanding artefacts from control owners and keeping the evidence register current. Support for CMMC Level 2 readiness activities, such as maintaining control status trackers and helping assemble documentation packages ahead of assessment milestones. Third-party and vendor risk assessments: reviewing questionnaire responses against our Vendor Risk Assessment Standard and flagging gaps for an analyst to validate. Migration and data quality work as we consolidate our GRC tooling onto a unified platform, including mapping controls between frameworks and cleaning up legacy records. Maintenance of the security policy and standards governance library, including formatting, version control and tracking annual review dates. Preparation of recurring reporting, including program status summaries and metrics that go to security leadership. Key Responsibilities Keep assigned trackers, registers and evidence repositories accurate and current, and raise items that are slipping before they become escalations. Draft clear, concise summaries of findings and status for review by an analyst, architect or the director. Follow up with control owners and other stakeholders across Arrow to request evidence, clarify responses and confirm closure of open items. Compare documentation and questionnaire responses against published Arrow standards and applicable control frameworks, and record where they do not line up. Handle confidential and restricted information with the discretion the classification requires, and complete all assigned security training on time. Attend program stand-ups and take accurate notes, actions and owners. Ask when something is unclear rather than guessing, and tell your mentor early when coursework will affect your availability. What You Will Learn This apprenticeship is structured as a learning path, not an administrative placement. By the end of twelve months a successful apprentice should be able to do the following. Explain how an ISO 27001 certification cycle runs end to end, from scoping and evidence to external audit and corrective action. Read a control framework such as ISO 27001 Annex A or NIST SP 800-171 and trace a requirement to the evidence that satisfies it. Run the first pass of a vendor risk assessment against a published standard. Work confidently inside a GRC platform, including control mapping, task assignment and reporting. Write for a security leadership audience: short, factual, and clear about what changed and what needs a decision. Who We Are Looking ForRequired Currently enrolled in a bachelor's or master's program at a recognized university in India, with at least one academic year remaining at the start of the apprenticeship. Studying a relevant field such as information technology, computer science, cyber security, information systems, engineering, commerce, law or business administration. We hire for aptitude, not for a single degree. Strong written and spoken English, since most of the team and its stakeholders are outside India. Comfortable with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Teams, and willing to learn new tools quickly. Genuinely careful with detail. Much of this work is the difference between an assessment that passes and one that does not. Available for the agreed weekly hours and able to overlap with colleagues in EMEA and the United States for part of the week. Preferred Coursework, certification study or project work touching information security, audit, risk management or data privacy. Familiarity with any control framework or standard, including ISO 27001, NIST, SOC 2, PCI DSS or GDPR, at an introductory level. Exposure to a GRC, ticketing or project tracking platform, or to basic data handling in Excel or Power BI. Student leadership, campus club, hackathon or volunteer experience that shows follow-through. An interest in continuing in security governance after graduation. Role Summary Take the hardest AI problems in Finance Global Business Services (GBS) from whiteboard to production, and set the patterns the rest of the team builds on. As Senior Manager, Forward Deployed Engineer, you join a Finance GBS function team, define the problem, and lead the build from first prototype through production handoff and support. You take the engagements that span multiple systems or teams. You work on engagements in areas such as financial close, forecasting, accounts receivable, procure-to-pay, tax, treasury, shared services operations, and other FGBS functions. We measure success through adoption and demonstrable business outcomes, including time saved, improved quality, reduced risk, stronger controls, faster cycle times, better decisions, and measurable financial impact, and by how much of your work the rest of the team can reuse. This is a senior hands-on individual contributor and technical lead role within the FGBS Technology AI Solutions Capability Center in Chennai. You set the engineering patterns other Forward Deployed Engineers follow, review their designs and code, and still write code every week. You work alongside Product Owners, function leaders, finance analysts, process owners, and Digital platform and architecture teams. Why This Role You work directly with Finance and GBS leaders worldwide, so you find out fast whether what you build works. You lead the design of agentic AI built with frontier models on Pfizer's enterprise AI platforms, connected to SAP, Snowflake, Oracle EPM, and custom solutions through MCP or direct API integration. You help shape a shared FGBS Data AI Foundation (ontology, rules engine, MCP tool library, and decision ledger), and decide which patterns become shared building blocks. Your influence grows through technical leadership and the patterns others reuse. You can grow your career without moving into people management. Role Responsibilities Problem Discovery and Business Partnership Work in person in Chennai within the FGBS Technology AI Solutions Capability Center, while embedding virtually with assigned Finance and GBS teams. Lead discovery for complex, cross-functional use cases through regular calls, screen-share walkthroughs, and process reviews, and shape them into roadmaps with measurable outcomes. Run discovery with senior business stakeholders and process owners across regions, including the US and Europe. Work with Product Owners to turn priorities and specifications into solution designs and delivery plans, and to rank use cases by value, feasibility, and risk. Say no, or not yet, when a use case lacks data, sponsorship, or a clear value case, and push back when a specification doesn't match the underlying problem or runs into technical issues and limitations. Set coding standards, evaluation practice, and quality bars for the engagements you lead, including review standards for AI-generated code. Use AI coding agents in your daily workflow to speed delivery, and show other engineers how to use them well. Make build-versus-buy and platform choices with Digital platform and architecture teams. Data Enterprise Integration Lead integration across Finance and GBS data and systems through governed MCP tools or APIs and certified data products, such as SAP S/4HANA, Snowflake (including Cortex), Databricks, SAP Ariba and Business Network, Oracle EPM, Microsoft 365, and other enterprise platforms. Define data contracts, semantic models, and access patterns, and extend the shared FGBS ontology and business rules (such as Delegation of Authority, Segregation of Duties, and materiality) that other engineers and agents reuse. Set data access, entitlement, and classification practice for financial and personal data on the engagements you lead. Controls, Compliance Responsible AI Own control design for your solutions. Engage SOX, Internal Audit, Privacy, Legal, Security, and AI governance early, including data privacy (GDPR, India DPDP Act) and EU AI Act review, and pass required gates before release. Define evaluation and monitoring for accuracy, drift, and failure modes on financial outputs, and make sure agent evidence, approvals, and actions are recorded in the decision ledger. Enforce Pfizer responsible AI safeguards: data access controls, prompt injection defenses, human review, and output monitoring. Production, Reliability Reuse Own production readiness and ongoing support for the solutions you lead: LLMOps practice, deployment pipelines, monitoring, incident response, and run costs. Establish support ownership, runbooks, service expectations, escalation paths, knowledge transfer, and root cause analysis for production solutions. Set the standard for logging, tracing, monitoring, and alerting with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Foundry Observability. Convert proven solutions into reusable components, templates, and accelerators across Finance and GBS. Identify and pay down technical debt before it blocks scale. Mentoring Practice Building Mentor Manager-level FDEs, and engineers in FGBS function teams, through design reviews, pairing, and code review. Present results and tradeoffs to senior Finance and GBS stakeholders and FDE leadership. Build champions in the business so adoption sticks. Technical lead experience on complex, multi-system builds. Expert-level Python, with strong TypeScript/JavaScript and SQL. Hands-on experience with Azure (preferred) or AWS cloud architecture, API-first design, CI/CD, and observability. Hands-on LLMOps practice: evaluation, tracing, and prompt, model, and agent versioning. Proven ability to influence senior business stakeholders without formal authority. Experience mentoring engineers. Preferred Qualifications Master's degree in a technical field, or a finance/accounting background combined with engineering experience. Deep knowledge of finance processes such as record-to-report, order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, FPA, or treasury, or prior work in finance technology. Experience integrating with SAP (S/4HANA, GTS, Ariba), Snowflake (including Cortex), Databricks, the Azure AI stack (AI Foundry, AI Search, Document Intelligence, Azure ML), Vertex AI, or Oracle EPM. Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, LangChain), MCP server development, and A2A. Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs, or rules engines. Experience with SOX and IT general controls in a regulated industry. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact confidently with senior stakeholders, clients and agent banks. Goods Movement Configuration: Configure movement types, stock types, reason codes and automatic account determination, and own the correctness of the postings they generate. Special Stock & Valuation: Configure special stock scenarios including consignment, subcontracting and project stock, and manage the valuation and price control behaviour that follows. Stock Transfers: Configure intra-company and cross-company stock transport orders, including the delivery, billing and accounting flow for each. Delivery Recovery Leadership: Lead recovery of stressed workstreams, including stock accuracy breaking down or inventory postings failing to clear into Finance: establish an evidenced position, re-plan, reallocate, remove the structural cause and report a defensible trajectory to programme leadership. Create a deployment roadmap for new and existing accounts, including baseline assessment, gap closure, readiness criteria and stabilisation governance. Lead assurance, auditing and compliance Govern sampling and evaluation across voice calls, chats, emails and back-office transactions, ensuring coverage is risk-based and operationally practical. Define escalation pathways for material defects, repeat failures, customer impact and compliance breaches. Drive quality insights and improvement Integrate quality results with operational, customer, complaint and productivity data to identify systemic risk and improvement opportunities. Lead structured RCA using tools such as 5 Whys, fishbone analysis, Pareto analysis, FMEA and Lean Six Sigma methods. Govern corrective and preventive actions, including accountable owners, target dates, effectiveness checks and sustained-control reviews. Sponsor cross-functional improvement initiatives addressing agent knowledge, tools, scripts, workflow design, policy interpretation and upstream/downstream dependencies. Govern measurement and performance reviews Define a balanced quality scorecard and KPI dictionary, with clear calculation logic, data ownership, thresholds and drill-downs. Lead weekly, monthly and quarterly operating reviews; present performance, risks, trends, interventions and decisions required to delivery and client leadership. Ensure reporting distinguishes outcome measures, process measures and control-health indicators rather than relying on a single quality score. Track action plans to closure and confirm that reported improvement is supported by evidence. Lead people capability and stakeholder alignment Lead, mentor and develop Quality Managers, Quality Analysts and local quality specialists across locations and accounts. Establish assessor selection, certification, calibration, coaching and recertification standards. Partner with Operations, Training, Workforce Management, Technology, Risk/Compliance and client teams to embed quality into process design and daily management. Act as a change leader for new tools, processes and behaviours through communication, training, adoption tracking and feedback loops. Hands-on expertise in quality assurance, audit, calibration, RCA, corrective action, process standardisation and operational performance review. Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt preferred; practical application of DMAIC, FMEA, Pareto, control plans and statistical analysis expected. Working knowledge of Quality Management Systems and recognised frameworks such as ISO 9001 and COPC, as applicable to the operating environment. Ability to interpret client contracts, SOPs/DTPs, policy requirements and operational data, and translate them into clear controls and management actions. Experience with performance dashboards, ERP/workflow platforms such as SAP or Oracle, and analytical tools such as Minitab, Python, Power BI or equivalent is advantageous.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer - Senior Consultant
jobs.description:
Experience range: 4-8 Yrs
Role Summary We are looking for a hands-on Applied AI Engineer to design, build, evaluate, and productionise Generative AI and agentic applications across our product and solution portfolio. The role is centred on AI application engineering: turning foundation models into reliable systems that can reason, use tools, retrieve information, collaborate across agents, and complete complex business workflows. We are particularly interested in engineers who have built real multi-agent systems with explicit orchestration, state and context management, tool use, human-in-the-loop controls, evaluation, observability, and failure handling. You may have used frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, or comparable frameworks and developer tooling. Key Responsibilities Design and build Generative AI applications, autonomous agents, and multi-agent systems that solve real business problems across industries. Design agent orchestration patterns including supervisors and worker agents, routing, delegation, planning, tool selection, state management, memory, retries, fallbacks, and human approval points. Build agents that interact safely with enterprise data and systems through APIs, functions, retrieval, databases, vector stores, MCP servers, and other governed tools. Work with leading foundation models and model APIs, selecting appropriate models and designing effective prompts, structured outputs, tool schemas, context strategies, and model fallbacks. Build evaluation harnesses and test suites for agent quality, task completion, tool selection, groundedness, safety, latency, cost, and regression detection. Implement tracing, logging, observability, feedback loops, guardrails, and debugging approaches that make complex agent behaviour understandable and supportable in production. Prototype rapidly using modern AI SDKs and coding agents, then turn successful prototypes into maintainable, secure, production-grade applications. Work with product, engineering, data, architecture, security, and client teams to integrate AI systems into real workflows and enterprise environments. Continuously evaluate new models, agent frameworks, protocols, and development patterns, and turn useful capabilities into reusable engineering components. What We're Looking For We care more about evidence that you have built and debugged working AI systems than about a particular job title. Strong software engineering and AI application fundamentals are the priority. Approximately 2-6 years of software, ML, AI, or product engineering experience, including meaningful hands-on work with Generative AI or LLM-powered applications. Strong Python programming skills and good software engineering fundamentals, including APIs, asynchronous programming, testing, Git, packaging, and debugging. Solid understanding of LLM concepts including tokens and context windows, system and user prompts, structured outputs, tool/function calling, embeddings, retrieval, model selection, temperature and sampling, latency, and inference cost. Hands-on experience building agents or multi-agent systems using at least one modern framework such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, Microsoft Agent Framework, or similar. Experience implementing explicit agent orchestration rather than only prompt chains or chatbots, including state, routing, delegation, tool permissions, retries, checkpoints, and failure recovery. Experience with RAG and grounding patterns using enterprise documents, structured data, vector search, semantic search, or knowledge stores. Experience integrating LLM applications with external APIs, business systems, databases, and developer tools; familiarity with MCP is valuable. Understanding of AI evaluation techniques, including task-based evals, LLM-as-judge where appropriate, deterministic checks, test datasets, tracing, and regression testing. Understanding of production concerns including prompt injection, data leakage, access control, secrets, rate limits, token budgets, latency, reliability, observability, and cost management. Ability to investigate ambiguous model or agent failures systematically and improve behaviour through changes to prompts, context, tools, orchestration, models, or application logic. Agentic AI Experience Built a multi-step or multi-agent system in which multiple specialised agents coordinate through an orchestrator, supervisor, graph, workflow, or shared state. Experience designing tool-using agents that take actions rather than only generate text, with controls around what each agent can access and execute. Familiarity with modern agent development environments and AI coding tools such as Google ADK, OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, and related SDKs or command-line development workflows. Experience with durable execution concepts such as checkpoints, resumability, idempotency, timeouts, retries, error routing, long-running tasks, and human-in-the-loop review. Experience instrumenting agent traces and using evaluations and production feedback to understand failure modes and improve solve rate, reliability, usefulness, and cost. Ability to explain the architecture of an agentic system end-to-end, including model choice, orchestration, state, memory, tools, identity, permissions, evaluation, monitoring, deployment, and operational support. Nice to Have Experience building agentic solutions within Databricks or Snowflake, including governed access to enterprise data, models, functions, or tools. Exposure to Databricks Unity Catalog, Model Serving, Vector Search, AI Gateway / Unity Gateway, or Snowflake Cortex Agents, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, and Cortex AI Gateway. Experience with MLflow, LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, OpenTelemetry, or similar evaluation and observability tooling. Experience with vector databases or search platforms such as Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search, or cloud-native equivalents. Familiarity with cloud AI services and model platforms across AWS, Azure, or GCP, and with enterprise authentication and security patterns. Experience deploying AI services using FastAPI, containers, serverless platforms, or Kubernetes, and integrating them into web or enterprise applications. Experience with fine-tuning, model adaptation, synthetic data generation, or advanced retrieval techniques is useful but not required. What Success Looks Like You can take an ambiguous business problem and build an AI system that goes beyond a demo to complete meaningful tasks reliably. You can design and implement a multi-agent architecture with explicit orchestration, governed tools, state, evaluation, observability, and failure handling. You can diagnose why an agent fails on real tasks and improve the system using evidence from traces, evals, user feedback, and production behaviour. You make pragmatic choices between a simple deterministic workflow, a single agent, and a multi-agent system rather than adding agents where they are unnecessary. You create reusable technical patterns that help multiple product teams build safer and more reliable AI applications. What We Offer Opportunity to build AI, data, analytics, and digital products across Retail & CPG, Media & Entertainment, Sports, Energy, Telecommunications, and other industries. Hands-on work with frontier and enterprise foundation models, modern agent frameworks, and emerging AI development patterns. Opportunity to take AI solutions from prototypes through evaluation, enterprise integration, production deployment, and continuous improvement. Exposure to Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, Azure, GCP, and modern cloud-native AI technologies without being constrained to a single platform. A development path toward Senior Applied AI Engineer, AI Architect, Agentic AI Lead, or technical leadership roles. jobs.title: Senior Design Verification Engineer
jobs.description:
Experience range: 8-13 Yrs
Job Summary Join Intel as a Senior IP Design Verification Engineer for the Silicon Chassis team and play a critical role in shaping the future of cutting-edge technology. In this role, you will contribute to the development and verification of Intellectual Property (IP) logic, ensuring that our designs meet rigorous specifications and exceed industry standards. As a key member of the design verification team, you will collaborate with architects, RTL developers, and physical design teams to validate complex features and create robust, high-quality products. Your work will directly impact Intel's ability to deliver innovative solutions that power the world's most advanced computing systems. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute detailed verification plans to confirm IP logic adheres to microarchitecture specifications. Create and maintain test benches and verification environments using best-in-class methodologies such as OVM and UVM. Perform functional and system-level simulations to identify and debug issues, ensuring coverage and compliance with requirements. Root cause failing tests and implement corrective measures to resolve design issues. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve verification strategies and ensure optimal integration of complex architectural and microarchitectural features. Analyze power and timing impacts during verification to support overall design optimization. Document verification plans, methodologies, and results, and lead technical reviews to refine and enhance verification frameworks. Maintain and enhance existing verification infrastructure, contributing to the evolution of methodologies and tool flows. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications: Proficiency in hardware simulation, SystemVerilog, and advanced verification methodologies such as OVM and UVM. Strong expertise in developing and executing IP test plans and creating detailed verification environments. Solid understanding of interconnect/Fabric/NOC and bus protocols such as AMBA AXI/ACE/CHI, PCIe, or CXL, and working knowledge of cache coherency concepts. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 8+ years of experience with a Bachelor's degree, or 6+ years with a Master's degree, focusing on IP-level design verification and Subsystem verification. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with Design for Verification (DFV) techniques and methodologies. Demonstrated ability to drive technical reviews and collaborate effectively with architects and design teams. Familiarity with emerging trends in verification technologies and a passion for innovation in the field. Job Details Job Type: Experienced Hire Shift: Shift 1 (India) Primary Location: Bangalore, India Work Model This role will be eligible for our hybrid work model which allows employees to split their time between working on-site at their assigned Intel site and off-site.

Experience range: 4-6 Yrs
Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI Genpact • AI Value Studio • Reports into an Applied AI Lead About the Role As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) on Genpact's Applied AI team, you will embed directly with our most strategic enterprise customers to ship production AI applications that solve real business problems. You will spend most of your week in Claude Code and at the client, turning ambiguous business problems into working software often within days, not months. This is the role at the front line of how the world's largest companies actually adopt AI. You will own a workstream end-to-end: sitting with client teams to understand their workflows, designing the solution, building it, demoing it, and getting it into production. You will collaborate closely with Anthropic, our other AI partners, and Genpact's industry and delivery teams to make sure what you build lasts after you leave. We expect our FDEs to operate autonomously, thrive in ambiguity, and represent Genpact at the highest level inside customer environments. What You Will Do Work inside customer systems to build production applications with Claude and other frontier models, making sure they meet real customer requirements. Deliver technical artifacts: agentic workflows, MCP servers, sub-agents, agent skills, evaluation harnesses, and the integrations that wire them into the client's stack. Own a workstream end-to-end — discovery, architecture, build, demo, handoff. Make trade-offs between scope, speed, and quality in real time. Co-design solutions with client stakeholders at the Director and VP level. Sit in the client's room, take direction, and turn it into shipped code by the end of the day. Provide white-glove deployment support inside enterprise environments. Be the person the client trusts when something has to work. Identify and codify repeatable deployment patterns. Contribute reusable assets — code, prompts, skills, runbooks, reference implementations — back to the Genpact Applied AI practice. Stay current with the latest in LLM capabilities, agent frameworks, and the AI product development stack. Bring field insights back to our product and partner teams. What We Are Looking For 4+ years in a technical, customer-facing role — Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Solutions Architect, or software engineer with consulting experience. Former technical founders are strongly encouraged to apply. Daily, hands-on working fluency with Claude (or a comparable frontier LLM) as a build tool — not as a chatbot. You use it to ship every day. Production experience with LLMs: advanced prompt engineering, agent development, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale. Strong programming skills in Python and, ideally, one or more of TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, or SQL. Experience shipping production applications. Track record of shipping something a customer or end-user actually paid for, used, or measured — a product, an internal tool, a notable open-source project, or a demo that closed a deal. Can hold your own in a client conversation with senior stakeholders. You do not need a PM to translate. High agency — comfortable navigating ambiguity in complex organizations and turning vague business problems into concrete technical plans. High cooperation mindset — you can balance competing priorities across customer teams, Genpact delivery, and partners with integrity. Bonus Domain depth in a regulated industry: life sciences, financial services, healthcare, insurance. Hands-on experience with MCP, agent frameworks (Claude Code, Cursor, LangGraph, etc.), evaluation tooling, or LLM observability. Background in a top-tier product, startup, frontier-lab, or consulting environment — or a credible self-built equivalent. Experience operating in hybrid onshore/offshore delivery teams. Familiarity with security, privacy, and compliance considerations for enterprise AI deployment. What We Are Not Requiring A specific degree. No degree requirement, no preference for any particular institution. Specific certifications. The bar is the work, not the credentials. Anthropic, AWS, or other AI certifications are nice to have, not required. A traditional ML or PhD background. We are hiring builders who use LLMs, not researchers who train them. Interview Process Our process is designed to evaluate the work, not the resume: Initial conversation with the hiring manager (45 min). Portfolio walkthrough — bring something you built recently with Claude or a comparable model and walk us through how you built it (45 min). Live build exercise — a 90-minute pair-build or take-home on a realistic client problem using Claude. Highest-signal step in our process. Client simulation — a working session with Genpact senior delivery and a simulated client stakeholder. Final conversations with practice leadership. Location and Travel US-based with hybrid working model. 25–50% travel to client sites and Genpact delivery centers.

This partnership ranges from sharing the IT work load, executing global strategy to owning global applications offshore. The role combines strong Python and data engineering fundamentals (ETL, relational databases, REST APIs) with hands-on development of AI capabilities such as LLM-powered applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and agentic workflows. Translate business requirements into technical designs and work closely with business users, data teams and other stakeholders throughout implementation and delivery. Ensure solutions comply with the Group’s standards on data security, privacy, Responsible AI, risk and compliance. Support Lead Data Scientist on end-to-end AI/ML lifecycle: problem definition, design, experimentation, deployment, and continuous improvement. Define an optimized user experience for financial analytics data pipelines, unifying multiple tools and services into an integrated workflow. Partner with analytics domain experts to understand business data needs and translate them into a practical platform and framework strategy. Lead the execution of this strategy in close collaboration with engineering and project delivery teams. Communicate product goals, progress, and achievements to product, engineering, business leaders, sales, proposition, support, and intereholders. Stay informed on financial analytics market trends to maintain a forward‑looking, future‑ready strategy. Continuously learn and adapt to emerging technologies and techniques in financial analytics. Develop and deploy production‑grade AI models and data‑driven solutions aligned with strategic objectives. Tune and optimize AI models to improve accuracy, performance, and scalability. Evaluate third‑party AI capabilities using both functional and non‑functional criteria. Establish and enforce coding standards to ensure a maintainable, robust codebase. Collaborate with Software Engineers and cross‑functional teams to define requirements, set direction, and shape development roadmaps. Hands‑on experience in data science, including Natural Language Processing, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, and Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG). Skilled in training, testing, and validating deep learning models as well as classical machine learning models. Ability to design and implement evaluation frameworks for automation solutions based on business requirements. Experience building solutions and onboarding workloads on AWS or other cloud platforms. Expertise in web crawling and scraping techniques, entity identification and extraction, and advanced pre‑ and post‑processing methods using emerging technologies such as prompt engineering. Proficient in processing structured, semi‑structured, and unstructured data from PDFs and scanned documents. Required Skills: 6–8 years of experience in data science, analytics, or statistical modelling roles. Strong foundation in data analytics, feature engineering, NLP, predictive modelling, LLMs, and RAG workflows. Expertise in Python and core ML/DL libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit‑learn), with demonstrated experience in developing and productionizing AI models. Proven ability to apply strong statistical analysis skills, including probability and applied statistics, to model development and evaluation. Experience with Git‑based version control and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab/GitHub runners). Strong understanding of relational databases, large‑scale data processing, and statistical programming. Familiarity with MLOps principles and experience deploying solutions on cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure). Hands‑on experience with commercial or open‑source data management tools. Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of simplifying complex technical concepts for both technical and business audiences. Strong influencing and collaboration skills, supporting cross‑team execution and alignment. Ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical and business problems using deep analytical and industry knowledge Ability to set and uphold coding standards. Hands-on experience with leading commercial or open-source data management tools. Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to present to peers, senior management, and cross-functional partners. Broad business awareness and understanding of relevant internal business relationships.
