jobs.description: Job Title: Senior Consultant - AI Platform Lead Location: Chennai GCL: D3 Introduction to role: Are you ready to lead an enterprise AI platform that turns trusted data and agentic systems into real outcomes for patients and the business? This is your chance to build the foundation that powers secure, reliable AI assistants and a knowledge graph used across drug discovery, development and operations. In this hands-on technical role, you will set the technical direction, own the graph and agentic platform end to end, and enable teams across the company to deliver with speed and confidence. You will work closely with engineering, architecture, security and platform partners to improve on quality, reliability and operational excellence. What could your platform unlock next quarter for scientists and decision-makers? Accountabilities: Graph Platform Ownership: Operate and evolve the knowledge graph and graph database platform to enterprise standards, ensuring performance, availability, backup/restore, access management and smooth operations; make graph and other data stores readily usable by AI agents through secure tools, accelerating insight generation. Agentic AI Orchestration: Define and implement secure agent orchestration through gateways, build and maintain MCP servers and tool layers with clear guardrails, and establish reusable patterns for prompt, skill and tool management; continuously evaluate agents with automated benchmarks to improve quality, cost and latency. Secure Access Management: Provide a consistent, secure access layer to AI tools and internal applications; maintain shared sign-in services, protect credentials and enforce authorization so users can only access what they are entitled to, reducing risk and simplifying adoption. Cloud and Kubernetes Operations: Deploy and run workloads on Kubernetes using Helm with robust ingress, secrets management, storage sizing and per-pull-request review environments; provision infrastructure as code across Azure, AWS and GCP to keep deployments portable and resilient. Data Ingestion at Scale: Build and operate reliable, resumable bulk ingestion pipelines for multi-terabyte datasets across graph, analytical and search stores; process large Parquet datasets efficiently, manage deltas and staged releases to ensure fast, trustworthy data availability. CI/CD and GitOps Enablement: Design and maintain GitHub Actions pipelines for build, test, review apps and deployment (including self-hosted runners) and run deployments using GitOps to deliver frequent, safe changes. Full-Stack Application Delivery: Build and maintain backend services in Python and frontends in React/TypeScript with strong authentication, validation, pagination and versioning; own services end to end from design through deployment, monitoring and support to create reliable developer and user experiences. Technical Leadership and Enablement: Set platform priorities and direction, review designs and pull requests, mentor engineers, and partner with data, NLP, application, security and identity teams; create architecture documents, runbooks and integration guides, and communicate designs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences to scale impact across the organization. Essential Skills/Experience: 8+ years in platform, DevOps, SRE or infrastructure engineering, including experience leading technical work or mentoring others. Working knowledge of knowledge graphs, and hands-on experience with graph databases such as Neo4J. Experience writing skills and building gateway-based agent orchestration for LLM-based assistants. Expertise in processing Parquet data at scale (with PyArrow, pandas, Polars or Spark), including partitioning, schema handling and memory-efficient loading. Full-stack development experience: Python with FastAPI for REST APIs, React with TypeScript for frontends, and the ability to maintain and upgrade existing applications and dependencies. Ability to collaborate effectively with Databricks platform and data teams, including integrating with data they produce. Strong Python and shell scripting for automation and tooling. Deep experience with Kubernetes and Helm, and hands-on experience across Azure, AWS and GCP. Good experience with CI/CD, GitHub Actions, and GitOps. Hands-on experience implementing single sign-on MSAL against Microsoft Entra ID, both frontend (React) and backend applications. Solid grounding in authentication and authorization: OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT, Microsoft Entra ID and API gateway concepts. Experience running data stores in production. Infrastructure as code (Bicep, Terraform or similar) and sound secrets management. Clear written communication and good documentation habits. You'll develop your team of highly motivated and talented multi-functional builders who can collaborate with product managers, technical specialists, and principals across the company. You will participate in defining the technology roadmap for our advertising billing strategy, and shape building technology tools that can disrupt the billing industry. You will encounter challenging, novel situations every day and given the size of this initiative, you’ll have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon in different locations. We’re looking for entrepreneurs who are passionate about innovating on behalf of customers, can demonstrate a high degree of ownership, and want to have fun while they make history and craft beautiful products. Billing and Budgeting system should be easily scalable to manage exponential increase in traffic and extensible to support different business needs. High Availability: Downtime of Billing and Budgeting system can cause a huge loss in revenue and loss of business opportunity for our advertisers. Precision: Every click or impression needs to be counted, accounted, invoiced, and charged in near real-time, without any exception. It impacts both revenue and regulatory compliance. We need to build generic and extensible reconcilers for any anomaly detection and raising an appropriate alarm. Strong programming skills in Python and, ideally, one or more of TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, or SQL. Experience shipping production applications. Can hold your own in a client conversation with senior stakeholders. You do not need a PM to translate. High agency — comfortable navigating ambiguity in complex organizations and turning vague business problems into concrete technical plans. High cooperation mindset — you can balance competing priorities across customer teams, Genpact delivery, and partners with integrity. Bonus Domain depth in a regulated industry: life sciences, financial services, healthcare, insurance. Hands-on experience with MCP, agent frameworks (Claude Code, Cursor, LangGraph, etc.), evaluation tooling, or LLM observability. Background in a top-tier product, startup, frontier-lab, or consulting environment — or a credible self-built equivalent. Experience operating in hybrid onshore/offshore delivery teams. Familiarity with security, privacy, and compliance considerations for enterprise AI deployment. jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI/ML
jobs.description: Company Overview Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design. Position Overview We are seeking a talented and versatile AI / Machine Learning Engineer with 3–10 years of experience to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI-powered capabilities across our electronic design and verification tools. In this hands-on engineering role, you will contribute to the design and implementation of AI/ML pipelines and Agentic AI systems, bridge modern GenAI architectures with robust software engineering, and integrate intelligent capabilities directly into engineering workflows. Collaborating closely with domain experts, software architects, and product teams, you will translate cutting-edge AI concepts—such as intelligent copilots, multi-step reasoning agents, and automated EDA verification assistants—into reliable, scalable, and high-impact solutions. Key Responsibilities Design, implement, and deploy end-to-end AI/ML and Agentic AI solutions integrated into EDA software workflows and developer environments. Build and enhance intelligent agent systems capable of automated reasoning, planning, multi-step execution, and tool usage using modern frameworks (LangGraph, Model Context Protocol / MCP, etc.). Develop and optimize production Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, leveraging vector databases, hybrid retrieval, metadata filtering, and semantic reranking. Build robust data preprocessing, feature extraction, model inference, and evaluation pipelines adhering to clean code, testability, and CI/CD practices. Work closely with domain experts (chip design, verification), product managers, and core software engineering teams to formulate AI use cases, prototype solutions rapidly, and harden them into production. Ensure robust model safety, evaluation against hallucinations, prompt injection defenses, IP protection, and compliance with enterprise security and governance standards. Qualifications 3 to 10 years of professional software engineering and AI/ML experience, with proven hands-on involvement in taking AI/ML or LLM-based solutions from concept to production. Strong proficiency in Python with solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, modular architecture, and automated testing (pytest, CI/CD). Solid understanding of ML fundamentals, deep learning architectures (Transformers, CNNs/GNNs), feature engineering, data preprocessing, and model evaluation metrics. Practical experience building applications with foundational LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, LLaMA, etc.), prompt engineering best practices, and Agentic design patterns (ReAct, plan-and-execute, tool calling). Hands-on experience implementing RAG systems, embedding models, vector databases, and semantic retrieval strategies. Proficiency with modern ML and AI development libraries such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, Scikit-learn, LangChain, or LangGraph. Familiarity with containerization (Docker), REST/gRPC API development (e.g., FastAPI), and model serving/evaluation workflows. Demonstrated ability to break down complex domain problems, rapidly prototype AI solutions, benchmark performance, and iterate toward production-quality implementations. Preferred & Good-to-Have Skills Hands-on experience with Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA), instruction tuning, dataset preparation/curation, or domain-specific model adaptation using Hugging Face TRL or Axolotl. Familiarity with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, Apache AGE) and knowledge graph-augmented retrieval. Familiarity with C/C++, compiler concepts, or GPU profiling/acceleration (CUDA). Background or curiosity in digital logic design, SystemVerilog, hardware verification, or Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools. Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks (e.g., Ragas, TruLens, DeepEval) and experiment tracking platforms (MLflow, Weights & Biases). Why Us We are Siemens: At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow! Diversity & Inclusion We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday #LI-Hybrid #LI-EDA

jobs.description: Function: AI Engineering / Applied AI Delivery About the Role We're hiring an AI Engineer to design, build, and ship production AI systems — not prototypes, not notebooks. This is a builder's role: you'll own the path from "we think an LLM/agent could solve this" to a system running reliably in production, under real load, with real failure modes. We are being deliberately selective here. This role is not for someone who has "used ChatGPT a lot" or built a weekend RAG demo. We want people who have shipped agentic or LLM-powered systems that other engineers depend on, who understand why those systems break, and who can hold their own in a room full of skeptical senior engineers. If that's not you yet, this probably isn't the right role yet either — and that's fine. full lifecycle of at least one non-trivial AI capability: problem framing, evaluation strategy, prompt/context engineering, orchestration, deployment, and post-launch tuning Build deterministic guardrails around probabilistic components — retries, validation, fallback paths, human-in-the-loop checkpoints where confidence is low Design evaluation harnesses and offline/online eval pipelines that actually catch regressions, not vanity metrics Make real architectural tradeoffs on latency, cost, and reliability — token economics is a design constraint you think about upfront, not an afterthought Integrate AI systems into existing production infrastructure (APIs, data pipelines, orchestration layers) without breaking what already works Push back on bad ideas — including ours — each of these breaks down Strong grasp of evaluation methodology — you know the difference between a model that looks good in a demo and one that's actually reliable Comfortable with orchestration and systems fundamentals: APIs, event-driven design, queuing, observability, CI/CD Able to reason clearly about cost, latency, and failure modes at design time, not just after something breaks in production Sharp communicator — can explain a technical tradeoff to both an engineer and a non-technical stakeholder without dumbing it down or overcomplicating it Genuinely curious and self-directed jobs.title: Research Engineer – Generative AI and Computer Vision
jobs.description: Company Description Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region. Job Description Role Overview The Research Engineer – Generative AI and Computer Vision focuses on advancing state-of-the-art Generative AI and deep learning methods for real-world computer vision applications. The role combines applied research, experimentation, and engineering to develop robust AI solutions for image understanding, synthetic data generation, visual inspection, and continuous model monitoring. The role will contribute to applied research and development of scalable AI capabilities spanning the full computer vision lifecycle—from data preparation and model development to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. The work will address practical challenges such as limited or imbalanced training data, rare events, changing image conditions, data drift, and model-performance degradation in operation. This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced AI research and real-world deployment, translating novel Generative AI and computer vision methods into reliable and scalable solutions across a range of industrial and business applications. Roles & Responsibilities : Generative AI and Synthetic Data: Research, design, and implement Generative AI approaches for creating realistic and diverse synthetic image datasets. Explore diffusion models, generative adversarial networks, image-to-image generation, controllable generation, and related techniques to address limited data, rare defects, class imbalance, and long-tail inspection scenarios. Computer Vision Model Development: Develop and evaluate deep learning models for industrial image inspection tasks such as image classification, defect detection, anomaly detection, object detection, segmentation, and representation learning. Work with CNN-based, transformer-based, and multimodal architectures. Data-Efficient Learning: Investigate methods including transfer learning, self-supervised learning, few-shot learning, domain adaptation, active learning, and synthetic data augmentation to reduce annotation effort and improve model performance under limited-data conditions. Model Monitoring and Robustness: Develop methods for continuously monitoring deployed inspection models and image-data pipelines. This includes detecting data drift, changes in image conditions, model-performance degradation, confidence shifts, unusual defect patterns, and out-of-distribution inputs. Research and Experimentation: Formulate research hypotheses, design controlled experiments and ablation studies, establish appropriate evaluation benchmarks, and analyze results with scientific rigor. Compare state-of-the-art methods and identify approaches suitable for industrial deployment. Prototype and Product Integration: Build proof-of-concept solutions and research prototypes using Python and modern deep learning frameworks. Collaborate with software, cloud, MLOps, manufacturing, and domain teams to integrate validated methods into scalable AI platforms and applications. Scalable AI Lifecycle: Contribute to capabilities covering data preparation, model training, validation, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and continuous improvement across the complete computer vision model lifecycle. Technology Transfer and Scientific Impact: Translate research outcomes into scalable and production-ready AI components. Document technical findings, communicate results to technical and business stakeholders, and contribute to publications, invention disclosures, patents, reusable frameworks, and Bosch’s intellectual-property portfolio. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with global research, engineering, manufacturing, and product teams to understand inspection requirements and convert real-world challenges into well-defined AI research and development problems. Qualifications Educational qualification: Ph.D. or M.S. or M. Tech from top Indian or foreign institutes (IITs, IIITs, IISc etc.) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, Applied Mathematics, or a closely related field. Experience : At least 3 years of relevant professional or applied research experience in computer vision, deep learning, Generative AI, machine learning, or related areas. Mandatory/requires Skills : Strong understanding of machine learning, deep learning, and computer vision fundamentals. Hands-on experience developing computer vision solutions using techniques such as convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and other sequence models where applicable, transformers, autoencoders, and other modern neural-network architectures. Strong proficiency in Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch. Experience with supporting libraries such as NumPy, pandas, OpenCV, scikit-learn, and common image-processing libraries. Practical experience with transformer-based vision models, such as Vision Transformers, hierarchical vision transformers, detection transformers, or related architectures. Hands-on knowledge of Generative AI methods for image data, particularly diffusion models, generative adversarial networks, variational autoencoders, or image-to-image generation methods. Experience designing synthetic data-generation or advanced data-augmentation pipelines for training and evaluating computer vision models. Experience with one or more computer vision tasks such as image classification, object detection, semantic or instance segmentation, anomaly detection, defect detection, or visual similarity learning. Experience with the Hugging Face ecosystem (models, libraries, and SDKs) for rapid prototyping and evaluation of state-of-the-art AI models. Hands-on experience with model evaluation methodologies and metrics (such as Precision, Recall, F1-score, AUC, and ROC), including the rigorous interpretation of results to optimize model decision thresholds. Ability to formulate research questions, design rigorous experiments and ablation studies, establish evaluation metrics, benchmark alternative approaches, and interpret empirical results. Understanding of model generalization, domain shift, data drift, out-of-distribution detection, uncertainty estimation, and model-performance monitoring. Good software-engineering practices, including version control, modular implementation, code reviews, testing, technical documentation, and reproducible experimentation. Strong analytical, problem-solving, presentation, and communication skills. Ability to collaborate effectively with interdisciplinary and geographically distributed teams. Preferred Skills - Any of the following will be an added advantage : Experience applying computer vision to industrial quality inspection, automated optical inspection, manufacturing, robotics, medical imaging, autonomous systems, or other safety- or quality-critical applications. Experience with synthetic defect generation, rare-event simulation, controllable image generation, domain randomization, or simulation-to-real transfer. Familiarity with vision-language models, multimodal foundation models, zero-shot or open-vocabulary vision methods, and parameter-efficient model adaptation (PEFT techniques such as LoRA, QLoRA etc.). Knowledge of self-supervised learning, contrastive learning, active learning, weakly supervised learning, few-shot learning, and continual learning. Experience with monitoring metrics and techniques such as input-data drift, feature drift, prediction drift, confidence calibration, outlier detection, defect-rate analysis, and alert generation. jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Minimum qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 8 years of experience in cloud computing or a technical customer-facing role. Experience building pipelines for structured and unstructured data using both vector databases and RAG-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions. Experience taking production-grade AI-driven solutions from conception to launch and architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform (GCP)). Experience leading technical discovery sessions. Preferred qualifications: Master’s or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field. Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation). Knowledge of "LLM-native" metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing. About the job As a GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you will be an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality within customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you will function as an "innovator-builder," moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. This role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management challenges that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with strategic accounts, you will serve a dual purpose: providing "white glove" deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap. It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours. Responsibilities Serve as a developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, model context protocol (MCP) servers) that drive measurable return on investment (ROI). Architect and code the "connective tissue" between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team. Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet rigorous requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency. Identify repeatable field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams. Co-build with customer engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, RBS Tech
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Are you excited about building the future of Retail Automation powered by Generative AI? Retail Business Services (RBS) supports Amazon's Retail business growth WW through three core tasks. These are (a) Selection, where RBS sources, creates and enriches ASINs to drive GMS growth; (b) Defect Elimination, where RBS resolves inbound supply chain defects and develops root cause fixes to improve free cash flow; and (c) supports operational process for WW Retail teams where there is an air gap in the tech stack. The tech team in RBS develops intelligent automation powered by GenAI, LLM and Machine/Deep Learning to scale execution of highly complex tasks that currently require human cognitive skills. Our solutions ensure that information in Amazon's catalog is complete, correct and comprehensive enough to give Amazon customers a great shopping experience every time. Why join us We believe in "Work Hard. Have Fun. Make History" value by having a strong focus on sharing learning experiences from the front line with the development teams. So, the options for people in the team are vast. If you like mastering a domain and going deep, we need you. If you love designing elegant abstractions for messy real world problems, we need you. If you love the benefits of process and methodical improvement, you will love it here. If you get a kick out of seeing your code improve the shopping experience for millions of customers worldwide, we definitely need you. If you want to keep your head down, headphones on, and bash out code to support the team, we have a spot for you too. About the role At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world's most beloved brands, customer obsession is part of our company DNA. We are seeking a Software Development Engineer II to join the SAMAI team and help us push the boundaries of what's possible with Generative AI in retail automation. As an SDE2, you will not just write code, you will architect systems that think. You will design scalable, distributed platforms that orchestrate LLM powered agents, build robust pipelines that process millions of data points daily, and make critical design trade offs that directly influence a multi billion dollar business. You will work at the intersection of Generative AI, distributed systems and real world business impact. Every system you build will be tested against the unforgiving scale of Amazon's catalog, hundreds of millions of ASINs, dozens of marketplaces and billions of customer interactions. You will collaborate closely with Applied Scientists and senior engineers to turn cutting edge research into production systems that work at scale. You will constantly stretch the boundaries of innovation to tackle the business challenges. If you enjoy designing and building GenAI powered platforms, highly distributed systems that can scale and solving challenging problems, come join us! Work/Life Balance RBS Tech team puts a high value on work-life harmony. It isn't about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it's about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and we encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives. Mentorship and Career Growth Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring, detailed and constructive code reviews. We have casual coffee chats with Principal and Senior Engineers from RBS Tech. You get an opportunity to network and have technical conversations around your work, technical challenges, suggestions, ideas and proposals. You can also seek advice and discuss about things outside work, like, life in general, your family, hobbies etc. We provide trainings to the employees through online learning platforms such as O'Reilly and also encourage them to take up AWS/ML certifications. And on a team building Gen AI systems every day, the learning opportunities are endless. Key job responsibilities We are looking for a sharp, experienced Software developer with a diverse skillset and background. As a SDE-2, your work is consistently of high quality. You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). You limit the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc.). You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers. You help your team evolve by actively participating in the code review process, design discussions, team planning, and ticket/metric reviews. You focus on operational excellence, constructively identifying problems and proposing solutions. You take on projects and make software enhancements that improve team software and processes. You are able to train new team-mates on how your team’s software is constructed, how it operates, how secure it is, and how it fits into the bigger picture. About the team We are building SAMAI, our Gen AI powered automation platform that is redefining how RBS delivers at scale. SAMAI harnesses the power of LLMs, agentic AI workflows and cutting edge ML to automate complex retail business processes end to end. Think of it as the brain behind RBS's next generation automation, orchestrating intelligent agents that can reason, act and deliver outcomes that previously needed hundreds of human hours. We are not just using Gen AI as a feature; we are building a platform that makes GenAI the foundation of retail operations. You are able to train new team-mates on how your team’s software is constructed, how it operates, how secure it is, and how it fits into the bigger picture. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience Experience programming with at least one software programming language Knowledge of professional software engineering & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: LLM & Agentic AI Performance Engineer
jobs.description: Job Details: Job Description: The Role and Impact: Join Intel's Data Center AI organization and help shape how LLM and Agentic AI workloads perform on Intel platforms. Our team operates at a unique intersection of core performance optimization, AI frameworks, and customer-facing AI solutions. We bridge the gap between teams that deeply understand silicon and benchmarking and teams building real-world AI solutions, turning performance insights into software optimizations that developers and customers can use. In this role, you will own end-to-end performance characterization and optimization of LLM and Agentic AI workloads, from Python-level frameworks and inference runtimes down to Linux, system architecture, and hardware performance counters. This is not simply a benchmarking role. Benchmarking tells us what the number is. Your job is to understand why the number is what it is, identify the hardware or software bottleneck, and determine what needs to change to remove it. Your work will translate into code contributions, framework optimizations, best-known configurations (BKCs), customer-ready solutions, and insights that help influence future Intel hardware and software. If you enjoy working across the complete AI stack, from agent frameworks and LLM serving engines to NUMA, memory bandwidth, cache behavior, and silicon counters, this role provides an opportunity to work at that intersection. About the Team: The AI Solutions and Toolkit Engineering team is part of Intel's Data Center organization, focused on enabling modern AI workloads and solutions on Intel platforms. We work across the AI ecosystem, collaborating with AI framework and runtime developers, performance and optimization teams, hardware architects, open-source communities, and solution engineering teams. Our goal is to take deep platform capabilities and performance insights and translate them into practical, optimized AI solutions that developers and customers can deploy. The team works across areas including LLM inference, Agentic AI, AI frameworks and runtimes, workload optimization, open-source software, and datacenter AI systems. Key Responsibilities: Characterize and optimize LLM and Agentic AI workloads across the complete software and hardware stack. Identify performance bottlenecks across AI frameworks, inference runtimes, operating systems, memory, compute, and platform architecture. Design and develop hardware-aware and hardware-agnostic optimizations for AI frameworks and runtimes. Optimize LLM inference techniques including KV-cache management, attention, continuous batching, and quantization. Work hands-on with serving stacks such as vLLM, SGLang, TGI, or equivalent technologies. Analyze host and accelerator performance using tools such as VTune, EMON/PMU, perf, top-down analysis, and roofline modeling. Debug complex performance issues spanning Python frameworks, native code, Linux, runtime libraries, and hardware. Convert performance findings into software changes, upstream contributions, BKCs, and reusable optimization guidance. Collaborate with open-source communities to upstream and integrate performance improvements. Translate silicon-level findings into actionable recommendations for framework developers, while bringing application and framework insights back to Intel platform and silicon teams. Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications: BE +10 years / M.Tech +8 years in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline. Significant hands-on experience in performance engineering, systems optimization, or workload characterization on server-class platforms. Demonstrated ability to identify complex performance bottlenecks and deliver measurable performance improvements. Strong programming skills in Python and C++, or equivalent systems programming experience in C/Rust. Strong understanding of server architecture including cache hierarchy, memory bandwidth, NUMA, interconnects, and system-level performance behavior. Hands-on experience with Linux performance and system technologies such as affinity, huge pages, cgroups, eBPF, ftrace, perf, or equivalent tools. Preferred Qualifications: Deep understanding of LLM inference, including KV-cache, paged attention, continuous batching and quantization such as INT8, INT4, or FP8. Contributions to significant open-source projects, including upstream code contributions. Ability to communicate across abstraction layers, translating silicon-level findings for software developers and application-level requirements for hardware architects. Why Join This Team? jobs.title: AI Performance Modeling Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career. Responsibilities: The Role We're building GPUs to run the most demanding AI in the world — Transformers, LLMs, and large vision models — and we need an experienced hands-on engineer who can tell us how fast those workloads will run before the silicon exists . This is an AI performance projection/modeling role: your job is to model AI workloads on our GPU architecture, predict their performance with confidence, and use those projections to shape the hardware we build. You'll work across the full modeling spectrum — analytical models for fast architectural what-ifs, and architectural and cycle-accurate simulators for precision — choosing the right level of fidelity for the question at hand. Because these workloads live on the GPU, you'll need real GPU architecture depth to do it. If you think in rooflines, arithmetic intensity, tensor/pipeline/data parallelism, and KV-cache bandwidth budgets — and you want your models to change the microarchitecture, not just describe it — this is the role. What You'll Do Project AI workload performance (your core mission) Build and use models — analytical, architectural, and cycle-accurate — to project the performance of generative AI and LLM workloads (attention, GEMMs, collectives, training and inference, vision models etc) on our GPU architecture. Choose the right fidelity for the question: analytical bounds and rooflines for rapid trade-off exploration, architectural and cycle-accurate simulation for precise answers. Find where performance will be won or lost — compute-engine occupancy, L1/L2 hierarchy, memory bandwidth, SoC fabric — and quantify the impact of each. Characterize workloads & shape the hardware Characterize AI workloads end to end — trace and profile execution, extract structural footprints, and translate them into microarchitectural bottlenecks and performance bounding boxes. Run architecture experiments to evaluate GPU configurations, scaling limits, and trade-offs against real AI workloads, backing every recommendation with sensitivity analysis and data. Extend and maintain the cycle-accurate / cycle-approximate simulators for the GPU subsystems AI workloads depend on — compute engines, cache hierarchies, memory subsystems, interconnects. Prove it on silicon (post-silicon) Run AI workloads on early silicon, capture telemetry, and correlate results back to your pre-silicon models to sharpen fidelity. Root-cause AI performance mismatches on physical silicon using low-level performance counters, register dumps, and Linux tracing. Collaborate across the stack Partner with compiler, runtime, and framework teams to turn model insights into optimizations, and to ground your projections in how workloads actually execute. Act as the bridge between architecture/RTL and software, translating AI workload requirements into concrete architectural constraints. What You'll Bring AI workload expertise: Deep, hands-on understanding of LLM and Transformer performance — scaling techniques, parallel training/inference strategies (tensor, pipeline, data parallelism), kernel execution graphs — and how they map to hardware. Performance modeling breadth: Hands-on experience with analytical performance models and execution-driven / architectural / cycle-accurate simulators, and sound judgment about which to reach for. Track record of turning models into decisions. GPU architecture depth: Strong command of GPU execution pipelines, SIMD/SIMT models, cache hierarchy, memory technologies, and high-bandwidth interconnects (PCIe, custom fabrics). Engineering craft: Expert modern C++ and production-grade Python. Execution: Excellent structured problem-solving; able to turn noisy simulation data into crisp, actionable findings for engineering stakeholders. Nice to have: Experience with NPU / AI-accelerator architecture, or modeling AI workloads on dedicated inference/training accelerators. #LI-AA1 Qualifications: Benefits offered are described: AMD benefits at a glance. Customer Health & Retention: Monitor customer health, adoption trends, and sentiment to proactively identify risks, develop recovery plans, and support long-term customer retention. Account Planning & Growth: Collaborate with Sales and Account Teams to contribute customer insights, support account planning activities, and identify opportunities for product adoption, expansion, and growth. Cross-Functional Leadership: Coordinate activities across Sales, Application Engineering, Support, Product Management, Professional Services, and Marketing to ensure successful customer outcomes. Voice of the Customer: Represent customer needs and feedback within the organization, helping influence product priorities, adoption strategies, and customer experience improvements. Executive Business Reviews & Governance: Lead customer governance discussions and business reviews that demonstrate value, align stakeholders, identify opportunities, and strengthen strategic relationships. Customer Advocacy: Develop customer champions and advocates who can participate in reference programs, industry events, case studies, and other strategic engagement initiatives. Qualifications Education Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Experience 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Business Development, Application Engineering, Technical Consulting, Pre-Sales, or Account Management within engineering software, CAE, simulation, PLM, CAD, or related technology industries. Experience managing strategic customer relationships and driving long-term adoption programs. Experience conducting customer reviews, executive engagements, and technical discussions with multiple stakeholder levels. Proven history of supporting customer retention, adoption growth, and business expansion initiatives. Core Competencies Strong customer-centric mindset. Strategic account planning and stakeholder management. Ability to leverage AI tools to enhance customer engagement, adoption, reporting, and productivity. Executive communication and presentation skills. Customer health and sentiment management. Value realization and adoption planning. Cross-functional leadership and influence without authority. Analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Strong business and commercial acumen. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Tools & Platforms CRM platforms such as Salesforce. Customer Success platforms such as Gainsight. Bring AI expertise Customer adoption and engagement analytics tools. Microsoft Office and collaboration platforms. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Customer Outcomes: Achievement of customer success plan objectives; customer adoption and utilization growth; successful onboarding and adoption milestones. Customer Health: Customer health score improvements; customer sentiment and relationship strength; risk identification and mitigation effectiveness. Retention & Growth: Customer retention rate; contribution to Net Revenue Retention (NRR); expansion opportunities identified and supported; renewal readiness and account stability. Customer Advocacy: Customer references and success stories generated; product feedback submitted and acted upon; participation in advocacy and community initiatives. Operational & Reporting: Accurate customer planning, reporting, and cross-functional execution. Ideal Candidate Profile A successful candidate will be a technically credible CAE professional who can build trusted relationships, drive customer adoption, influence cross-functional teams, manage customer sentiment, contribute to account planning, and identify business growth opportunities while ensuring customers achieve measurable engineering and business outcomes. jobs.title: Manager, Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Use Your Power for Purpose At Pfizer, technology impacts everything we do. Our digital and 'data first' strategy focuses on implementing impactful and innovative technology solutions across all functions, from research to manufacturing. By digitizing drug discovery and development, identifying solutions, or making our work easier and faster, you will be making a difference to countless lives. Your dedication and hard work will be instrumental in helping Pfizer achieve new milestones and make a positive impact on patients worldwide. ROLE SUMMARY Build AI that Finance & Global Business Services (GBS) teams use every day and see it in production within weeks. As Manager, Forward Deployed Engineer, you join a Finance & GBS function team, learn how the work gets done, and build AI that changes it. You own the full path: problem discovery, prototype, MVP, production handoff and support. You learn the process, and you write the code. You work on engagements in areas such as financial close, forecasting, accounts receivable, procure-to-pay, tax, treasury, shared services operations, and other F&GBS functions. We measure success through adoption and demonstrable business outcomes, including time saved and adoption, improved quality, reduced risk, stronger controls, faster cycle times, better decisions, and measurable financial impact. This is a hands-on individual contributor role within the F&GBS Technology & AI Solutions Capability Center in Chennai. You work alongside Product Owners, function leaders, finance analysts, process owners, and Digital platform teams. WHY THIS ROLE You work directly with Finance and GBS teams worldwide, so you find out fast whether what you build works. You build agentic AI with frontier models on Pfizer’s enterprise AI platforms, connected to SAP, Snowflake, Oracle EPM and custom solutions through MCP or direct API integration. You help build and expand a shared F&GBS Data & AI Foundation (ontology, rules engine, MCP tool library, and decision ledger), so future agents don’t start from scratch. You can grow into a Senior Manager technical lead role without moving into people management. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Problem Discovery & Business Embedding Work in person in Chennai alongside a F&GBS Technology & AI Solutions Capability Center, while embedding virtually with an assigned Finance or GBS team. Learn the work through regular calls, screen-share walkthroughs, and process reviews, map the process, and find where AI removes effort, risk, or delay. Run discovery with business users and process owners across regions, including the US and Europe. Translate business pain points into scoped use cases with success measures agreed with the business owner. Work from Product Owner priorities and specifications, and shape them into buildable scope with the business owner. Push back when the request doesn’t match the underlying problem or it’s exposed to technical issues and limitation. Build & Ship Build agentic AI solutions end to end: agents and tools on Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI, other market leading runtimes and Microsoft Agent Framework, Lang Graph, LangChain, MCP tool integrations, retrieval with Azure AI Search, document extraction with Document Intelligence, and the interfaces users touch. Deliver working prototypes in days and MVPs in weeks. Iterate directly with end users. Write production-quality code in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, with tests, version control, and code review. Use AI coding agents in your daily workflow, and review AI-generated code to the same standard as your own. Build evaluation sets that prove accuracy on real finance data before release, and run them as regression tests on every change. Data & Enterprise Integration Connect solutions to enterprise Finance and GBS data and systems through governed MCP tools (or API) and certified data products, such as SAP S/4HANA, Snowflake (including Cortex), Databricks, SAP Ariba and Business Network, Oracle EPM, Microsoft 365, and other enterprise platforms. Write and tune SQL. Use and extend the shared F&GBS ontology, semantic views, and business rules instead of hard-coding logic in prompts. Follow data access, entitlement, and classification rules for financial and personal data. Controls, Compliance & Responsible AI Design solutions that hold up to SOX, Internal Audit, data privacy (GDPR, India DPDP Act), and EU AI Act review. Record agent evidence, approvals, and actions in the decision ledger, and build human review steps where AI outputs drive financial decisions. Apply Pfizer responsible AI safeguards: data access controls, prompt injection defenses, and output monitoring. Document design decisions, data lineage, and model behavior for control owners. Production & Handoff Own production readiness and ongoing support: LLMOps practice, deployment pipelines, monitoring, incident response, and run costs. Establish support ownership, runbooks, service expectations, escalation paths, knowledge transfer, and root cause analysis for production solutions. Deploy through approved pipelines on Pfizer cloud and GenAI platforms. Set up logging, tracing, monitoring, and alerting with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Foundry Observability. Contribute reusable components and patterns to the team’s shared library. Value & Adoption Track usage, accuracy, and hours saved. Report results to the business owner and FDE leadership. Train users and build champions in the business so adoption sticks. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS You can partner with the business, turn messy problems into working solutions, and show the impact in numbers. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, with [6+] years of software or data engineering experience. 3+ years building LLM-based applications, including RAG, tool calling, or agents, with at least one solution in use by business users. Experience evaluating and testing LLM output quality. Hands-on Python coding at a production standard. Working knowledge of TypeScript/JavaScript and a modern web framework such as React. Strong SQL and experience working with enterprise data platforms. Hands-on experience with Azure (preferred) or AWS cloud services, API design, and CI/CD. Track record of working directly with business users to define and deliver solutions. Clear written and verbal communication with non-technical stakeholders. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Master’s degree in a technical field, or a finance/accounting background combined with engineering experience. Working knowledge of finance processes such as record-to-report, order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, or FP&A. Experience with SAP data structures, Snowflake (including Cortex), or the Azure AI stack (AI Foundry, AI Search, Document Intelligence, Azure ML). Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph), MCP, and vector search. Exposure to ontologies, knowledge graphs, or rules engines. Experience in a regulated industry, with exposure to SOX or IT general controls. Relevant certifications (AWS or Azure Developer or Solutions Architect or other market leading runtimes). You don’t need every item on this list. If you’ve shipped AI that people use and you want to work close to the business, we want to hear from you. NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL, OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS Regular overlap with US and European time zones is required, including some early-evening IST calls. Must be able to travel to Pfizer offices and partner sites when required, including occasional international travel. Work can be demanding at times, including support during period-end close or response to production incidents. Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers. Information & Business Tech

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Use Your Power for Purpose At Pfizer, technology drives everything we do. You will play a pivotal role in implementing impactful and innovative technology solutions across all functions, from research to manufacturing. Whether you are digitizing drug discovery and development, identifying innovative solutions, or streamlining our processes, you will be making a significant impact on countless lives. ROLE SUMMARY Take the hardest AI problems in Finance & Global Business Services (GBS) from whiteboard to production, and set the patterns the rest of the team builds on. As Senior Manager, Forward Deployed Engineer, you join a Finance & GBS function team, define the problem, and lead the build from first prototype through production handoff and support. You take the engagements that span multiple systems or teams. You work on engagements in areas such as financial close, forecasting, accounts receivable, procure-to-pay, tax, treasury, shared services operations, and other F&GBS functions. We measure success through adoption and demonstrable business outcomes, including time saved, improved quality, reduced risk, stronger controls, faster cycle times, better decisions, and measurable financial impact, and by how much of your work the rest of the team can reuse. This is a senior hands-on individual contributor and technical lead role within the F&GBS Technology & AI Solutions Capability Center in Chennai. You set the engineering patterns other Forward Deployed Engineers follow, review their designs and code, and still write code every week. You work alongside Product Owners, function leaders, finance analysts, process owners, and Digital platform and architecture teams. WHY THIS ROLE You work directly with Finance and GBS leaders worldwide, so you find out fast whether what you build works. You lead the design of agentic AI built with frontier models on Pfizer’s enterprise AI platforms, connected to SAP, Snowflake, Oracle EPM, and custom solutions through MCP or direct API integration. You help shape a shared F&GBS Data & AI Foundation (ontology, rules engine, MCP tool library, and decision ledger), and decide which patterns become shared building blocks. Your influence grows through technical leadership and the patterns others reuse. You can grow your career without moving into people management. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Problem Discovery & Business Partnership Work in person in Chennai within the F&GBS Technology & AI Solutions Capability Center, while embedding virtually with assigned Finance and GBS teams. Lead discovery for complex, cross-functional use cases through regular calls, screen-share walkthroughs, and process reviews, and shape them into roadmaps with measurable outcomes. Run discovery with senior business stakeholders and process owners across regions, including the US and Europe. Work with Product Owners to turn priorities and specifications into solution designs and delivery plans, and to rank use cases by value, feasibility, and risk. Say no, or not yet, when a use case lacks data, sponsorship, or a clear value case, and push back when a specification doesn’t match the underlying problem or runs into technical issues and limitations. Technical Leadership & Build Serve as technical lead on complex engagements. Own solution design and stay hands-on in the code. Design multi-agent and multi-step workflows on Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI, and other market-leading runtimes, using frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, and LangChain, with MCP, A2A, and APIs connecting enterprise systems, deterministic business rules, and human approval steps. Set coding standards, evaluation practice, and quality bars for the engagements you lead, including review standards for AI-generated code. Use AI coding agents in your daily workflow to speed delivery, and show other engineers how to use them well. Make build-versus-buy and platform choices with Digital platform and architecture teams. Data & Enterprise Integration Lead integration across Finance and GBS data and systems through governed MCP tools or APIs and certified data products, such as SAP S/4HANA, Snowflake (including Cortex), Databricks, SAP Ariba and Business Network, Oracle EPM, Microsoft 365, and other enterprise platforms. Define data contracts, semantic models, and access patterns, and extend the shared F&GBS ontology and business rules (such as Delegation of Authority, Segregation of Duties, and materiality) that other engineers and agents reuse. Set data access, entitlement, and classification practice for financial and personal data on the engagements you lead. Controls, Compliance & Responsible AI Own control design for your solutions. Engage SOX, Internal Audit, Privacy, Legal, Security, and AI governance early, including data privacy (GDPR, India DPDP Act) and EU AI Act review, and pass required gates before release. Define evaluation and monitoring for accuracy, drift, and failure modes on financial outputs, and make sure agent evidence, approvals, and actions are recorded in the decision ledger. Enforce Pfizer responsible AI safeguards: data access controls, prompt injection defenses, human review, and output monitoring. Production, Reliability & Reuse Own production readiness and ongoing support for the solutions you lead: LLMOps practice, deployment pipelines, monitoring, incident response, and run costs. Establish support ownership, runbooks, service expectations, escalation paths, knowledge transfer, and root cause analysis for production solutions. Set the standard for logging, tracing, monitoring, and alerting with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Foundry Observability. Convert proven solutions into reusable components, templates, and accelerators across Finance and GBS. Identify and pay down technical debt before it blocks scale. Mentoring & Practice Building Mentor Manager-level FDEs, and engineers in F&GBS function teams, through design reviews, pairing, and code review. Contribute to FDE playbooks, interview loops, and team upskilling. Value & Adoption Build business cases and track realized value: hours saved, cycle time, cost avoidance, and risk reduction. Present results and tradeoffs to senior Finance and GBS stakeholders and FDE leadership. Build champions in the business so adoption sticks. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS You can partner with the business, turn messy problems into working solutions, and show the impact in numbers. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, with [9+] years of software or data engineering experience. 3+ years building and shipping LLM-based applications to production, including at least one multi-step agentic system with tool use, evaluation, and monitoring. Technical lead experience on complex, multi-system builds. Expert-level Python, with strong TypeScript/JavaScript and SQL. Hands-on experience with Azure (preferred) or AWS cloud architecture, API-first design, CI/CD, and observability. Hands-on LLMOps practice: evaluation, tracing, and prompt, model, and agent versioning. Proven ability to influence senior business stakeholders without formal authority. Experience mentoring engineers. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Master’s degree in a technical field, or a finance/accounting background combined with engineering experience. Deep knowledge of finance processes such as record-to-report, order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, FP&A, or treasury, or prior work in finance technology. Experience integrating with SAP (S/4HANA, GTS, Ariba), Snowflake (including Cortex), Databricks, the Azure AI stack (AI Foundry, AI Search, Document Intelligence, Azure ML), Vertex AI, or Oracle EPM. Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, LangChain), MCP server development, and A2A. Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs, or rules engines. Experience with SOX and IT general controls in a regulated industry. Experience turning bespoke solutions into reusable platforms or products. Relevant certifications (AWS or Azure Solutions Architect or Developer, or equivalent on other market-leading platforms). You don’t need every item on this list. If you’ve led AI into production that people use and you want to work close to the business, we want to hear from you. NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL, OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS Regular overlap with US and European time zones is required, including some early-evening IST calls. Must be able to travel to Pfizer offices and partner sites when required, including occasional international travel. Work can be demanding at times, including support during period-end close and leading the response to production incidents. Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers. Information & Business Tech

jobs.title: Principal Forward Deployed DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.description: About the Role We're after a hands-on engineer for our Forward Deployed team in Labs & CMC Digital & Tech, building the automation, data pipelines and AI tooling that take manual work out of the lab. You'll typically work closely alongside a Senior Principal Forward Deployed DevSecOps Engineer on the approach, coordinating with stakeholders as needed, while your own focus stays on turning that direction into working software: quickly, securely, and in a way that still holds up once it's live. As you build experience, you may take on more of that stakeholder relationship yourself, with support and guidance from leadership. Expect a lot of coding, pipeline work and cloud infrastructure, with security and testing built in as you go rather than bolted on at the end. Most weeks you'll be deep in one piece of the build: automating a lab workflow, wiring up a data pipeline, or getting an agentic prototype into decent shape, while staying close enough to the rest of the engagement to flag problems before they land on someone else's desk. As you get more experience, you'll be trusted with a bigger slice of the problem yourself, and eventually the whole thing. We care about software that scientists actually use. Less manual lab work, fewer errors, better data, medicines and vaccines moving faster through the pipeline. Why This Role Exists Labs & CMC is rebuilding how laboratory science and CMC work gets done, with automation, data and AI doing jobs scientists used to do by hand. Senior engineers typically lead and coordinate the relationship with the business side of that, working in close partnership with the wider team; this role exists to give them the extra hands to actually build what's agreed, while staying closely involved in how the work takes shape. You'll spend most of your time writing code, wiring up pipelines and getting things into production, picking up more ownership of the problem, and potentially of the stakeholder relationship itself, as you grow into the role and build a deeper understanding of what's needed. Turning direction into software: working with a Senior Forward Deployed DevSecOps Engineer to agree an approach, coordinating with stakeholders as needed, then building it properly rather than knocking together a demo. Keeping pace: most of what you'll build needs to land in days, not sprints, so you'll want to be comfortable shipping fast and adjusting as scientist feedback comes in. Automation that actually sticks: wiring up instruments, lab systems and data platforms so what you build is still running after the project wraps up. Getting the data right: pairing with data engineering so whatever you're building sits on data that's actually trustworthy. Production-ready by default: security, testing and monitoring go in as you build, not after something's already gone wrong. Leaving something behind: writing components and patterns that the next engineer, on this engagement or another one, can actually pick up and use. Key Responsibilities: Working the Problem Partner with Product Owners, Product Managers, Business Owners and scientists to understand laboratory and CMC workflows first-hand, clarify the required outcome and identify delivery, data, security or compliance risks early. Translate the agreed approach into a realistic technical plan, build rapid prototypes using representative laboratory data and incorporate scientist feedback before progressing the solution. Building and Shipping Design, code and test software, integrations, automation and data pipelines, taking ownership of day-to-day technical decisions within the agreed architecture. Develop successful prototypes into secure, reliable and supportable production solutions, confirming significant architectural decisions with a Senior Principal Forward Deployed DevSecOps Engineer or the relevant technical leader. Coordinate dependencies with internal, vendor and contract engineers, communicate delivery risks promptly and provide clear code, documentation and handover materials. Keeping It Secure and Reliable Build continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines that enable frequent, controlled and traceable releases. Implement unit, integration and end-to-end testing, together with dependency scanning, secrets management and least-privilege access. Apply relevant GxP, data-integrity, privacy and security requirements, documenting technical decisions and obtaining specialist guidance where needed. Establish production observability using appropriate logging, metrics and alerting tools, and connect solutions with ServiceNow processes to support operational readiness and incident management. Cloud Infrastructure Provision approved Azure or Google Cloud Platform infrastructure through the central Digital Platforms team, following established architecture, networking, identity, security and cost-management guardrails. Define infrastructure using Terraform and deploy applications using Kubernetes or Helm, applying appropriate settings for resilience, scaling and cost. Maintain consistency across development, test and production environments by managing configuration and infrastructure changes through automated pipelines. Contributing to Labs & CMC Solutions Build and extend workflows and integrations within laboratory orchestration platforms, enabling scientists to manage and track work through connected systems. Integrate laboratory instruments and systems to automate data capture and reduce manual entry. Develop AI agents and workflow automation that reduce repetitive scientific and operational tasks. Partner with data engineers to make laboratory, analytical and inventory data accessible and trustworthy for the solutions being developed. Build Generative AI capabilities that support activities such as experiment planning, information retrieval and scientific decision-making. Building With AI Use approved AI-assisted software-development tools and agent workflows, reviewing, testing and validating generated outputs before use. Reuse existing skills, prompts, components and Model Context Protocol connections, and contribute identified capability gaps to the wider team. Build AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines and Model Context Protocol integrations, seeking technical guidance for complex evaluation or data-access decisions. Apply appropriate guardrails, evaluation, traceability and human review to AI-enabled capabilities, particularly where scientific, regulated or GxP-relevant information is involved. Working Well With Others Escalate Responsible AI, data-integrity, security or validation concerns as soon as they are identified. Contribute reusable components, agents and engineering patterns to the Labs & CMC library, supported by documentation that enables adoption by other engineers. Support internal, vendor and contract engineering colleagues with technical problem-solving and knowledge sharing. Share delivery lessons, recurring risks and improvement opportunities with technical leaders so that they can inform broader engineering decisions. What You Bring Required Experience: 5+ years building software professionally, across full-stack, data or AI/ML work, including some time on systems that actually reached production, not just proofs of concept. Comfortable taking a reasonably well-defined problem and shipping working software against it quickly. Solid Python, plus at least one of TypeScript/JavaScript, Go or similar. Hands-on with GenAI patterns, including agents, RAG, prompt engineering and evaluation, not just familiar with the terms. Some experience with workflow orchestration tools (n8n, Airflow, Temporal) and working alongside data engineers. DevSecOps basics: CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, security scanning built into how you work rather than applied afterwards. Cloud experience on Azure or GCP, our preferred platforms, including provisioning with Terraform and deploying with Kubernetes or Helm. Comfortable setting up observability with Grafana, Prometheus or Elastic, and familiar with how ServiceNow fits into incident and change processes. Use AI coding tools such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot daily, not occasionally. Comfortable working closely with a more senior engineer on the shape of a problem, while owning how you build the solution yourself, and ready to take on more of that framing role as you gain experience. Comfortable working across time zones with a distributed team. Some exposure to regulated environments, so security, privacy and quality considerations aren't new territory. Preferred Experience: A background in pharma, biotech or life sciences. Instrument integration, robotics or closed-loop experimentation experience. Familiarity with GxP, computer system validation or data integrity requirements. Hybrid cloud experience. A previous stint as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Customer Engineer or Solutions Architect. Have worked alongside vendor or contract engineers on a shared piece of delivery. Contributed a pattern or component that someone else actually reused. Education Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Engineering or a related subject, or relevant industry experience. Skills Agile Methodology, API Management, CI/CD, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Containerization, Database Management, High Availability (Inactive), Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Microservices Architecture, Network Security, Operating Systems (OS), System Monitors, Version Control System Why GSK? Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale. People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
