jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - Flow
jobs.description: Company Description It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. Join us to put AI to work for people. Job Description About Flow by ServiceNow Flow is a product and a new business unit in ServiceNow staffed by a team of 0-1 builders. We’re creating Flow, an AI-native conversational experience for natural language automation and enterprise service management. Flow is built on a new tech stack with new ways of working. We challenge established practices and are defining a new product and GTM playbook for ServiceNow. Flow puts what we build in front of the largest possible audience. You’ll have real ownership of the work, the freedom to move fast, and the resources of a global technology leader behind you. If you have a point of view on building and want to start from the beginning again, we want to talk to you, wherever you are. Plenty of people can ship an AI prototype this year. Few get to build a product that runs enterprise work at global scale. Join us. Job Description We are hiring a hands-on Senior Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer who serves as the technical champion for customers, guiding them from their first demo and trial to long-term success with Flow. You will demonstrate the product, answer technical questions, set up and enable Flow, and help customers build automations and integrations through AI-assisted, natural-language development. You will solve problems the product does not yet handle and translate customer needs into clear requirements that help product managers prioritize what to build next. The role combines technical implementation, customer success, and support. Ready to be the person who turns “we’re stuck” into “we’re live”? We’re looking for a hybrid problem-solver who helps trial customers and enterprise IT teams unlock the full power of Flow. You will own complex customer problems end to end, and your work will shape what Flow does next. What You Will Do Technical Solutions Work with customer IT and security teams to configure SSO and integrations with tools such as Okta, Microsoft Teams, Slack, and ServiceNow. Build, test, and launch automations with Flow’s natural-language builder, connecting to tools such as Jira, Workday, Zoom, Microsoft 365, and ServiceNow. Connect document sources such as SharePoint, Google Drive, Box, Notion, and the ServiceNow knowledge base so the AI returns accurate, sourced answers. Solve complex customer requirements outside the standard product, document effective workarounds, and turn customer learnings into clear product requirements that you help refine and shepherd through delivery. Build proof-of-concept solutions and workflows for strategic evaluations. Customer Success and Adoption Guide new customers through a structured onboarding path, setting up and enabling Flow in a few hours so they can reach a live production deployment in one day. Monitor usage, conversation allowances, and automation results in Flow analytics, using the data to demonstrate value and identify new automation opportunities. Identify opportunities to expand Flow from an initial use case into a broader self-service service desk. Translate customer pain points and requests into clear product requirements, then partner with product and engineering to refine and shepherd them through delivery. Support and Reliability Own first-line triage for trial and enterprise customers, answering technical questions and escalating issues when deeper product or engineering support is needed. Be the go-to person when customers encounter API timeouts, sync errors, payment-related questions, or failed automations, and drive issues from initial diagnosis through resolution. Reproduce bugs, isolate root causes, and work directly with core engineers to resolve them. Monitor health, audit, and activity logs to identify outages or issues that prevent customers from using Flow fully. Use Flow audit and activity logs to diagnose complex customer issues, confirm what happened, and drive the issue to resolution. Qualifications 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role, such as forward deployed, solutions, or implementation engineering, in enterprise software. Hands-on experience with REST APIs, scripting, automations, and webhooks, with comfort testing them using tools such as Postman or cURL. Working knowledge of single sign-on and identity providers, including SAML, OAuth, Okta, and Entra ID. Experience with enterprise service management or collaboration tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, Slack, or Microsoft Teams. Familiarity with AI and workflow automation, including prompt design and how AI systems retrieve information from documents. Communicate clearly with stakeholders from IT directors to system administrators and security engineers. See how Flow fits into a customer’s broader IT and operations strategy and ServiceNow’s plans. Demonstrated ability to take ownership of customer outcomes while partnering effectively across product, engineering, support, and customer teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience with service desk offerings. Experience with AI-native or cloud-native enterprise products. Background in product-led growth or consumption-priced software. Experience building an onboarding or implementation motion from scratch; startup experience is helpful but not required. Additional Information Work Personas We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service. Equal Opportunity Employer ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements. Accommodations We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. As an FDE, you will operate at the intersection of AI consulting, solution architecture, rapid prototyping, and delivery advisory. You will work closely with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, platform teams, and engineering squads to transform opportunities into scalable AI solutions while balancing business value, technical feasibility, governance, and production readiness. The ideal candidate combines architectural depth, hands-on technical credibility, customer engagement skills, and a pragmatic delivery mindset. Candidate should be comfortable engaging with business leaders, challenging architectural decisions, building rapid prototypes, and guiding solutions from experimentation through last mile adoption. While hands-on implementation experience is important, success in this role is defined by the ability to rapidly validate business value, shape scalable solutions, and help customers move confidently from proof-of-value to enterprise adoption. Key Responsibilities AI Solution Architecture You will lead the design of enterprise grade AI solutions and guide customers through architecture decisions that align with their business and technology strategies. Key areas of focus may include: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Agentic AI solutions Multi-agent systems Enterprise knowledge platforms Conversational AI Intelligent automation Enterprise integration patterns AI reference architectures Responsibilities may include: Defining architecture blueprints and solution patterns. Evaluating trade-offs across models, frameworks, and platforms. Guiding enterprise architects and engineering teams through design decisions. Establishing scalable and reusable implementation approaches. Rapid Prototyping Solution Validation A core expectation of this role is the ability to validate business value quickly before significant delivery investment is made. You will: Conduct discovery workshops and use-case assessments. Evaluate the customer's existing technology landscape and approved toolset. Build prototypes using available enterprise platforms and AI capabilities. Develop Proofs of Concept (POCs) and Proofs of Value (POVs). Validate technical feasibility, business value, and adoption potential. Define implementation roadmaps for successful prototypes. Partner with engineering teams to industrialize and scale approved solutions. AI Governance Responsible AI You will help ensure AI solutions are designed and deployed responsibly within enterprise environments. Responsibilities include: Defining AI governance approaches and guardrails. Embedding Responsible AI principles into solution design. Aligning solutions with: Security requirements Compliance obligations Privacy standards Data governance policies AI risk management practices Supporting architecture assurance and governance reviews. Delivery Production Readiness While not a pure platform engineering role, the FDE must be capable of assessing whether solutions can successfully operate at enterprise scale. Expected areas of knowledge include: Production hardening AIOps (MLOps, LLMOps, AgentOps) Evaluation frameworks Observability and monitoring Reliability engineering Scalability planning Cost optimization You will: Challenge implementation approaches where necessary. Review solution readiness for production deployment. Provide architectural guidance on operational and support considerations. Help teams navigate the transition from prototype to production. Polycloud AI Platform Strategy Customers operate across diverse cloud and technology environments. The FDE should be able to provide platform neutral guidance while understanding the strengths and limitations of major AI ecosystems. Responsibilities include: Advising customers on platform and model selection. Evaluating deployment options based on business and technical requirements. Designing solutions that remain portable and adaptable. Supporting multi-cloud and cross-platform AI strategies. Cloud Expectations Candidates should demonstrate: Deep expertise in at least one major hyperscaler: Microsoft Azure Amazon Web Services (AWS) Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Working knowledge of multi-cloud architectures and AI platform capabilities. Understanding of cloud native AI services, enterprise data platforms, and modern integration patterns. Consulting Client Advisory The FDE acts as a trusted advisor throughout the customer AI journey. Responsibilities include: Facilitating business and technology discovery workshops. Assessing current-state technical and functional ecosystems. Identifying and prioritizing AI opportunities. Developing business cases and value realization approaches. Creating transformation roadmaps and implementation plans. Presenting recommendations to technical and executive stakeholders. Building trusted relationships with customer leadership teams. Serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout the customer AI adoption journey. Facilitate discussions across business stakeholders, architects, platform teams, and engineering leadership. Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Solution Architecture, Technology Consulting, AI Engineering, Customer Engineering, or related disciplines. Experience in designing and delivering enterprise technology solutions. Strong understanding of Generative AI, Agentic AI, and modern AI architectures. Experience with RAG, agents, multi-agent systems, and enterprise integration patterns. Familiarity with AI governance, security, compliance, and Responsible AI principles. Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills. Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders. Ability to balance business value, technical feasibility, governance requirements, and delivery constraints when shaping AI solutions. Preferred Experience Experience with one or more of the following is desirable: Agent development and orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI) Azure AI Services/Foundry AWS Bedrock Vertex AI Databricks Snowflake Copilot Studio Power Platform Enterprise search and knowledge management platforms ProCode and NoCode development approaches What Success Looks Like A successful FDE will: Identify high-value AI opportunities for customers. Rapidly validate ideas using prototypes and experiments. Design scalable and governable AI solutions. Influence architectural and implementation decisions. Build credibility with both business and technical stakeholders. Help delivery teams scale successful solutions into production. Drive measurable customer outcomes and adoption. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - AI
jobs.description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role About the Role At Kyndryl, we deploy AI innovation where it creates the greatest real-world impact. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will collaborate directly with customers to solve complex challenges, shaping solutions that redefine industries. You will be empowered to work at speed, supported by a global AI ecosystem, and play a pivotal role in delivering outcomes that matter. This position operates within our triad delivery model, where engineering, consulting, and product expertise come together to drive transformative results for customers. This is not traditional consulting or pure software engineering; it is a hybrid role designed for the complexities of real-world AI deployment, with accountability for outcomes not just code. You will blend deep engineering expertise with consultative engagement to deliver tailored solutions that drive measurable business value. Operating in dynamic environments and working closely with customer teams - often on-site - you will scope, prototype, and deploy solutions at pace. Technologies include Generative AI, Agentic AI architectures, and multi-agent ecosystems, with insights continually fed back into Kyndryl’s platforms and frameworks to accelerate future deployments. If you are motivated by solving complex problems, excel in direct customer engagement, and aspire to shape the future of enterprise AI, this role is designed for you. Key Responsibilities 1. Customer Engagement & Solution Integrity: Partner with customers to understand business challenges and translate them into high‑quality, fit‑for‑purpose technical solutions, prioritising the right outcome over the fastest one. 2. Rapid Prototyping: Build and iterate custom AI solutions tailored to customer needs, leveraging agentic AI frameworks. 3. Ownership, Deployment & Partnership: Own delivery end to end, from scoping to production. Working as part of the customer team to engineer and deploy production‑ready solutions that drive adoption and measurable business outcomes. 4. Optimisation: Troubleshoot and enhance system performance, scalability, and reliability. 5. Field Intelligence: Systematically capture deployment learnings, document best practices, and proactively share insights to inform enhancements to Kyndryl’s core platforms and frameworks. 6. Continuous Learning: Adapt quickly to emerging technologies and evolving customer requirements by engaging in ongoing professional development. 7. Platform Contribution: Actively contribute to the evolution of Kyndryl’s AI platforms through feedback, code contributions, and collaboration with product teams. Your Future at Kyndryl Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Skills & Experience 3-6 years of relevant IT experience in which at least 1 years of working experience in Agentic AI Frameworks, Orchestration, Deployment and 2 years on GenAI solutions Programming Proficiency: Demonstrable expertise in Python; experience working with AI/ML frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch is a plus. Open-Source Ecosystems: Familiarity with community-driven AI tools and libraries, including Hugging Face and relevant repositories. T-shaped Profile: Deep technical expertise in one or two domains, with broad understanding across AI/ML, cloud, and consulting. Agentic AI Systems: Experience designing, building, or integrating multi-agent systems and orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Agent Framework, AutoGen, CrewAI), including the development of agent protocols and coordination mechanisms. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) & Knowledge Systems: Practical knowledge of deploying RAG architectures and integrating structured and unstructured knowledge sources into AI solutions. Software Engineering: Solid grasp of the software delivery lifecycle, version control (Git & GitHub), and data engineering tools such as Pandas and Spark. Cloud & Distributed Systems: Experience with cloud AI platforms (AWS, Azure, Google AI) and distributed computing architectures. Performance & Security: Knowledge of system-level optimisation and security best practices for scalable AI systems. Business Acumen: Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and communicate technical value to diverse stakeholders, including executive audiences. Flexibility: Willingness to travel and work on customer premises as required. Education: Degree-level qualification in Computer Science, Informatics, Data Science, Engineering, or a closely related discipline - or equivalent professional experience. Preferred Experience : Experience in Observability and evaluation platforms – e.g. Langsmith Why join us? You will become part of a team that values pace, autonomy, and tangible impact. At Kyndryl, you will have full visibility of the delivery lifecycle, with opportunities to lead engagements and shape strategic direction. Our triad delivery model means you will work alongside experts in engineering, product, and consulting, fostering continuous learning and innovation. Career progression is clearly defined, from Junior to Principal levels, with pathways to influence the evolution of our AI platforms. You will contribute directly to platform development and see the results of your work in real-world applications. If you are seeking an environment where your ideas are valued and execution drives results, this is the place to make a difference. If you want to work where innovation meets execution, apply now. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Experience reviewing designs and code in Python, PySpark and SQL. Experience designing platforms built on Data Cloud services (e.g. BigQuery, Managed Spark/Lightning Engine, Apache Iceberg (e.g., Borderless Lakehouse), Spanner, AlloyDB, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Kafka). Experience building agentic AI systems on enterprise data (e.g., agents, retrieval, vector search, evaluation). We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours. jobs.title: Associate, AI Data Scientist- Private Markets
jobs.description: Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka Team: Data Science Job Requisition #: R264031 Date posted: Nov. 02, 2026 Job description About this role Build efficient, trusted agentic AI for private-markets intelligence Research, build and scale advanced agentic systems and fit-for-purpose language models that turn complex information into dependable data, research and decision intelligence. Your team You will join a multidisciplinary AI and data science team focused on applying advanced AI to high-value challenges in private markets. The team brings together data science, engineering, product and domain expertise, and works closely with users to develop practical capabilities that improve how information is acquired, researched and managed. You will work in an environment where applied research is expected to become dependable production capability. We value intellectual curiosity, rigorous experimentation, strong engineering and responsible AI, with quality, security and appropriate human oversight designed in from the start. Your role & impact As an Associate, AI Data Scientist, you will be a hands-on technical contributor responsible for researching, building and scaling enterprise-grade agentic AI capabilities. Working directly with users and senior technical leaders, you will translate complex private-markets workflows into well-evaluated systems that move from experimentation to governed production and sustained adoption. Your core mandate is to advance multi-agent LLM systems through effective agent design patterns, rigorous evaluation and disciplined model engineering. You will develop workflows that plan, retrieve, reason, use tools, verify and escalate appropriately, while selecting the simplest architecture and model that can meet the required quality, latency, cost and control objectives. You will also help establish the lifecycle for open-source small language models and LLMs, from model discovery and benchmarking through training, adaptation, fine-tuning, deployment, monitoring and retirement. Your impact will be visible in stronger data quality, faster research, scalable automation and reusable AI capabilities that help BlackRock Preqin remain at the forefront of private-markets data and technology. Your responsibilities Work forward-deployed with researchers, data specialists and product teams to understand workflows, frame ambiguous problems, define measurable outcomes and iterate rapidly from evidence to production. Research, design and deliver agentic workflows spanning planning, retrieval, tool use, structured extraction, reasoning, verification, exception handling and human escalation, using single-agent or multi-agent patterns where each is demonstrably appropriate. Engineer advanced agent patterns, including bounded iterative loops, reflection and critique, planner-executor and evaluator-optimizer patterns, with explicit stop conditions, budgets and safeguards that prevent unproductive or uncontrolled execution. Build agent and model harnesses that standardise tool interfaces, context assembly, state and memory handling, policy enforcement, tracing, replay and failure recovery. Determine when an agentic architecture, retrieval workflow, specialised model or deterministic service is the best fit, and validate the decision against representative tasks and simpler baselines. Design safe caching and reuse across retrieval, prompts, model responses, tool results and intermediate agent state, with clear cache keys, invalidation, freshness, access-control and provenance requirements. Build systematic evaluation harnesses using representative datasets, explicit quality dimensions, adversarial and edge-case testing, regression suites, human feedback and monitored production outcomes. Research and benchmark open-source SLMs and LLMs for task fit, considering quality, inference performance, cost, licensing, security, deployment constraints and operational supportability; apply fit-for-purpose routing and batching where they improve efficiency. Develop model-adaptation strategies using prompt and context optimisation, supervised fine-tuning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning or other suitable techniques, supported by governed dataset creation, experiment tracking, reproducibility and controlled promotion criteria. Operate the lifecycle for trained and fine-tuned open-source models, including data and model versioning, lineage, experiment and artifact management, evaluation gates, registry and release controls, deployment, performance and drift monitoring, rollback, retraining triggers and retirement. Build production-quality Python components that integrate models with enterprise data, retrieval services, APIs, workflow orchestration and human-review experiences. Improve grounding and trust through attribution, provenance, uncertainty handling, validation checks, access controls and clear separation of source evidence from model-generated conclusions. Own delivered reliability across testing, observability, latency, cost and maintainability, and diagnose model, data, prompt and orchestration failures in production. Document findings, reusable patterns and trade-offs; contribute to design reviews; and communicate results clearly to research, product, engineering, risk and senior stakeholders. Partner with engineering, product, risk, privacy, information security, legal and compliance colleagues to support responsible, secure and accountable use of AI. Required experience We are looking for a hands-on applied AI practitioner who combines strong research and modelling skills with production judgment and user-focused problem solving. You should bring: Strong experience building and deploying AI or machine-learning systems in an enterprise, SaaS, data-product or similarly complex environment, with evidence of taking work beyond prototypes. Practical depth in LLM applications and agentic systems, including retrieval, tool use, planning, orchestration, memory or state management, structured outputs, verification and evaluation of non-deterministic behaviour. Experience implementing and comparing bounded loops, reflection or critique, planner-executor and evaluator-optimizer patterns against simpler baselines, with measurable treatment of quality, reliability, latency, token usage, cost and failure modes. Experience building agent or model harnesses across tool interfaces, context and state management, orchestration, policy enforcement, testing, tracing, replay, deployment and observability. Hands-on experience evaluating, selecting, training or adapting open-source SLMs or LLMs, including benchmarking, governed dataset preparation, supervised or parameter-efficient fine-tuning and inference optimisation. Practical ModelOps experience for trained or fine-tuned models, including dataset and model lineage, experiment and artifact tracking, registries, evaluation gates, controlled release, performance and drift monitoring, rollback, retraining and retirement. Experience designing model routing, batching and safe caching with appropriate keying, invalidation, freshness, privacy, access-control and provenance safeguards. Strong grounding in modern machine learning, experimentation and statistical evaluation, with disciplined handling of train-test separation, leakage, uncertainty, reproducibility and model comparison. Ability to write production-quality Python and work effectively across data preparation, model development, APIs, orchestration, testing, deployment and observability. Experience with unstructured or multimodal information, semantic retrieval, provenance and data-quality engineering in workflows where domain experts provide ground truth and structured feedback. Experience working directly with users or domain specialists to turn ambiguous needs into usable capabilities and iterate based on observed workflow outcomes. Sound judgment on model and architecture trade-offs across efficacy, efficiency, security, licensing, maintainability and operational risk. Clear communication and collaborative delivery skills, with the ability to explain experiments, limitations and production trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences. Understanding of private markets, alternative investments, financial data or adjacent institutional-investment workflows is desirable; curiosity and the ability to build domain depth quickly are essential. Commitment to responsible AI, data provenance, privacy, security and meaningful human control in high-trust enterprise workflows. jobs.description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. Additionally, you will conduct code reviews, enforce security, quality, and coding standards, build and manage CI/CD pipelines, package and deploy applications using Docker and Kubernetes, support cloud deployment and operational readiness on AWS, troubleshoot automated deployment processes, and collaborate closely with architects, platform engineers, QA teams, and modernization specialists. Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Modern Engineering: Proficiency in Java (Java 11+ preferred), Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices architecture, SQL, Git, and Maven/Gradle. Cloud & Containers: Hands-on experience with AWS services, Docker, Kubernetes, cloud-native application development, and distributed systems. Pattern Transformation: Proven ability in legacy-to-modern application transformation, including COBOL-to-Java, CICS-to-API, JCL-to-Spring Batch, and DB2/VSAM patterns. AI-Assisted Engineering: Experience with AI-generated code remediation, optimization, and automated test generation/remediation. Testing & DevOps: Proficiency in automated unit testing (JUnit, Mockito), code reviews, troubleshooting, and managing CI/CD deployment pipelines. Preferred Qualifications: Experience in large-scale mainframe modernization or migration programs. Hands-on experience with AI-assisted software engineering and code transformation frameworks. Experience modernizing mission-critical banking, insurance, retail, transportation, or government applications. Knowledge of event-driven architectures and cloud-native design patterns. AWS certifications or cloud modernization certifications are a plus. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. jobs.title: Senior / Lead Platform Forward Deployed Engineer - Cogentiq I2C
jobs.description: It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing! We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business. About Cogentiq I2C Cogentiq I2C is Fractal's agentic AI platform for invoice-to-cash operations, spanning Collections, Cash Application, Deductions, Credit Risk, and Invoice Management. The platform runs on a four-tier architecture: a Next.js application layer, FastAPI services, the Cogentiq APA agentic orchestration layer, and a data estate built on Azure Databricks and PostgreSQL. Deployments land in client Azure tenancies against live ERP data (Dynamics 365, SAP), which means deployment engineering is a first-class discipline, not an afterthought to development. Why this role, now The platform has crossed from being built to being deployed. Collections is entering pilot with enterprise clients, and the deployment machinery is real: Databricks Asset Bundles with one-click, script-based deployment; auto-loader ingestion running historical and incremental loads into a common data model; versioned bundles and wheel-file packages delivered through Git and Azure Artifactory; and a quick-start standard under which a newcomer must be able to stand up the full data platform by running one setup script. This role carries that machinery into client environments and makes it hold under client governance, client data, and client timelines. It owns everything between our release artefacts and a running, observable, correctly governed installation; candidates who want to work on agent behaviour and LLM integration should apply to the AI FDE track instead. What you will do Own the deployment architecture of client installations from environment readiness through hypercare: bundle strategy, environment topology (Dev, QA, production; per-client catalogs), release sequencing, and sign-off that the installation meets the validation standard. Navigate Unity Catalog and platform governance Client and internal IT control catalog and metastore provisioning, storage decisions, and access models. You will assess what their governance model means for our setup scripts, negotiate provisioning paths, and know when a shared-infrastructure convenience creates an SOW, NDA, or data-isolation problem that must be escalated rather than worked around. Set and enforce the platform engineering standards: idempotent, rerunnable deployments; fail-fast error handling with no silent except-and-continue paths; environment-variable-driven parameterisation with a single point of change per client value; and configuration conventions that hold across Databricks today and Fabric tomorrow. Own the shared utilities architecture: interface-function contracts and factory-pattern abstractions across Databricks, Fabric, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and storage back ends, packaged as versioned wheel files through Azure Artifactory, so swapping a client's platform is a configuration change, not a rewrite. Make the hard ingestion calls: auto-loader versus custom conflict-driven ingestion when the client will not provision Databricks, checkpoint and reprocessing strategy, retry and alerting design per pipeline, and writeback reliability to the application database. Run incident command during deployment and hypercare. When a deployment breaks in a client environment, you run the incident: triage across the data estate, the application database, and upstream ERP feeds; communicate honestly with the client; and land the fix and the post-incident correction to the playbook. Own the deployment playbook as a product. The quick-start guides, validation suites, and synthetic data configurations you leave behind must make the next deployment cheaper. The bar is that a newcomer deploys the platform from your playbook with one setup script. Coach junior Platform FDEs, reviewing their work against the standards you set and growing them toward deployment ownership. What You need 6 or more years in data platform or deployment engineering, with at least two years deploying into environments you did not control (client tenancies, regulated environments, or equivalent). Deep Azure Databricks: Asset Bundles, workflows, Unity Catalog and metastore governance, cluster and library management, service-principal automation, and the CLI. Strong Python and SQL, with the judgement to review pipeline code for idempotency, failure behaviour, and configuration hygiene, not just correctness. PostgreSQL in production: schema evolution, write reliability, connection behaviour under load. CI/CD for data platforms: Git-based release flows, semantic versioning, artefact repositories, and backward compatibility across component versions. Domain literacy in order-to-cash and accounts receivable data: invoices, receipts, remittances, customer masters, and ERP AR structures in Dynamics 365 or SAP. You cannot validate a deployment whose data you do not understand. Client-facing composure: you will be the technical face of the deployment to client IT and finance stakeholders. Nice to have: Microsoft Fabric, observability design (OpenTelemetry, Application Insights), and experience taking a data product through pilots at multiple clients in parallel. Success in the first year Two client deployments taken from environment readiness through hypercare, each validated against the standard suite and signed off on schedule. A deployment playbook that demonstrably reduced the cost of the deployment that followed it, measured in elapsed time from access granted to validated installation. Platform standards (idempotency, fail-fast, parameterisation) adopted across the data engineering codebase, evidenced in review practice, not just documentation. At least one governance or infrastructure negotiation with client IT resolved without escalation to leadership. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Applied Research in Robotics
jobs.description: As the world’s leading accelerated computing company, NVIDIA is paving the way in robotics, self-driving cars, machine learning, supercomputing, and visualization. We are building a team that will help define the next generation of robotics acceleration across NVIDIA platforms, and we would love for you to join us. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer - Applied Research in Robotics to research, prototype, and optimize robotics solutions that use NVIDIA’s Programmable Vision Accelerator (PVA), a power-efficient, deterministic VLIW/SIMD processor used across NVIDIA DRIVE, Jetson, and IGX platforms. In this role, you will identify high-impact robotics workloads and map them to efficient execution on the NVIDIA’s Programmable Vision Accelerator, or PVA. You will work at the intersection of robotics systems, sensor and actuator processing, heterogeneous computing, and algorithm optimization. Your work will help improve latency, determinism, power efficiency, and throughput for real-time robotics systems. What You’ll Be Doing: Research and analyze end-to-end robotics software stacks to discover, characterize, and prioritize high-impact workloads that can be accelerated on PVA. Design, implement, test, and optimize PVA operators for robotics workloads, including end-to-end integration into real robotics pipelines. Research parallelization and data movement strategies for mapping robotics algorithms onto PVA efficiently! Work across camera, RADAR, LiDAR, IMU, perception, planning, and actuator paths to understand algorithmic requirements, memory behavior, timing constraints, and real-time execution needs. Build benchmarks, validation infrastructure, and technical mentorship for robotics teams adopting PVA acceleration! Collaborate with robotics, hardware architecture, compiler, system software, sensor, and platform teams to define acceleration strategies and interfaces. Support internal and external teams developing and optimizing robotics algorithms on PVA. Leverage modern AI-assisted development tools and agentic workflows to accelerate workload analysis, algorithm creation, benchmarking, and performance exploration. Write high-quality, maintainable C/C++ code, performance tests, user documentation, and validation infrastructure for robotics acceleration workflows. What We Need To See: BS/MS or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience. 5+ years of experience in robotics software, embedded systems, accelerated computing, computer vision, sensor processing, perception systems, or related areas. Strong robotics algorithm knowledge, with practical understanding of perception, sensor fusion, control, planning, or actuator pipelines. Strong C/C++ programming skills, including low-level debugging, performance profiling, optimization, and production-quality software development. Experience analyzing algorithms and mapping workloads to heterogeneous hardware such as CPUs, GPUs, DSPs, SIMD/VLIW processors, or domain-specific accelerators. Deep understanding of embedded systems, SoC architecture, memory hierarchy, cache behavior, DMA, real-time scheduling, and performance bottlenecks. Experience with embedded Linux and/or QNX development environments. Experience with robotics middleware, ROS 2, real robot bring-up, sensor integration, or actuator/control paths. Strong communication, collaboration, analytical, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced multi-functional environment. Ways To Stand Out from the crowd: Background with NVIDIA Jetson, DRIVE, IGX, ISSAC, VPI, NvMedia, or PVA. Experience building robotics applications that use CUDA or other accelerators for perception, planning, simulation, or real-time sensor processing. Familiarity with safety-conscious development processes such as ISO 26262, IEC 61508, or similar standards. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you. NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is looking for extraordinary people like you to help us accelerate the next wave of artificial intelligence.

jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer
jobs.description: About Us As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful. Overview about TII At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy. And that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from different backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations. Pyramid Overview A role with Target Data Science & Engineering means the chance to help develop and manage state of the art predictive algorithms that use data at scale to automate and optimize decisions at scale. Whether you join our Statistics, Optimization or Machine Learning teams, you’ll be challenged to harness Target’s impressive data breadth to build the algorithms that power solutions our partners in Marketing, Supply Chain Optimization, Network Security and Personalization rely on. Team Overview Target’s Advanced AI team builds end-to-end AI/ML systems that create meaningful business value across the enterprise. These systems may be powered by LLMs, classical machine learning, or deep learning models, and are designed as scalable, reliable, production-grade applications, including agentic architectures where they add clear value. Role Overview As a Lead AI Engineer for Advanced AI, you will help design, build, deploy, and maintain AI/ML applications that support automation, insight, and action across core business workflows. You will work closely with Data Scientists, engineers, product partners, platform teams, security teams, and business stakeholders to turn ambiguous business problems into practical, scalable technical solutions. In this role, you will provide hands-on technical leadership for AI engineering initiatives. You will contribute to architecture and design decisions, evaluate appropriate models, frameworks, and tools, write maintainable production-quality code, and help establish strong engineering practices across development, testing, deployment, observability, documentation, and ongoing support. You will help ensure AI applications are secure, reliable, maintainable, and aligned to Target’s enterprise standards for infrastructure, platform architecture, data handling, and operational readiness. You will also partner with senior engineers and engineering leaders to shape technical approaches, identify implementation risks, resolve roadblocks, and support the evolution of reusable AI engineering patterns. This role requires curiosity and continuous learning, including staying current with developments in AI, machine learning, LLMs, agentic systems, and modern software engineering practices. A successful Lead AI Engineer will help deliver production-grade AI applications that create measurable business value while raising the technical quality and capability of the broader team. Core responsibilities of this job are articulated within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs. About You 4-year degree in Quantitative disciplines (Science, Tech, Engineering, Mathematics) or equivalent industry experience required; MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics or a related technical field preferred. 6+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including experience building and operating production systems. Strong experience developing AI/ML applications, including LLM-powered applications, agentic systems, applied machine learning solutions, data-intensive applications, or intelligent automation capabilities. Strong proficiency with Python and experience with modern AI/ML or deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar tools. Experience working with model APIs, prompt orchestration, agent development patterns, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation frameworks, observability tools, cloud ML platforms, containers, or orchestration technologies. Strong understanding of system design, application architecture, model and framework tradeoffs, experimentation, evaluation strategy, performance optimization, and production deployment considerations for AI systems. Experience building scalable, maintainable, and well-tested services, APIs, data pipelines, applications, or platforms. Experience with version control, CI/CD, code review practices, documentation, operational monitoring, and production support. jobs.title: Cyber Security and Applied AI Engineering Analyst, Chrome Platform Security
jobs.description: Minimum qualifications: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 5 years of experience in data analysis, including identifying trends, generating summary statistics, and drawing insights from quantitative and qualitative data. 5 years of experience managing projects and defining project scope, goals, and deliverables. Preferred qualifications: Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a quantitative discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research etc.). Proven experience or strong foundational knowledge in broader cybersecurity principles and practices. Familiarity with the development lifecycle and security considerations specific to browser extensions or similar technologies. Working knowledge in one or more of the following areas: cyber security, threat intelligence, statistical analysis and machine learning libraries (e.g., R), programming languages (e.g., Python), Large Language Models (LLMs) or applied AI. Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills with attention to detail in an ever-changing environment. About the job Trust & Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety. Trust and Safety has the critical responsibility of protecting Google's users by ensuring online safety fighting fraud and abuse across Google products. We collaborate with anti-abuse teams across the company to identify and resolve the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. More specifically, in the Trust and Safety Chrome Web Store and Extensions Security team, we are responsible for protecting users from harmful extensions, while enabling developers to provide useful and safe experiences in Chrome. As a Security and Applied AI Engineering Analyst, you will apply large-scale data analysis to protect Chrome users from abuse, discover and interpret attack vectors and leverage AI to build scaled protections to keep users safe. You will collaborate closely with Engineering and Product partners to identify threats, mitigate risks, and launch new protection mechanisms. At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust & Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. A team of Analysts, Policy Specialists, Engineers, and Program Managers, we work to reduce risk and fight abuse across all of Google’s products, protecting our users, advertisers, and publishers across the globe in over 40 languages. Responsibilities Conduct investigations through reverse engineering, enforce our product policies, learn abuse patterns, and establish ground truth data to train automated systems. Identify vulnerabilities and performance gaps in automated and manual review pipelines. Design AI-powered and automated solutions that enable scalable identification of malware, and other harmful techniques. Collaborate with other teams to develop and deploy new detection methods and signals. Understand the abuse landscape and techniques. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Applied AI Platforms Engineer II - SAP Fiori + ABAP
jobs.description: Applied AI Platform Engineer II - SAP Fiori + ABAP Role Overview: As an Applied AI Platform Engineer II , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to building the platforms, tooling, accelerators, and frameworks that other engineering teams build on. Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering platform capabilities that delight the engineers who depend on them, while driving tangible leverage and value across Deloitte’s AI engineering investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship across platform engineering, distributed systems, and modern AI/ML and Data infrastructure, consistently demonstrating your strong track record in delivering high-quality, reusable, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, build, and operate the enabling layer for AI engineering at scale. Key Responsibilities: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for engineering-leverage and adoption outcomes. Build platform capabilities that solve recurring problems once, well, for many teams—reducing per-team build and operate toil while ensuring consistency and compliance by default through high-quality, lean designs and implementations. Serve as the technical advocate for the platform as a product, ensuring capability integrity, feasibility, and alignment with the needs of the engineering teams who consume it. Lead requirement discovery with consuming teams, component design of platform services, frameworks, and the AI control plane, and their development, testing, integration, and support. Maintain accountability for the integrity of the platform architecture and for the enterprise tech-stack conformance baseline that engineering teams build against. Manage platform dependencies, code design, implementation, the data and policy-as-code enforcement layers, and the OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation substrate—building capabilities that are operable, instrumented, performant, and drift-resistant by design, to the production standards set by SRE. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, codify recurring patterns into reusable components and golden paths, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code to ensure all platform KPIs (adoption, reliability-by-design, and developer experience) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams. Develop lean platform capabilities through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve the real needs of consuming engineering teams. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right capability is delivered at the right time—and adopted, not shelved. Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering platform capabilities as lean, adoption-validated increments rather than big-bang builds, and keeping them supportable and maintainable. Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, SRE, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Integrate their constraints into the paved roads so that the secure, compliant, and reliable path is the easy path. Deliver capabilities that are admissible-by-design and submit them for admission, co-defining service-level objectives with SRE, who set production standards and own the admission decision. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation. Possess expertise in platform engineering and modern AI/ML infrastructure—internal developer platforms, MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure, eval and observability tooling, policy-as-code, container orchestration, IaC, and CI/CD at platform scale—including AI and Agentic SSDLC to deliver self-service, governed capabilities with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize platform solutioning and delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning. Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the enterprise data estate and the AI use-case patterns the platform must serve. Translate the needs of engineering teams, reference architectures, and governance requirements into reusable frameworks, the data platform, and governance-as-code enforcement. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff. Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives. Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions. jobs.title: Enterprise Solutions AI Applied Engineer
jobs.description: Job description Company and benefits Job ID ENTER020582 Employment Type Regular Work Style on-site Location Bangalore,INKA,India Travel Up to 25% Role Enterprise Solutions AI Applied Engineer Why UKG: At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do. We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you. Core Mission The Enterprise Applied AI Solution Specialist is a hands-on engineer who builds and deploys practical AI solutions that improve internal workflows and employee productivity. The role focuses on implementing agentic and Generative AI features using established patterns, grounded in enterprise knowledge and data. This individual partners closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into usable, reliable capabilities while operating within enterprise constraints such as security, governance, and user trust. The position is ideal for a builder who ships, iterates quickly, and continuously improves solution quality through feedback and measurement. Key Responsibilities This is a delivery-focused role combining hands-on implementation with light product ownership and operational discipline. 1. Applied Solution Delivery & Iteration (65% of time) Build and enhance AI-powered features (e.g., copilots, summarization, classification, routing, Q&A) aligned to defined business workflows. Partner with business users to clarify requirements, run demos, capture feedback, and iterate toward measurable outcomes. Support pilot launches, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to smooth adoption through user training and clear documentation. 2. Knowledge-Based Agents & Conversational Design (25% of time) Develop agents grounded in the company’s internal knowledge base, using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns and retrieval quality improvements. Design conversational flows for internal functions (e.g., HR helpdesk), including intent handling, escalation paths, and handoff to human support when needed. Implement simple agentic or predictive models for operational use cases (e.g., predicting customer support ticket volume) under guidance from senior engineers. 3. Product Execution, Quality & Documentation (10% of time) Manage the feature backlog for an AI product area: write user stories, define acceptance criteria, and coordinate UAT. Contribute to evaluation and regression testing using approved checklists; help monitor quality, latency, and cost for deployed features. Create and maintain documentation (how-to guides, runbooks, and user enablement materials) to support long-term sustainability. Required Qualifications 3+ years of experience in software engineering or applied solutions development (or equivalent practical experience). Proficiency in Python and API-based integration; working knowledge of SQL and data access patterns. Working familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Exposure to agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar) and the ability to implement tool/function calling patterns. Basic understanding of enterprise security, privacy, and data governance requirements; ability to follow established guardrails and escalate risks early. Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Ideal Candidate Profile: Who Thrives in This Role Builders Over Theorists: You enjoy shipping working software and iterating based on user feedback. User-Centered Mindset: You like sitting with users, mapping workflows, and improving day-to-day productivity. Pragmatic Technologist: You choose simple, reliable approaches and adopt new techniques when they clearly improve outcomes. Quality-Driven: You care about correctness, safety, and operational reliability, and you follow established production standards. Continuous Learner: You stay current on rapidly evolving GenAI capabilities and apply them responsibly. Generous Collaborator: You document clearly, communicate proactively, and work well across teams. Company Overview: UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry — because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. Learn more at ukg.com. UKG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion in the workplace, including the recruitment process. We are a group of researchers, applied scientists, engineers, and product managers with a dual mission. We are expanding our group and seeking highly skilled individuals who will be responsible for contributing to the team (or teams) of Machine Learning (ML) and Software Engineers that are bringing innovative solutions to AI-driven customer-facing products. At Bloomberg, we believe in fostering a transparent and efficient financial marketplace. Our business is built on technology that makes news, research, financial data, and analytics on over 35 million financial instruments searchable, discoverable, and actionable across the global capital markets. Bloomberg has been building Artificial Intelligence applications that offer solutions to these problems with high accuracy and low latency since 2009. We build AI systems to help process and organize the ever-increasing volume of structured and unstructured information needed to make informed decisions. Our use of AI uncovers signals, helps us produce analytics about financial instruments in all asset classes, and delivers clarity when our clients need it most. We are looking for Senior Applied AI Engineers with a strong expertise and passion for Large Language Modeling research and applications to join our team. The advent of large language models (LLMs) presents new opportunities for expanding our NLP capabilities with new products. This would allow our clients to ask complex questions in natural language and receive insights extracted across our vast number of Bloomberg APIs or from potentially millions of structured and unstructured information sources. Broad areas of applications and interest include: application and fine-tuning methods for LLMs, efficient methods for training, multimodal models, learning from feedback and human preferences, retrieval-augmented generation, summarization, semantic parsing and tool use, domain adaptation of LLMs to financial domains, dialogue interfaces, evaluation of LLMs, model safety and responsible AI. Optimize accuracy / performance tradeoffs, to retain achieve but speed execution of algorithm modules Analyze large quantities of sensor and metrology data, and iteratively improve simulation and models to improve accuracy Implement models and code for user facing applications, in control systems or dashboards Maintain a clean and consistent code base, that can be extended by team Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate possesses a strong foundation in theoretical and computational disciplines, coupled with practical software development expertise. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, DSP Tech
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Do you want to be part of the team that transforms how safety decisions are made for Amazon's Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) across 21 countries? Are you passionate about building intelligent, data driven platforms that protect delivery associates every single day? DSP SafetyTech is a newly formed team serving as the intelligence layer between safety signals and decisions — interpreting what happened, routing it to who can act, and ensuring no safety event goes unresolved. Today, safety data is fragmented across seven systems with no single technical owner, causing attribution errors, reconciliation gaps, and duplicated logic. We're changing that. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help build a governed safety intelligence platform. You will contribute to three critical pillars: Safety Data as a Service (SDaaS), a governed serving layer consolidating telematics, incidents, and contextual enrichment; DSP Facing Mechanisms, a unified configuration layer managing compound signals and business rules across DSP facing surfaces; and Advanced Analytics and Agentic Capabilities, predictive models and AI agents that provide actionable safety insights. This is a rare opportunity to join a team building a platform from the ground up that will directly impact the safety of delivery associates worldwide. Key job responsibilities Design, develop, test, and deploy software components for a governed data serving platform that consolidates telematics, incident reports, video evidence, and contextual enrichment from multiple upstream systems Build and maintain backend services and APIs that support a unified configuration layer where safety business rules are authored, validated, versioned, and distributed Develop frontend components for a consolidated safety dashboard, a single view where signals, scorecard outcomes, alerts, event video, and interventions come together • Implement compound safety signals that combine individual data sources into higher order, actionable safety indicators • Write clean, maintainable, and well tested code following software engineering best practices Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and operational excellence activities Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to integrate data pipelines and model outputs into production services Contribute to automated evidence preservation mechanisms to address short video retention windows Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, participating in on call rotations to ensure system reliability Work with cross functional teams including product managers, stakeholders across investigations, claims, insurance, and accountability to understand requirements and deliver solutions A day in the life You will be part of a team building the safety intelligence backbone for Amazon's DSP ecosystem. Your day may involve writing and reviewing code for backend services, building frontend features for the safety dashboard, discussing design approaches with your team, or debugging a production issue. You will collaborate closely with data engineers and data scientists to bring data driven capabilities to life. You'll participate in sprint planning, stand ups, and retrospectives, contributing ideas to improve both the product and the development process. You will have the opportunity to learn and grow across the full stack, from data pipelines to user facing experiences, while working on a platform that scales across multiple countries. About the team DSP Safety Tech is a newly established team with a clear mission: convert every safety event into a clear, trusted action for every DSP, in every market, every time. Our North Star is ensuring every safety signal reaches the people who can act on it, with the context needed to make timely decisions, so risks are identified earlier, decisions are made consistently, and every Delivery Associate goes home safely. We operate at the intersection of data engineering, applied science, and product development, serving stakeholders from investigators to insurance to DSP owners themselves. We're building from the ground up with a strong vision, executive sponsorship, and the freedom to innovate across the full stack, from governed data pipelines to AI powered agentic experiences. jobs.description: Req ID: 142335 Remote Position: Hybrid Region: Asia Country: India State/Province: Chennai City: Guindy, Chennai Summary We are seeking a senior technical leader for the role of Infrastructure Automation Manager to direct and execute our enterprise-wide end-to-end automation strategy. This role bridges traditional on-premises data centers, private cloud hypervisors, container platforms, and public cloud environments into a unified, code-driven delivery ecosystem. With 12 to 15 years of industry experience, you will manage a specialized team of automation, infrastructure, and network reliability engineers. You will drive declarative infrastructure practices across bare-metal systems, hyperconverged/virtualization layers (Nutanix AHV, VMware vSphere), enterprise container fleets (Red Hat OpenShift, native Kubernetes), and software-defined network hardware (Cisco, Arista, Juniper switches and routers). You will own the full operational lifecycle—from architecture alignment and automated rollouts to fleet hygiene, automated DR failover, L3 support escalations, and executive operational reporting. Detailed Description Performs tasks such as, but not limited to, the following: Enterprise Automation Framework: Define and enforce declarative automation standards across hybrid environments spanning on-premise data centers, private clouds, and multi-cloud landing zones. Virtualization & HCI Automation: Architect automated provisioning, node expansion, and policy baselines across VMware vSphere/vCenter (vROps, PowerCLI, Terraform vSphere provider) and Nutanix AHV/Prism Central (Calm, Prism APIs). Container Platform Orchestration: Standardize deployment, node scaling, and operator lifecycle automations for Red Hat OpenShift and native Kubernetes clusters across bare metal and virtual platforms. Network as Code (NetDevOps): Champion automated configuration, deployment, and validation of physical and virtual network infrastructure (leaf-spine fabrics, switches, routers, firewalls, and load balancers) using Ansible, NAPALM, Nornir, and NetBox as a single source of truth. Unified Pipeline Orchestration: Build and manage enterprise GitOps pipelines (ArgoCD, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins) that drive zero-touch provisioning for compute, storage, virtualization, and network layers. Multi-Tier IaC & Configuration: Direct the authoring, testing, and modularization of production-grade Terraform modules, Ansible playbooks, Python automation frameworks, and Kubernetes Helm/Kustomize manifests. Zero-Touch Provisioning (ZTP): Establish automated PXE/IPXE booting, bare-metal imaging, switch boot-strapping, and dynamic host/hypervisor configuration workflows. Rolling Cluster & Hypervisor Lifecycle: Coordinate and automate rolling non-disruptive upgrades across VMware ESXi, Nutanix AOS/AHV, and OpenShift/Kubernetes worker and control-plane nodes. Configuration Drift & Compliance: Implement continuous drift detection and compliance auditing tools to guarantee that on-prem hardware, network device configurations, and cloud workloads strictly match source-controlled code baselines. Automated Patching & Vulnerability Remediation: Build automated orchestration pipelines for monthly firmware updates, hypervisor security patches, base OS updates, and network OS (NOS) upgrades. L3 Operational Support: Serve as the senior escalation manager for critical automation, networking, hypervisor, and platform outages, leading cross-functional debugging sessions. Knowledge/Skills/Competencies Virtualization & HCI: Extensive, production-level expertise automating and administering VMware vSphere/vCenter and Nutanix (AOS, AHV, Prism Central). Container Orchestration: Hands-on experience configuring, automating, and operating Red Hat OpenShift and native Kubernetes at scale (CNI, CSI, Operators, Helm, Kustomize). NetDevOps & Network Automation: Proven track record automating physical switch and router configurations (Cisco IOS-XE/NX-OS, Arista EOS, Juniper Junos) using NetBox, Ansible, Python (Netmiko, Nornir), or Terraform. Automation & IaC Tooling: Deep proficiency with Terraform, Ansible/Ansible Automation Platform (Tower/AWX), and Git-driven CI/CD systems. Scripting & Development: Advanced scripting abilities in Python, Go, Bash, or PowerShell for custom API integrations and operational tooling. Resiliency & DR: Proven experience automating enterprise backup, snapshotting, and disaster recovery architectures (Veeam, Velero, Zerto, or native storage replication). Observability: Strong working knowledge of telemetry pipelines, SNMP/gNMI collectors, Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK/OpenSearch dashboards. Physical Demands Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment. Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required. Typical Experience 12 to 15 years of progressive experience in infrastructure engineering, systems administration, network operations, and DevOps. 3+ years in a people management or technical lead capacity. Make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade-offs. Evaluate options for caching, retry strategies, concurrency, and data modeling. Justify your choices and communicate trade-offs clearly. Design and build for scale and resilience. Consider failure modes, rate limits, traffic bursts, and downstream dependency health in your designs. Implement patterns like backpressure, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation. Own operational excellence for your systems. Monitor production health, respond to alarms, investigate root causes, and drive fixes. Write runbooks, improve observability, and reduce operational burden over time. Contribute to system-level design discussions. Participate actively in design reviews — propose solutions, challenge assumptions, and help the team arrive at better architectures. Mentor junior engineers. Support SDE-Is through code reviews, pairing sessions, and technical guidance. Help them grow their skills and develop good engineering habits. Understand and translate business requirements. Work with stakeholders to understand complex domain rules across punch processing, attendance, scheduling, and compliance. Turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs. Identify and resolve technical debt proactively.
