jobs.description: Prompt Engineer – Generative AI Role Purpose CGI is looking for an experienced Prompt Engineer – Generative AI to design, develop, evaluate and optimise prompt based solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI. The role will work closely with product, engineering, data and business teams to translate real business problems into effective AI experiences and workflows. The Prompt Engineer will take ownership of prompt design, prompt optimisation, evaluation, testing and guardrails, helping move Generative AI use cases from experimentation and proof of concept into reliable, secure and scalable production solutions. The role requires a combination of strong analytical capability, understanding of LLM behaviour, hands on prompt engineering, experimentation, evaluation and sufficient technical knowledge to work effectively with AI engineers and software development teams. Key Responsibilities 1. Prompt Engineering & Optimisation . Design, develop and optimise prompts for Large Language Models and Generative AI applications. . Create reusable prompt templates and prompt patterns for different business use cases. . Apply techniques including: Zero shot prompting Few shot prompting Structured prompting Contextual prompting Role/task based prompting Tool/function oriented prompting . Experiment systematically with different prompt structures, instructions and context. . Improve output accuracy, consistency, relevance and reliability. . Reduce hallucinations and undesirable model behaviour. . Optimise prompts considering quality, latency and token/cost efficiency. 2. Generative AI Solution Development . Work with AI and software engineers to build Generative AI solutions that deliver measurable business value. . Translate business requirements into effective LLM based interactions and workflows. . Support use cases such as: Enterprise knowledge assistants Customer/service agent assistance Document summarisation and analysis Information extraction Classification Content generation Question answering Workflow automation Decision support applications . Help move Generative AI capabilities from experimentation into production ready solutions. 3. LLM Evaluation & Testing . Develop systematic approaches for evaluating prompt and model performance. . Define evaluation criteria covering: Accuracy Relevance Completeness Consistency Groundedness Hallucination Safety Response quality . Build representative evaluation datasets and test scenarios. . Conduct comparative testing across prompts, models and configurations. . Perform regression testing following prompt or model changes. . Analyse failure patterns and identify opportunities for improvement. . Establish measurable acceptance criteria before prompts are promoted into production. 4. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) . Work with engineering teams to design prompts for Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions. . Optimise how retrieved enterprise context is supplied to LLMs. . Design system and user prompts that encourage grounded responses based on approved information. . Support optimisation of retrieval and generation workflows. . Evaluate whether responses are properly grounded in retrieved source material. . Help identify whether poor results originate from retrieval, context, prompt design or the underlying model. 5. Prompt Libraries & Reusable Patterns . Develop and maintain a governed library of reusable prompt templates. . Define standard patterns for common Generative AI use cases. . Maintain appropriate prompt documentation and version history. . Ensure prompt changes can be tested, reviewed and traced. . Promote reuse rather than duplication across AI solutions. . Capture lessons learned and effective prompting practices for wider engineering teams. 6. Responsible AI, Safety & Guardrails . Ensure prompt based solutions comply with Centrica's security, privacy, governance and responsible AI requirements. . Design appropriate safeguards against: Prompt injection Jailbreak attempts Hallucination Sensitive information disclosure Harmful or inappropriate outputs Unintended model behaviour . Define system level instructions and constraints for production AI applications. . Work with Security, Data and AI Governance stakeholders to identify and mitigate risks. . Support testing for bias, safety, privacy and explainability. . Ensure human oversight is incorporated where appropriate. 7. Business Requirement Translation . Work directly with business and product stakeholders to understand problems that could benefit from Generative AI. . Translate business requirements into clear AI tasks and prompt strategies. . Facilitate discovery and experimentation sessions with users. . Understand user journeys and determine where AI can genuinely improve outcomes. . Challenge use cases where Generative AI may not be the appropriate solution. . Convert user feedback into measurable prompt and solution improvements. 8. AI Experimentation . Experiment with different Large Language Models and model configurations. . Compare models based on: Output quality Accuracy Reasoning capability Latency Cost Security Context window requirements . Conduct controlled experiments to determine the most effective approach for each use case. . Document findings and provide evidence based recommendations. . Stay current with developments in LLMs, Generative AI and prompt engineering techniques. 9. Production AI & Monitoring . Work with AI engineering teams to integrate prompts into production applications and services. . Ensure prompts are version controlled and deployed through appropriate engineering processes. . Define monitoring requirements for prompt/model performance. . Analyse production feedback and failure patterns. . Support continuous improvement of live Generative AI services. . Identify prompt/model drift or degradation. . Contribute to incident investigation where AI behaviour affects production services. 10. Collaboration with AI Engineering Work closely with: . AI / ML Engineers . Software Engineers . Data Engineers . Data Scientists . Product Managers / Product Owners . UX / Conversation Designers . Solution Architects . Security teams . Data Governance teams . Business SMEs Ensure prompt design is integrated into the overall engineering lifecycle rather than treated as an isolated activity. 11. Documentation & Governance . Document prompt purpose, design decisions and expected behaviour. . Maintain prompt versions and associated evaluation results. . Document known limitations and failure scenarios. . Define appropriate usage guidance. . Support governance reviews for production AI solutions. . Ensure sufficient traceability between business requirements, prompt versions, testing and production releases. Mandatory Skills & Experience The successful candidate should have hands on experience with: . Large Language Models (LLMs) . Generative AI . Prompt engineering and prompt optimisation . System/user prompt design . Structured prompting and few shot techniques . LLM evaluation and testing . Hallucination and groundedness evaluation . Responsible AI and AI safety . Working with LLM APIs / managed foundation model platforms . RAG concepts and prompt design . Python or equivalent scripting capability . API based AI integration . Git / source control practices The candidate should also demonstrate: . Strong analytical and problem solving skills. . Ability to design structured experiments and interpret results. . Ability to translate business problems into AI use cases. . Strong written communication and language skills. . Understanding of data privacy and security. . Experience collaborating with software and AI engineering teams. . Strong attention to detail and quality. Desirable Technical Skills Experience with the following would be advantageous: . Python . SQL . Azure OpenAI / AWS Bedrock or equivalent managed AI platforms . OpenAI compatible APIs . LangChain / LangGraph or equivalent orchestration frameworks . Vector databases . Embeddings and semantic search . RAG architectures . Agentic AI / tool calling . REST APIs . CI/CD . Docker / containers . Cloud native AI deployment . Prompt/model observability . Automated LLM evaluation frameworks Responsible AI Knowledge Candidates should understand the risks associated with enterprise Generative AI, including: . Hallucination . Prompt injection . Data leakage . Bias . Toxic or inappropriate output . Privacy . Explainability . Model reliability . Human oversight They should be able to incorporate appropriate controls into prompt and solution design rather than treating responsible AI as a post development activity. Analytical ThinkingAble to define measurable evaluation criteria and use evidence to improve AI behaviour. Generative AI Understanding Understands LLM capabilities, limitations and common failure modes. Reduce hallucinations and unreliable AI behaviour. . Establish measurable evaluation frameworks for LLM applications. . Improve grounding of enterprise AI through effective RAG prompting. . Strengthen responsible AI controls. . Improve user experience and adoption of AI solutions. . Reduce repetitive manual work through effective AI automation. . Configure and customise Dynamics applications to meet agreed business requirements. . Develop high quality, secure and maintainable solutions in accordance with established engineering standards. . Develop and maintain Dynamics components including: Entities / tables Plugins Workflows Business logic Web resources Model driven applications Custom controls Integrations . Analyse technical requirements and translate them into robust Dynamics solutions. . Ensure solutions meet agreed functional and non functional requirements. 2. SAP Decommissioning Enablement . Work within the UKI SAPDecomEnabler squad to support the transition of relevant capabilities and dependencies away from legacy SAP services. . Collaborate with SAP, application, architecture and business teams to understand existing process and integration dependencies. . Identify where Dynamics 365 capabilities form part of the target state solution. . Develop or enhance Dynamics functionality required to support processes transitioning away from SAP. . Support the replacement or decoupling of SAP dependent interfaces where Dynamics is part of the target architecture. . Automate business processes and workflows using appropriate Power Platform capabilities. . Develop reusable components and patterns where appropriate. . Ensure Power Platform solutions follow agreed governance, security and development standards. 4. Integration Engineering . Design and develop integrations between Dynamics 365 and other enterprise systems. . Build and consume REST APIs and web services. . Support integration with legacy/SAP applications during transition. . Work with Azure based integration technologies where appropriate. . Develop solutions using technologies such as: Azure Functions Azure Logic Apps Azure Service Bus APIs / Web Services . Support event driven and asynchronous integration patterns. . Ensure integrations are secure, resilient, observable and supportable. . Troubleshoot complex integration and data flow issues across platforms. 5. Software Development Depending on the Dynamics solution area, develop and maintain solutions using relevant technologies including: . C# . .NET . JavaScript . TypeScript . Dynamics plugins . Workflow assemblies . FetchXML . Web resources . APIs and web services Apply appropriate coding standards, design patterns and engineering practices to ensure solutions are maintainable and scalable. 6. CI/CD & DevOps . Work with modern source control and CI/CD practices. . Maintain application code and configuration within appropriate version control repositories. . Build and support automated deployment pipelines for Dynamics and Power Platform solutions. . Promote controlled and repeatable deployment across environments. . Participate in code reviews and peer reviews. . Implement automated testing where appropriate. . Support continuous improvement of development and deployment practices. 7. Testing & Quality Engineering . Take ownership of the quality of delivered Dynamics solutions. . Develop and execute appropriate unit and technical testing. . Support integration, system and user acceptance testing. . Participate in peer/code reviews. . Investigate and resolve defects proactively. . Ensure technical solutions satisfy functional and non functional requirements. . Support regression testing during SAP transition and decommissioning activities. . Validate that changes do not adversely affect existing business processes and integrations. 8. Security & Compliance . Develop solutions in accordance with company security and data protection requirements. . Apply appropriate Dynamics security roles and access controls. . Ensure customer and business data is handled responsibly. . Follow secure software development practices. . Consider security, privacy and compliance requirements throughout the development lifecycle. . Work with Security and Architecture teams where design approval or specialist input is required. 9. Performance, Resilience & Scalability . Design Dynamics solutions with appropriate consideration for: Performance Availability Scalability Resilience Maintainability Supportability . Identify and resolve performance issues. . Ensure integrations can handle expected business volumes. . Avoid unnecessary customisation where standard Dynamics/Power Platform capabilities can meet requirements effectively. . Contribute to continuous platform optimisation. 10. Live Service Support . Support Dynamics solutions after deployment into production. . Participate in incident investigation and technical troubleshooting. . Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues. . Resolve defects and production problems. . Contribute to ongoing platform and service improvements. . Ensure appropriate technical documentation and support knowledge is maintained. . Support hypercare following major migrations or SAP decommissioning releases. 11. Agile & Cross Functional Delivery . Work as part of the UKI SAPDecomEnabler cross functional squad. . Collaborate closely with: Product Owners Software Engineers SAP SMEs Solution/Technical Architects QA / Quality Engineering Security Infrastructure Integration teams Operations Business stakeholders . Participate in sprint planning, refinement, stand ups, retrospectives and technical design discussions. . Take ownership of agreed work items through to completion. . Raise risks, blockers and dependencies early. . Contribute positively to team delivery and continuous improvement. JavaScript and/or TypeScript . Dynamics plugins and workflows . Power Apps . Power Automate . Dataverse . REST APIs / Web APIs / Web Services . Enterprise system integration . Source control and CI/CD . Automated testing and code review . Secure software engineering practices The candidate should also demonstrate: . Experience working as a software engineer within a modern cross functional Agile/product squad. . Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. . Understanding of non functional requirements including performance, resilience and scalability. . Experience supporting live enterprise applications. . Strong troubleshooting and problem solving capability. . Good communication and stakeholder management skills. Desirable Technical Skills Experience in the following would be advantageous: . Azure Functions . Azure Logic Apps . Azure Service Bus . Azure DevOps . Event driven architectures . Asynchronous processing . PCF Controls . FetchXML . Workflow Assemblies . Dynamics Web Resources . Power Platform governance . Application monitoring and observability . Cloud native integration patterns SAP Transformation Experience – Highly Desirable For the UKI SAPDecomEnabler squad, candidates with the following experience would be particularly valuable: . Power Platform / Dataverse Candidates do not necessarily need deep expertise across every Dynamics product. Certifications – Desirable Relevant Microsoft certifications would be advantageous, including: . Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Developer . Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer . jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Senior Machine Learning Engineer Description - We are looking for a Senior MLOps Engineer to design, build, and operate the infrastructure that enables machine learning models and large language models to be deployed safely, reliably, and at scale. In this role, you will create the end-to-end capabilities required to move models from experimentation into production, expose them through secure and highly available endpoints, and enable users and applications to interact with AI-powered services. You will work across AWS and Databricks to establish robust CI/CD pipelines, model-serving infrastructure, observability, governance, rollback mechanisms, and operational standards. You will partner closely with data scientists, machine learning engineers, software engineers, security teams, and platform engineers. The ideal candidate combines strong cloud and DevOps engineering skills with a practical understanding of machine learning systems, LLM deployment patterns, and production reliability. Key Responsibilities MLOps Platform and Architecture Design and implement a scalable MLOps platform using AWS and Databricks. Define reference architectures and reusable deployment patterns for traditional machine learning models, deep learning models, and large language models. Build standardized workflows that move models from development and validation into staging and production. Develop self-service capabilities that allow data scientists and ML engineers to deploy models without manually managing infrastructure. Establish clear separation between development, testing, staging, and production environments. Design multi-region or multi-availability-zone architectures where required by business continuity and availability objectives. CI/CD and Model Deployment Build automated CI/CD pipelines for model code, inference services, infrastructure, configuration, and model artifacts. Implement automated testing across the deployment lifecycle, including: Unit testing Integration testing Model validation Data contract validation API and endpoint testing Security testing Performance and load testing Regression testing Automate model packaging, containerization, versioning, approval, promotion, and deployment. Support deployment strategies such as blue-green deployments, canary releases, shadow deployments, and controlled traffic shifting. Implement reliable rollback and roll-forward mechanisms for application code, infrastructure, model versions, prompts, and configuration. Ensure deployments are reproducible, auditable, and recoverable. Model and LLM Serving Design and operate secure, scalable, low-latency inference endpoints. Deploy models using appropriate services and patterns across AWS and Databricks, such as: Databricks Model Serving MLflow Model Registry Amazon SageMaker Amazon ECS or EKS AWS Lambda, where appropriate API Gateway Application Load Balancers Build synchronous, asynchronous, batch, and streaming inference capabilities. Design serving architectures for LLM-powered applications, including: Hosted foundation models Open-source models Fine-tuned models Retrieval-augmented generation Embedding services Vector search Prompt and response orchestration Tool-calling and agentic workflows Optimize inference performance, scalability, GPU utilization, concurrency, throughput, latency, and cost. Implement autoscaling, request throttling, queuing, caching, timeout handling, and graceful degradation. Reliability, Recovery, and Business Continuity Build recoverable model-serving endpoints with clearly defined recovery time and recovery point objectives. Implement automated health checks, failover mechanisms, retry policies, circuit breakers, and service recovery procedures. Design backup and recovery processes for: Model artifacts Model registry metadata Feature definitions Deployment configurations Infrastructure state Prompts and application configuration Vector indexes and knowledge-base assets Create disaster recovery procedures and regularly test restoration and failover capabilities. Ensure production services can recover from failed deployments, infrastructure outages, model errors, and upstream dependency failures. Develop operational runbooks and incident response procedures. Monitoring and Observability Implement end-to-end observability for infrastructure, applications, models, data, and user interactions. Monitor: Availability Request volume Latency Error rates Resource utilization Model performance Data quality Data drift Concept drift Prediction distributions LLM response quality Hallucination and safety indicators Token consumption Cost per request Establish dashboards, alerts, service-level indicators, and service-level objectives. Integrate monitoring with incident management and on-call processes. Enable traceability from user requests through model inference, retrieval, orchestration, and downstream services. Support root-cause analysis by maintaining structured logs, metrics, traces, model lineage, and deployment history. Security and Governance Implement security controls for model-serving environments, APIs, data access, and deployment pipelines. Apply least-privilege access using AWS IAM, Databricks permissions, service principals, and role-based access control. Secure secrets, credentials, API keys, certificates, and tokens using approved secrets-management solutions. Implement encryption in transit and at rest. Design private networking, endpoint controls, firewall rules, and secure connectivity patterns. Support authentication, authorization, rate limiting, and tenant isolation for AI services. Ensure models and LLM applications comply with organizational requirements for privacy, security, auditability, and responsible AI. Maintain model lineage, approval records, version history, and deployment audit trails. Implement controls for sensitive data, personally identifiable information, prompt injection, unsafe outputs, and unauthorized model access. Infrastructure as Code and Automation Build and maintain cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation. Automate environment provisioning, policy enforcement, deployment configuration, and platform upgrades. Create reusable modules, templates, libraries, and deployment frameworks. Implement configuration management and environment-specific parameterization. Ensure infrastructure changes are peer-reviewed, tested, version-controlled, and traceable. Collaboration and Engineering Standards Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to productionize models and define deployment requirements. Work with software engineering teams to integrate model endpoints into user-facing products and internal applications. Collaborate with cybersecurity, architecture, legal, privacy, and governance teams. Define MLOps engineering standards, design principles, coding practices, and operational requirements. Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, and production-readiness assessments. Machine Learning Experience : Significant experience in MLOps, platform engineering, DevOps, site reliability engineering, cloud engineering, or production machine learning. Proven experience deploying and operating machine learning models in production. Strong hands-on experience with AWS services and cloud architecture. Strong hands-on experience with Databricks, including MLflow, model registries, jobs, clusters, permissions, and model-serving capabilities. Experience building CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or AWS CodePipeline, Docker and containerized application deployment. Experience with Kubernetes and managed container platforms such as Amazon EKS or ECS. Proficiency in Python and experience building production-quality APIs and inference services. Experience with REST APIs, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, and distributed systems. Strong knowledge of Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform. Experience with model versioning, artifact management, experiment tracking, and deployment promotion workflows. Experience implementing monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, and production support processes. Strong understanding of high availability, disaster recovery, fault tolerance, and rollback strategies. Knowledge of cloud networking, IAM, secrets management, encryption, and secure software delivery. Training and inference workflows Online and batch inference Model serialization and packaging Feature engineering and feature consistency Model validation and evaluation,l drift and data drift Model explainability and reproducibility GPU-based model serving Embeddings and vector databases Retrieval-augmented generation Prompt management and versioning LLM evaluation and guardrails Token limits, context management, and inference cost optimization Responsible AI, content safety, and human-in-the-loop controls This role does not necessarily require the candidate to develop new machine learning algorithms. However, the candidate must be able to understand model behavior, deployment constraints, performance characteristics, and operational risks. Preferred Qualifications: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 12+ years of total experience Experience deploying generative AI or LLM-based applications in production. Experience with Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Databricks Mosaic AI, or similar AI platforms. Experience with vector-search technologies such as Databricks Vector Search, OpenSearch, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, or pgvector. Experience with LLM application frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent orchestration tools. Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, or Splunk. Experience applying SRE practices to machine learning and AI systems. Experience operating platforms in regulated, enterprise, or data-sensitive environments. Relevant AWS, Databricks, Kubernetes, or cloud architecture certifications. What Success Looks Like Within the first 6 to 12 months, the successful candidate will: Establish a standardized and automated path from model development to production. Reduce the time required to deploy a new model or LLM service. Enable repeatable deployments across development, staging, and production. Provide reliable and secure endpoints through which users and applications can interact with AI. Implement automated rollback and recovery for failed deployments. Establish monitoring for service health, model performance, quality, security, and cost. Improve availability, deployment frequency, change-failure rate, and recovery time. Create reusable platform components that increase engineering productivity. Establish production-readiness standards for machine learning and generative AI services. Example Performance Indicators Model deployment lead time Deployment frequency Percentage of automated deployments Change-failure rate Mean time to detect incidents Mean time to recover Endpoint availability P95 and P99 inference latency Model rollback success rate Recovery-test success rate Infrastructure provisioning time Cost per inference request Percentage of production models with complete lineage and monitoring Number of security or compliance exceptions Internal developer and data scientist satisfaction Ideal Candidate Profile You are a pragmatic platform engineer who understands that deploying a model is only the beginning. You think about security, reliability, monitoring, recovery, cost, governance, and the end-user experience from the start. jobs.description: Function: AI Engineering / Applied AI Delivery About the Role We're hiring an AI Engineer to design, build, and ship production AI systems — not prototypes, not notebooks. This is a builder's role: you'll own the path from "we think an LLM/agent could solve this" to a system running reliably in production, under real load, with real failure modes. We are being deliberately selective here. This role is not for someone who has "used ChatGPT a lot" or built a weekend RAG demo. We want people who have shipped agentic or LLM-powered systems that other engineers depend on, who understand why those systems break, and who can hold their own in a room full of skeptical senior engineers. If that's not you yet, this probably isn't the right role yet either — and that's fine. Requirements What You'll Own Design and build production-grade AI/agentic systems — from architecture through deployment, monitoring, and iteration — not just model calls wrapped in a script Own the full lifecycle of at least one non-trivial AI capability: problem framing, evaluation strategy, prompt/context engineering, orchestration, deployment, and post-launch tuning Build deterministic guardrails around probabilistic components — retries, validation, fallback paths, human-in-the-loop checkpoints where confidence is low Design evaluation harnesses and offline/online eval pipelines that actually catch regressions, not vanity metrics Make real architectural tradeoffs on latency, cost, and reliability — token economics is a design constraint you think about upfront, not an afterthought Integrate AI systems into existing production infrastructure (APIs, data pipelines, orchestration layers) without breaking what already works Push back on bad ideas — including ours — with technical reasoning, not opinions Who You Are 4+ years of strong software engineering experience, with at least 1–2 years hands-on building and shipping LLM/agentic systems in production (not just experimentation) Fluent in Python and/or TypeScript, with the engineering discipline to write systems that survive contact with real users Real, hands-on depth with modern AI tooling — LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.), agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, Strands, or equivalent), vector stores/RAG pipelines, and prompt/context engineering — and a clear, opinionated point of view on where each of these breaks down Strong grasp of evaluation methodology — you know the difference between a model that looks good in a demo and one that's actually reliable Comfortable with orchestration and systems fundamentals: APIs, event-driven design, queuing, observability, CI/CD Able to reason clearly about cost, latency, and failure modes at design time, not just after something breaks in production Sharp communicator — can explain a technical tradeoff to both an engineer and a non-technical stakeholder without dumbing it down or overcomplicating it Genuinely curious and self-directed — this space moves weekly, and we need someone who tracks it because they want to, not because it's a KPI Nice to Have Experience with cloud-native deployment (Kubernetes/OpenShift), and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) Exposure to AI gateways / model routing layers (Portkey or equivalent) Experience with structured spec-driven or agent-first SDLC platforms Contributions to open-source AI tooling, published technical writing, or a portfolio of shipped AI products you can speak to in depth Experience in regulated industries (finance, insurance, healthcare) where reliability and auditability are non-negotiable Working Style Onsite Pune or Hyderabad, India. Direct, low-ceremony communication. jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer – Generative AI Model Serving (Go / Rust / GPU)
jobs.description: Our Company: At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. Power the Platform Behind Enterprise Generative AI At Teradata, we’re not just managing data; we’re unleashing its full potential. Our ClearScape Analytics™ platform and Enterprise Vector Store help the world’s largest enterprises derive value from their most complex data. Generative AI and agentic systems are the next frontier, and they run on infrastructure that has to be fast, efficient, and dependable at scale. As an AI Infrastructure Engineer, you will build the serving layer that runs large language models and other generative models inside the Teradata Vantage ecosystem. You will work on GPU-accelerated inference, high-performance Go and Rust services, and the cloud-native platform that lets teams ship models to production with confidence. You will own systems end to end, from a CUDA kernel profile to a Kubernetes rollout. What You’ll Do Design, build, and operate scalable, low-latency model-serving platforms for LLMs and generative models, covering batching, streaming, routing, autoscaling, and multi-tenant isolation. Develop high-performance control-plane and data-plane services in Go and performance-critical components (tokenizers, schedulers, runtimes, gRPC/HTTP gateways, native extensions) in Rust . Optimize GPU inference for throughput, latency, and cost using continuous batching, KV-cache management, quantization (INT8/FP8/AWQ/GPTQ), speculative decoding, tensor/pipeline parallelism, and efficient memory use. Integrate and extend inference engines such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, Ray Serve, KServe, SGLang, llama.cpp, and ONNX Runtime ; contribute fixes upstream where it makes sense. Build and manage GPU cluster infrastructure on Kubernetes (NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, MIG/time-slicing, node pools, scheduling and bin-packing) across cloud and on-prem environments. Own the full delivery path : CI/CD pipelines, model packaging and registries, canary and blue/green rollouts, infrastructure as code, and automated performance regression testing. Build AI observability into everything: metrics, logs, and traces for token throughput, time-to-first-token, GPU utilization, queue depth, error and hallucination signals, using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana. Provide clean APIs, SDKs, and developer tooling (OpenAI-compatible endpoints, internal services, and lightweight UIs or dashboards) so AI engineers and agent builders can deploy and monitor models self-serve. Support agentic and RAG workloads by serving embedding, reranking, and generation models alongside the Enterprise Vector Store, with predictable latency and graceful degradation. Drive reliability, security, and cost efficiency: SLOs, load and chaos testing, capacity planning, GPU cost attribution, and secure model and tenant isolation. Who You’ll Work With You will collaborate daily with AI researchers, ML engineers, data scientists, and platform and SRE teams who champion diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental to our success. You’ll be part of a cohesive team delivering high-quality, highly visible AI/ML functionality within the Teradata Vantage platform. You will report to the Sr. Manager, Software Engineering, who will champion your growth and empower your contributions. What Makes You a Qualified Candidate 3+ years of professional software engineering experience in backend systems, distributed systems, or AI/ML infrastructure. Strong, production-level proficiency in Go (concurrency, gRPC, profiling, service design) and working proficiency, or a demonstrated passion for learning, Rust (ownership, async runtimes such as Tokio, FFI, performance tuning). Hands-on experience with GPU computing for ML: CUDA fundamentals, GPU profiling (Nsight, nvidia-smi/DCGM), memory and bandwidth tradeoffs, and multi-GPU or multi-node inference. Experience serving LLMs or generative models in production, with practical knowledge of inference optimization techniques and the serving frameworks listed above. Solid understanding of transformer architectures and the LLM inference lifecycle (prefill vs. decode, attention, KV cache, sampling), plus familiarity with PyTorch and Hugging Face tooling. Strong system design skills and a deep understanding of distributed systems, networking, concurrency, and failure modes. Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm) and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo CD, or similar), plus infrastructure as code (Terraform). Full-stack engineering experience : comfortable building REST/gRPC APIs and a pragmatic front end (React or similar) for dashboards, playgrounds, or admin tools; Python for glue, tooling, and ML integration. Experience with observability practices and tools (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, tracing) applied to ML or LLM workloads. You are obsessive about reliability, debuggability, and ensuring AI systems behave predictably and deterministically when needed. You code daily, own systems end to end, and are knowledgeable about open-source tools and know how to leverage and extend them. What You Bring A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Genuine excitement for AI, LLMs, and the systems that make them efficient and affordable to run at scale. Strong communication skills and a bias toward measuring, benchmarking, and iterating. Familiarity with modern data platforms such as Teradata, Snowflake, or Databricks is a plus. Bonus Points Experience writing or tuning CUDA / Triton (OpenAI) / CUTLASS kernels, or contributing to inference engines. Experience with on-device or edge ML inference (ONNX, TFLite, llama.cpp, quantized small language models), embedded or mobile deployment. Knowledge of RAG pipelines, vector databases, embeddings , and agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, ReAct-style agents). Experience with model monitoring, drift detection, evaluation harnesses, and responsible AI practices. Open-source contributions, technical writing, or public projects in ML systems, Go, or Rust. Experience with service meshes, RDMA/InfiniBand/NCCL, Slurm, or Ray clusters. #LI-VB1

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Senior AI Engineer Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage. We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. In this hands-on role, you'll design, build, and ship production-grade agentic AI systems. These include agents that make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs, handle complex multi-step workflows, and deliver secure, scalable, reliable results. You'll work across agent orchestration, tool calling, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps, help set the engineering standard for Gen AI development, and mentor other engineers on the team. Much of this work is strong backend engineering. If you bring deep experience building production services and have started building with LLMs, we'd love to Roles & Responsibilities Architect and build the tool-calling layer that powers our agents: wrap internal services, data platforms, and external APIs as well-defined tools with clear schemas, contracts, and permissions. Engineer reliable tool execution at scale, including parallel and chained tool calls, timeouts, retries, idempotency, error recovery, and graceful handling of tool failures or bad model outputs. Develop high-performance Python backend services for LLM orchestration, covering async job handling, streaming responses, caching, rate limiting, and distributed workflows supporting high-throughput Gen AI operations. Engineer state, memory, and context management subsystems so agents can maintain session continuity across long, multi-step, tool-heavy interactions. Architect multi-agent and skills-based agent systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar, enabling autonomous reasoning, tool use, inter-agent coordination, and adaptive decision-making at enterprise scale. Build observability for agent behavior, including end-to-end tracing of tool calls, measuring tool-selection accuracy, and debugging multi-step agent runs in production. Build retrieval systems (RAG and Graph-RAG) where agents need grounded knowledge, using vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune). Establish LLMOps and MLOps pipelines on Databricks (AWS), covering MLflow, prompt and agent evaluation, model lineage tracking, CI/CD, and monitoring. Design multimodal generative AI pipelines that unify text, image, tabular, and graph data using modern transformer-based and foundation models. Guide fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and alignment strategies (e.g., PEFT, LoRA, instruction tuning, RLHF) to adapt foundation models for specialized enterprise use cases, working closely with ML specialists. Implement Responsible AI practices, including hallucination mitigation, bias detection, output safety guardrails, explainability, and compliance with data ethics standards. Evaluate and productionize advances in agentic AI, multimodal models, and frontier foundation models, benchmarking them against enterprise performance and safety requirements. Lead, mentor, and grow a team of engineers, and set the engineering standard for Gen AI development across the program. All About You Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. A strong track record of building and operating production backend systems at scale, including distributed services, APIs, async processing, data stores, and observability. Strong API design and integration experience: you know how to build services that other systems, and now LLMs, can call safely and reliably. Excellent Python engineering skills, including async programming, API development (FastAPI or similar), and microservices, plus SQL proficiency. Hands-on experience shipping at least one LLM-powered application to production that uses tool/function calling, such as agents that call APIs, query databases, or trigger workflows. This can be with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open-source models. A working understanding of Gen AI engineering patterns, such as prompt design, embeddings, semantic search, and agent memory, or a demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly on new technical domains. Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome). Experience leading or mentoring engineers, plus strong communication and stakeholder management skills. You should be able to translate technical work into business value. Nice to have: experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or building tool servers and connectors for LLM agents. Nice to have: experience evaluating agent performance, such as tool-selection accuracy, task completion rates, or multi-step reasoning reliability. Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, knowledge graphs, or MLOps tooling like MLflow, Weights & Biases, SageMaker, or Bedrock. Coming from a backend background? We value engineers who take AI from prototype to production as much as those who train the models. jobs.description: Job Description: Job Title: Lead Engineer, VP Location: Pune, India Corporate Title: Vice President Role Description Overview: Corporate Banking is a technology centric business, with an increasing move to real-time processing, an increasing appetite from customers for integrated systems and access to supporting data. This means that technology is more important than ever for business. Deutsche Bank is one of the few banks with the scale and network to compete aggressively in this space, and the breadth of investment in this area is unmatched by our peers. Joining the team is a unique opportunity to help rebuild the core of some of our most mission critical processing systems from the ground-up. Our Corporate Bank Technology team is a global team across 30 countries. The primary businesses that we support within Corporate Bank are Cash Management, Securities Services, Trade Finance and Trust & Agency Services. CB Technology supports these businesses through ‘vertical’ CIO aligned teams and by ‘horizontals’ such as Client Connectivity, Surveillance and Regulatory, Infrastructure, Architecture, Production, and Risk & Control. About Role: As the Lead Engineer of the Channel Security team, you will be responsible for the development and end-to-end technical delivery of a mission-critical platform designed to protect the Corporate Bank’s online channels from real-time fraud. You are expected to be a hands-on backend developer with deep architectural expertise to meet demanding performance, reliability, and security requirements, while also providing coaching and technical guidance to the development squad to enable their success. What we’ll offer you As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy Best in class leave policy Gender neutral parental leaves 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral) Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents Accident and Term life Insurance Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above Your key responsibilities Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the team, foster a culture of engineering excellence and ownership. Lead by example through direct, hands-on development of the core services and critical components of the Fraud Monitoring Platform. Partner closely with the platform architect to define and drive the implementation of the solution design, ensuring the Fraud Monitoring Platform is scalable, resilient, and secure. Work closely with Engineering Heads, Project Management, and leaders of related platforms to build, integrate, and deliver the software. Drive continuous improvement in the team's performance across the entire SDLC, including code quality, automated testing (QA), CI/CD pipelines, and post-release operational activities. Act as the primary technical expert on the platform in strategy meetings, stakeholder discussions, and future product development opportunities. Partner with SRE and L3 support teams to proactively identify and implement architectural improvements that enhance system reliability and reduce operational toil. Your skills and experience Proven, hands-on experience designing, building, and deploying complex, scalable applications on a major public cloud platform (GCP strongly preferred). Extensive hands-on backend programming experience, with expert-level proficiency in the modern Java ecosystem (Java 17+, Spring Boot). Familiarity with AI/ML, Generative AI and agentic AI patterns, with an understanding of how ML models, LLMs or AI agents can be safely integrated and orchestrated within enterprise and real-time decisioning platforms. Experience applying AI-assisted engineering techniques across software development, testing, operational support or developer productivity is required. Overall experience of 15+ years in software engineering, with a proven track record of leading the design and delivery of complex, business-critical systems. Strong knowledge of Microservices Architecture, Kubernetes, Docker, and building cloud-native applications. Proficiency with event-driven architecture and messaging systems like Kafka or MQ. Expertise with relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and in-memory data stores/caches (Redis). Good understanding of Git, CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions), and DevOps/SRE principles. Experience engineering systems with high-load and high-traffic requirements, including performance testing, tuning, and ensuring zero-downtime releases. A strong understanding of modern security principles, including API security (mTLS, OAuth2), data protection, and secure coding practices. Familiarity with the principles of AI/ML and an understanding of how to integrate and orchestrate machine learning models or AI agents within a real-time decisioning system is a strong plus. Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs. How we’ll support you Training and development to help you excel in your career Coaching and support from experts in your team A culture of continuous learning to aid progression A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs About us and our teams Please visit our company website for further information: https://www.db.com/company/company.html We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively. Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group. We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

jobs.title: AI Principal Architect
jobs.description: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary AI Principal Architect Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage. We're looking for a Principal Architect, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. As a principal-level technical leader, you'll define the architecture vision and technical strategy for our agentic AI platform. On this platform, agents make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs and must run securely, reliably, and at scale. You'll set the standards teams build on across tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, self-correcting agents, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps. You'll also make the key decisions on models, platforms, and trade-offs. Working closely with engineering, product, security, and business leaders, you'll shape the long-term direction of Gen AI across B&MI and mentor architects and senior engineers. You'll also stay hands-on with prototypes that de-risk big bets. The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale. If you've solved them as a backend or distributed systems architect and have started applying that experience to LLM systems, we'd love to hear from you. Roles & Responsibilities Own the architecture and technical roadmap for the Operational Intelligence Gen AI platform, defining reference architectures and standards that teams across the program can reuse and scale. Architect the enterprise tool-calling layer, setting standards for how internal services, data platforms, and external APIs are exposed to agents as tools. This covers schemas, contracts, versioning, access control, and resilient execution (parallel and chained calls, retries, timeouts, idempotency, circuit breakers, and fallbacks). Set the architecture for multi-agent and skills-based agent systems (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), including when to use agents versus deterministic workflows and how agents coordinate, delegate, and share context. Design self-correcting agent patterns: tool critics and verifiers that check tool selection, arguments, and results, plus reflection and plan-and-execute loops that catch errors before agents act or respond. Architect agent memory and state for long-running, multi-step sessions, including short- and long-term memory (e.g., Mem0, Zep, LangGraph memory), session persistence, and memory scoping and retention. Define retrieval architecture for grounded reasoning, including Self-RAG, Corrective RAG (CRAG), adaptive retrieval, and Graph-RAG, built on vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune). Design the inference and orchestration layer for high throughput, covering async processing, streaming, caching, rate limiting, and model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models. Establish the LLMOps architecture on Databricks (AWS), including MLflow, CI/CD for prompts and agents, and model lineage. Set platform-wide evaluation and observability standards: end-to-end tracing of tool calls, tool-selection accuracy, task success rates, cost, and latency. Build security and Responsible AI into the architecture, including guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and audit trails that meet Mastercard's data ethics and regulatory standards. Own key architecture decisions and trade-offs, such as build versus buy, model and vendor selection, and cost versus latency versus accuracy, documented through architecture decision records. Assess emerging models, frameworks, and standards such as MCP for production readiness. Lead design reviews and partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to align on architecture and raise the engineering bar across the program. Stay hands-on, building prototypes and reference implementations that de-risk decisions and give teams a working starting point. All About You Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Significant experience architecting large-scale distributed systems in production, including microservices, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud-native infrastructure. Deep expertise in API design and systems integration, including contracts, security models, and reliability patterns for services consumed by many teams. You understand what changes when the consumer is an LLM. Hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered systems in production, especially agents that use tool/function calling, memory, and retrieval, and a clear view of how they fail. Strong Python skills for hands-on prototyping (async programming, FastAPI or similar), plus SQL proficiency. Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome), including its AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI. A solid grounding in security, privacy, and compliance for enterprise systems, ideally in financial services or another regulated industry. The ability to influence without authority, aligning engineering, product, and leadership around a technical direction and explaining trade-offs in business terms. Nice to have: hands-on experience with tool critics, Self-RAG, CRAG, reflection loops, memory frameworks such as Mem0 or Zep, MCP tool servers, or agent evaluation frameworks. Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, or knowledge graphs. Coming from backend or distributed systems architecture? The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale, and you've solved them before. If you've started applying that experience to LLM systems, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't used every tool listed here. Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Ability to balance business priorities, technical strategy, and long-term platform sustainability. Strong communication and collaboration skills for working with global, cross-functional teams. Together, these teams implement and sustain new and existing manufacturing processes, workflows, materials and technologies across Apple's supply base in India. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs. Must have skills : Jakarta EE Good to have skills : NA Minimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: AI POWERED TECH TALENT Seeking a forward-thinking professional with an AI-first mindset to design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade solutions using Generative and Agentic AI frameworks that drive innovation, efficiency, and business transformation.AI Powered Tech Talent Roles & Responsibilities: Lead AI-driven solution design and delivery by applying GenAI and Agentic AI to address complex business challenges, automate processes, and integrate intelligent insights into enterprise workflows for measurable impact. Professional & Technical Skills: Strong grasp of Generative and Agentic AI, prompt engineering, and AI evaluation frameworks. Ability to align AI capabilities with business objectives while ensuring scalability, responsible use, and tangible value realization. Overview: We are seeking a seasoned Full Stack Enterprise Architect with deep expertise in designing and implementing application-heavy, multi-cloud enterprise solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in applications, infrastructure and integration, with hands-on experience in Java Spring boot and Python, as well as exposure to modern front-end technologies like React or Angular. A solid understanding of AI and its integration into enterprise systems is essential. This role will drive the architecture of scalable, secure, and innovative solutions to support business objectives across multiple cloud platforms. Key Responsibilities: Solution Architecture: Design end-to-end, application-heavy enterprise architectures that integrate infrastructure, applications, data and platforms across multi-cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). Application Development Leadership: Lead the design and implementation of robust, scalable applications with a focus on full-stack development, ensuring alignment with business goals. Integration Strategy: Architect seamless integrations between systems, applications, and third-party services using APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures. Multi-Cloud Strategy: Develop and implement strategies for deploying and managing applications across multiple cloud platforms, ensuring portability, scalability, and cost optimization. Technology Leadership: Provide technical guidance on Java Spring boot, and Python-based backend systems, and modern front-end frameworks like React or Angular. AI Adoption: Incorporate GenAI/Agentic AI capabilities into enterprise applications, leveraging frameworks and tools to enhance productivity & functionality (e.g., predictive analytics, automation). Infrastructure Design: Collaborate with infrastructure teams to design cloud-native solutions, including containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and IaC (Terraform etc.). Performance & Security: Ensure solutions are optimized for performance, scalability, and security, adhering to industry standards and best practices. Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, developers, DevOps, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions. Innovation & Trends: Stay updated on emerging technologies, including AI advancements, cloud trends, and full-stack development practices, to drive continuous improvement. Qualifications & Skills: Experience: 12 to 20+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, with at least 3 to 5 years in a full-stack architect role focusing on application-heavy solutions. Proven track record of designing and deploying solutions in multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). Hands-on experience with Java Spring boot and Python for backend development. Exposure to front-end technologies such as React, Angular, or similar frameworks. Strong understanding of AI concepts and their application in enterprise systems. Expertise in integration patterns (e.g., REST, Azure Integration Services, GraphQL, Kafka, message queues) and microservices architecture. Exposure to big data technologies (e.g., Fabrics, Hadoop, Spark) and data integration pipelines. Experience with infrastructure components such as containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), serverless computing, and IaC tools (Terraform). Understanding of DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and logging tools. Knowledge of enterprise security practices, including IAM, encryption, and compliance standards. Soft Skills: Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. Strong communication and leadership abilities to guide cross-functional teams. Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-friendly language. Proactive, innovative mindset with a focus on delivering scalable solutions. Education: Bachelor s or master s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field. Relevant certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect, GCP Professional Cloud Architect, AWS Certified AI Practitioner, TOGAF, DevOps Engineer Expert or similar) are a plus. 15 years full time education

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer – Databricks, dbt & GenAI
jobs.description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Your Role As a Senior Data Engineer – Databricks, dbt & GenAI at Kyndryl, you will design and build the advanced data platforms that power next-generation AI and Generative AI solutions. You will leverage your expertise in Databricks, dbt, Python, and modern data architectures to create scalable, intelligent, and high-performing data ecosystems that enable AI-driven innovation across the enterprise. You will work with large volumes of structured and unstructured data, developing robust data pipelines, semantic data layers, and retrieval frameworks that support Generative AI, advanced analytics, and business transformation initiatives. By ensuring data quality, accessibility, governance, and operational excellence, you will help organizations unlock the full potential of AI-ready data platforms. Join Kyndryl and gain the trust, autonomy, and collaboration needed to help shape the future of data engineering and Generative AI. What You Will Do Design and build scalable data pipelines supporting Generative AI, advanced analytics, and enterprise data initiatives. Develop and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks by preparing, transforming, and managing large volumes of enterprise data for AI-driven applications. Create and maintain vectorized data processing pipelines that enable fast and accurate retrieval of information for AI and agentic workflows. Build semantic data layers, knowledge frameworks, and contextual datasets that improve the effectiveness and accuracy of AI-powered solutions. Develop and manage dbt models, macros, tests, documentation, and deployment pipelines to ensure trusted and reusable data assets. Leverage Databricks Lakehouse capabilities, including Delta Lake, Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog, and Workflows, to deliver scalable and secure data solutions. Implement automated data quality controls, governance frameworks, and validation processes to identify data inconsistencies, bias, duplication, and compliance risks. Collaborate with AI Engineers, Data Scientists, Architects, and Business Stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. Build, deploy, and maintain CI/CD pipelines that support continuous integration, testing, and delivery of data engineering solutions. Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data platform performance, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency. Drive engineering best practices in data modeling, version control, testing, documentation, security, and cloud-native development. If you are passionate about modern data engineering, Databricks, dbt, cloud technologies, and Generative AI, this is the role for you. You will work alongside talented professionals on innovative projects that help organizations accelerate data-driven transformation and unlock new business opportunities through AI. Your Future at Kyndryl As a Senior Data Engineer – Databricks, dbt & GenAI, you will collaborate closely with AI specialists, Data Scientists, Data Architects, Cloud Engineers, and Business Leaders to solve complex data and AI challenges. Whether you aspire to become a Lead Data Engineer, Data Architect, AI Platform Engineer, GenAI Solutions Architect, or Data Engineering Manager, Kyndryl provides the opportunities, mentorship, and resources to accelerate your professional growth and help shape the future of enterprise AI and modern data platforms. Who You Are You're good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally important, you have a growth mindset and are committed to continuous learning and professional development. You are customer-focused, passionate about building modern data platforms, and thrive in collaborative, fast-paced environments. You enjoy solving complex data challenges, enabling AI-driven innovation, and delivering scalable, production-grade solutions that create business value. Required Technical and Professional Expertise 7+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, with a proven track record of designing, developing, deploying, and supporting enterprise-scale data solutions in production environments. Expert-level proficiency in dbt Core , including project structuring, model development, macros, testing, documentation, source management, environment configuration, CI/CD integration, and production troubleshooting. Strong hands-on experience with the Databricks Lakehouse Platform , including Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Databricks Workflows, and performance optimization techniques. Advanced proficiency in SQL , including complex transformations, query optimization, dimensional modeling, partitioning strategies, data warehousing concepts, and large-scale analytical workloads. Strong experience designing and implementing dimensional models (SCD Type 1 and Type 2) , enterprise reporting layers, and scalable data products. Proficiency in Python for data engineering, automation, orchestration, and ingestion frameworks. Experience developing and supporting data ingestion pipelines from diverse sources including REST APIs, SFTP, relational databases, cloud storage platforms, and large-scale file-based datasets. Strong understanding of Generative AI concepts , including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, semantic layers, and AI-ready data architectures. Experience preparing, governing, and optimizing enterprise data for AI, machine learning, and GenAI use cases. Hands-on experience implementing and enforcing enterprise data governance, security, lineage, and quality frameworks using Databricks Unity Catalog and dbt testing capabilities. Experience designing and building governed, reusable, and scalable data products that support analytics, AI, and business transformation initiatives. Strong understanding of cloud services including object storage (ADLS/GCS), secret management (Azure Key Vault/GCP Secret Manager), compute services, containers, and serverless architectures. Experience establishing and supporting CI/CD pipelines for data platforms using GitHub Actions and modern DevOps practices. Strong troubleshooting, performance tuning, monitoring, and operational support experience within cloud-based data platforms. Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively across global teams. Preferred Technical and Professional Experience Experience working in multi-cloud environments , including Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Hands-on experience with dlt (Data Load Tool) or similar modern ingestion and orchestration frameworks. Knowledge of enterprise data governance, metadata management, data cataloging, and lineage best practices. Experience developing data products that support Agentic AI, GenAI, machine learning, or advanced analytics initiatives. Familiarity with vector databases and semantic data architectures supporting AI-driven applications. Advanced Python development experience including Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), decorators, multi-threading, and optimization techniques. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform. Familiarity with Power BI integration, semantic modeling, and performance optimization within Databricks environments. Experience mentoring junior engineers through code reviews, pair programming, technical coaching, and engineering best practices. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred! If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.
