jobs.title: Staff Data Scientist
jobs.description: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Job Summary: This job will design and implement advanced data science models to support business needs. You will work with stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions. Your role involves driving best practices in data science, ensuring data quality, and mentoring junior scientists. We are looking for a Staff Data Scientist with strong computer science and software engineering fundamentals and deep, hands-on experience taking ML models and AI applications into production. We have a strong preference for candidates who have built AI applications in production and who bring a research background in ML. You will own systems end to end, from modeling and evaluation to deployment, and monitoring, and you will help shape how AI is used to detect and respond to fraud. Job Description: Essential Responsibilities: Lead and manage data science projects, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with business goals. Develop and maintain data models, algorithms, and reporting systems to support data analysis and decision-making. Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that drive strategic initiatives. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data needs and provide actionable insights. Ensure data quality and integrity through regular audits and validation processes. Mentor and guide junior data scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement. Minimum Qualifications: 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications : What you need to know about the role This role is in the AI/ML team within the PayPal Artificial Intelligence org. This team supports Payment Services and Crypto, one of the 3 Business Units within PayPal. We partner with large, strategic customers to design, build and deploy fraud-detection solutions – machine-learning models, rules and AI-assisted tooling – that stop emerging attacks while keeping the experience smooth for good customers. We are looking for a Staff Data Scientist with strong computer science and software engineering fundamentals and deep, hands-on experience taking ML models and AI applications into production. We have a strong preference for candidates who have built AI applications in production and who bring a research background in ML. You will own systems end to end, from modeling and evaluation to deployment, and monitoring, and you will help shape how AI is used to detect and respond to fraud. Your day to day In your day-to-day role, you will Develop, train, tune and evaluate models for fraud detection and risk assessment. Own feature development, modeling choices, reproducible experiments and error analysis as fraud patterns evolve. Design, implement, and maintain ML and generative AI applications, including multi agent workflows built on payments data in production. Build maintainable Python services, APIs, and SQL data pipelines that connect models with enterprise data, databases, and user applications. Own full-stack delivery of ML applications: Backend API services, data pipelines on BigQuery, containerized deployments, and PR-based review. Work with strategic merchants and cross-functional partners to understand their fraud challenges, design solutions together, and explain results clearly to technical and executive audiences. Identify areas of improvement in internal systems and product, design, and project manage solutions end to end. Independently execute projects end to end, while also mentoring and guiding junior team members, with a strong people-oriented mindset Mentor Data Scientists, and ML Engineers; lead design reviews, set coding and documentation standards, and act as a bar-raiser in hiring. What do you need to bring- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Mining or related field or equivalent practical experience A minimum of 8 years of experience in building and shipping machine-learning systems to production, with demonstrated Staff-level scope, ownership and technical leadership. Hands-on experience with ML models and AI applications in production: training, evaluating, deploying and monitoring models (classical ML, deep learning and/or LLMs) for real users. Strong SQL and practical experience preparing data, building reliable pipelines, and integrating analytical or relational data with model workflows. Experience deploying and operating services on a public cloud (GCP preferred). Excellent communication and influencing skills; able to translate business and customer needs into technical solutions and to mentor others. Strongly preferred End-to-end experience building and launching AI applications in production, with ownership of evaluation, reliability and user outcomes; risk or decision-support applications are especially relevant. Research background in machine learning: PhD or MS with research experience, publications, or research-engineering work that moved from papers to products. Nice to have Experience in fraud, risk, trust & safety, payments or e-commerce, including real-time decisioning or rule engines. Experience with graph, sequence or anomaly-detection methods, or adversarial / drifting data. Experience with multi-agent orchestration, Vertex AI, MCP, vector stores, or LLM cost and latency optimization. Customer-facing consulting experience with enterprise clients; track record of mentoring across teams. Subsidiary: PayPal Travel Percent: 0 PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us. For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations. Our Benefits: At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health. Who We Are: Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com. Belonging at PayPal: Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal. Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community. We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply.

as the technical expert for the India market You may be a good fit if you have: 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems Comfortable with Python Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones as part of a global team Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Research Engineer, Applied Research (BioTech AI – Drug Discovery) About the Company Quantiphi is an award-winning AI-first digital engineering company, driven by a deep desire to solve transformational problems at the heart of businesses. Our signature approach combines groundbreaking machine-learning research with disciplined cloud and data-engineering practices to create breakthrough impact at unprecedented speed. Quantiphi has seen 2.5x growth YoY since its inception in 2013 to 3500+ team members globally. For more details, please visit our website or LinkedIn page. About Phi Labs Phi Labs is an R&D practice at Quantiphi focused on advancing the frontiers of AI technologies with Applied Machine Learning at its core. We ideate and build novel solutions to high-impact, cutting-edge challenges, with a focus on advanced prototyping and scalable proof of concepts. Within this unit, the AI-Accelerated Drug Discovery practice is a key pillar that aims to apply state-of-the-art AI methodologies to revolutionize the way new therapeutics are discovered and developed. We are committed to driving meaningful scientific breakthroughs by combining strong AI research with deep cross-disciplinary collaboration. Job Description Role Level: Research Engineer Work Location: India The Role This is a unique opportunity to work on scientifically impactful problems at the intersection of AI and biotechnology within Phi Labs, Quantiphi’s Applied Research team. In this role, you will work on the development of core AI models and algorithms aimed at accelerating the drug discovery process. This position focuses on key peptide engineering workstreams. This includes In Silico design of Antibodies, mini proteins, cyclic peptides etc. The position involves working with a diverse, lively, and proactive group of nerds who are constantly raising the bar on translating the latest AI research in Healthcare and Life Sciences into tangible reusable assets for the community. Hence this would require a high level of conceptual understanding, attention to detail and agility in terms of adaptation to new technologies. While prior experience in the biotech or life sciences domain is highly valued and will elevate the candidate profile, we are equally open to exceptional AI/ML researchers from other domains who are excited to explore and learn the nuances of this rapidly growing field . Please note: This is a core AI research role, not a software engineering or system integration position. We are particularly keen to engage with candidates focused on scientific AI innovation rather than application development or LLM/GenAI-centric workflows . Responsibilities Stay ahead of the AI research curve, focusing on foundational AI methodologies applicable to protein analysis and protein design. Build rapid prototypes, conduct detailed experimental studies, and develop advanced AI models in areas such as generative modeling, reinforcement learning, graph-based learning, and property prediction. Work closely with interdisciplinary teams including biologists, chemists, and life science domain experts to design scientifically sound AI approaches. Contribute to Quantiphi’s IP portfolio through the development of novel algorithms, proof of concepts, and potential publications. Drive thought leadership through documentation, knowledge dissemination, and participation in conferences, blogs, webinars, and publications. Publish Research papers in prestigious Conferences and Journals. Requirements Must Have: Master’s degree, PhD, or equivalent experience in Biological Sciences/ Biotechnology, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, or related fields. Minimum work experience required : from new graduates to 3+ yrs of research experience post graduation (in ML research) Strong foundation in AI/ML concepts with hands-on experience in model development, experimental design, and large-scale data analysis. We are looking for a QA Engineer to join our global Digital Experiences team and help ensure that the experiences we build—guiding users through the purchase funnel, personalizing to their needs, and encouraging ongoing engagement—are reliable, accurate, and release-ready. The successful candidate will own quality across the delivery lifecycle, from test planning and preparation through execution, automation, and CI/CD integration. They will bring a development-minded approach to testing and help evolve our QA practice toward an AI-assisted model that increases coverage and speed while reducing manual effort. Responsibilities: Planning Understand requirements and Jira stories; create test plans, assess test automation feasibility, and estimate, schedule, and plan testing activities. Use AI tools to analyze requirements and user stories, identify gaps or ambiguities early, and propose risk-based test coverage. Test Preparation Analyze and understand scenarios and application flows, and prepare test scenarios and test cases for new functionality. Prepare test data and manually execute test cases to understand application flows. Use AI-assisted tools to generate and refine test scenarios, test cases, and synthetic test data, applying human review to validate accuracy and completeness. Test Execution Execute new functional test cases for the current release, as well as manual and automated regression packs. Log defects and retest fixed defects. Apply AI to triage test failures, cluster related defects, and draft clear, reproducible defect reports. Leverage AI-enabled visual, accessibility, and content checks to catch regressions across pages, markets, and devices. Test Scripting & Integration Develop test scripts according to the BlackRock framework and perform dry runs of automation scripts. Integrate automation with the CI/CD pipeline and complete a full run of automated scripts. Use AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to accelerate test script development, refactoring, and maintenance, including self-healing of brittle locators. Help build reusable prompts, agent workflows, and standards that scale AI-assisted QA across the team, and measure their impact on coverage, cycle time, and defect leakage. User Documentation Create and update user manuals. Core Skills: Quality mindset with a development background. Analytical mindset with the ability to grasp complex concepts easily. Comfortable working in an agile environment, fluent in English. Interested in continuously extending testing know-how. Curious and pragmatic about AI—applies it to improve quality and speed, while exercising sound judgment on AI-generated output. Qualifications: Essential Skills and Experience 3-7 years of working experience in software testing or QA. Technology-based university degree or equivalent experience. Proven ability to assure the quality of developed software and code. Experience with at least one of the following frameworks: Playwright, Cypress, or Puppeteer. Experience with CI/CD environments. Experience with Jira/Azure Boards, Confluence, and Git. Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) in testing or development workflows. Desirable Skills and Experience Practical knowledge of designing and developing test automation solutions. Experience with Azure DevOps. Strong hands-on knowledge of TypeScript and Python for test automation, scripting, and framework development. Familiarity with AI-native testing tools, Playwright MCP, or agent-based test generation and execution. Experience testing AI-powered features (e.g., chatbots or generative content), including evaluation of output accuracy and consistency. Our benefits To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. Our hybrid work model BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. Guidance on AI use for candidates At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance (opens in new window) on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. About BlackRock At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com (opens in new window). We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn (opens in new window), Instagram (opens in new window), YouTube (opens in new window), X (opens in new window), and TikTok (opens in new window). BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law. jobs.title: Agentic/AI engineers with Claude/code/LLM skills1
jobs.description: Job Description: Key Responsibilities Design and build agentic LLM solutions (single- and multi-agent patterns) to solve real business problems across domains (e.g., customer support, document intelligence, knowledge retrieval). Build RAG pipelines end-to-end: data ingestion chunking/embeddings vector search retrieval orchestration response synthesis, with measurable quality. Implement prompt engineering and prompt orchestration (prompt chains, tool-calling, function calling), including prompt iteration and cost/latency optimisation. Develop production services/APIs for LLM applications (e.g., FastAPI/Flask/Streamlit ) and integrate with enterprise systems and data sources. Apply guardrails to reduce hallucinations, enforce policy constraints, and ensure safe tool usage; implement evaluation strategies for LLM and RAG outputs. Collaborate with Data Engineering teams to ensure data quality, governance, and documentation standards , and with MLOps/Platform teams for CI/CD, monitoring, and reliable deployments. Create and maintain technical documentation, solution design artefacts, and reusable components for faster delivery and consistent engineering practices. Must-Have Skills 5 to 12 years total experience, with hands-on LLM/GenAI delivery experience (preferably 1–3+ years building production-grade LLM apps). LLM / GenAI & Agentic Engineering Hands-on experience with LLMs including Claude (Anthropic) and other leading models; strong understanding of capabilities, limitations, and use-case fit. Practical experience with RAG , embeddings, vector databases (e.g., FAISS/Pinecone/ChromaDB), semantic search, and retrieval quality evaluation. Experience with frameworks/tools such as LangChain, LangGraph , Hugging Face, or equivalent orchestration stacks. Experience building agentic workflows including tool calling/function calling; familiarity with “agentic architecture” concepts is valued. Exposure to Claude Code or similar coding-agent workflows is a plus (agentic coding that can work across codebases, run tests, and iterate). Core Engineering Strong Python engineering skills (production-grade coding, testing, packaging, API development). Solid understanding of cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) and deployment basics (containers, CI/CD, monitoring). Strong communication skills—ability to translate business needs into technical solutions and articulate trade-offs clearly. Mandatory Background (Non-negotiable) Prior experience in Data Engineering or Data Science : Data pipelines / ETL / ELT / orchestration, or ML/NLP modelling lifecycle, experimentation, evaluation, or Analytics engineering and data product delivery. Good-to-Have / Preferred Fine-tuning approaches (e.g., LoRA/PEFT ), prompt tuning, few-shot strategies, and model evaluation methods. Experience with enterprise-grade privacy/security considerations for GenAI solutions (data handling, redaction, access control). Experience with Azure stack components often used in GenAI (e.g., Azure AI Search / Azure OpenAI) is beneficial. Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or related fields (or equivalent practical experience). jobs.title: Senior GenAI Engineer — Claude
jobs.description: Job Description: The Senior GenAI Engineer — Claude & Agentic Systems is a hands-on builder who deploys Claude-powered demos and production solutions using Python, LangChain, RAG, and AWS/Replit. The role owns EXL’s Claude demo library and POC pipeline within the India AI Center of Excellence. Reporting to the Director, the engineer turns solution designs into working, measurable systems and rapidly prototypes new Claude capabilities for client pursuits. CCA-F (Claude Certified – Foundations) certification is the baseline; MCP and Claude Computer Use familiarity is a strong differentiator Responsibilities: Responsibilities Build and deploy Claude-powered demos, proofs-of-concept, and production solutions using Python, LangChain, and RAG patterns. Own and continuously expand EXL’s Claude demo library and POC pipeline, ensuring reusable, well-documented components. Implement agentic workflows with tool-calling/function-calling and, where relevant, MCP-based integrations. Develop production services and APIs, and deploy on AWS (and Replit for rapid prototyping), with attention to reliability, cost, and latency. Apply guardrails and evaluation strategies to ensure output quality, safety, and policy compliance. Collaborate with the Claude Solutions Architect and delivery teams to convert designs into working systems. Maintain technical documentation and reusable assets to accelerate future delivery. Must-Have Skills 5–7 years of engineering experience, with hands-on GenAI/LLM delivery. Claude & Agentic Engineering Strong hands-on experience building Claude-powered solutions, including RAG pipelines and agentic workflows. Proficiency with LangChain (or equivalent orchestration stacks) and prompt engineering. Experience with vector databases, embeddings, and retrieval evaluation. CCA-F (Claude Certified – Foundations) certification as a baseline (held or achievable on joining). Core Engineering Strong Python engineering skills (production-grade coding, testing, packaging, API development). Hands-on experience deploying on AWS; familiarity with Replit for rapid prototyping. Good communication skills and the ability to work closely with architects and delivery teams. Good-to-Have / Preferred Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations. Exposure to Claude Computer Use and emerging agentic-coding workflows. Experience contributing demo libraries, accelerators, or reusable POC assets to a CoE. Domain exposure to BFSI, healthcare, or insurance use cases. Qualifications: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Systems, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

jobs.title: AI Engineer, India, 2-3 years
jobs.description: Job Description: AI Engineer, India, 2-3 years Responsibilities: • Design, build, and optimize agentic AI systems leveraging LLMs, multi-agent frameworks, tool‑use orchestration, retrieval systems, and autonomous workflows to solve complex real‑world problems. • Develop scalable ML pipelines and infrastructure including data processing, feature engineering, model training/evaluation and deployment using modern ML-Ops practices (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability). • Integrate agents with enterprise tools and APIs enabling autonomous planning, reasoning, and execution chains across cloud platforms, internal systems, and third‑party services. • Collaborate cross‑functionally with product, engineering, and domain SMEs to design end‑to‑end intelligent workflows, ensure reliability/safety, and translate business needs into production‑grade agentic solutions. Qualifications: • Minimum 2 year(s) of hands-on experience with Python (comfortable with PyTorch/TensorFlow) • Minimum 1 year(s) of experience with LangChain/LlamaIndex • Minimum 1 year(s) of experience with RAG pipelines and vector databases • Practical exposure to agentic/LLM systems such as tool‑calling, autonomous task execution, workflow orchestration, reasoning chains, prompt engineering, and integrating models with APIs or enterprise systems. • Strong MLOps & engineering discipline including experience with cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP), containerization (Docker), CI/CD, data pipelines, and deploying ML systems into production environments. • Problem‑solving mindset and cross‑functional communication skills with the ability to translate business requirements into intelligent workflows, run experiments, and iterate quickly in a fast-paced AI environment.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: Overview Intuit is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to join our Data Audience Platform (DAP) team in DGX. In this leadership position, you will guide a team of engineers in developing critical data-driven solutions vital to Intuit's marketing strategies, including the effective management and utilization of big data Responsibilities Gather functional requirements and develop technical specifications, project plans, and test plans. working knowledge on Data and data pipelines, Data analysis Design and develop high-velocity web applications, prototypes, and proofs of concept (POCs). Act as a technical leader, mentoring junior and new team members while applying technical expertise to solve challenging programming and design problems. Engage in hands-on coding for approximately 70-85% of your time. Resolve defects and bugs during testing, as well as in pre-production, production, and post-release environments. Collaborate cross-functionally with various Intuit teams, including product management, QA/QE, product lines, and business units, to drive results. Contribute to the design and architecture of projects. Utilize experience with Agile Development, SCRUM, or Extreme Programming methodologies. Manage system and data integration. Qualifications Experience: 10+ years developing web, software, or mobile applications. Education: BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent work experience. Technical Skills: Strong experience with Java, SpringBoot, AWS, Kafka, and Kubernetes. Data Processing: Strong experience with stream processing or near real-time data ingestion. Software Development: Experience with the entire Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Communication: Solid communication skills with the demonstrated ability to explain complex technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences. Design: A strong understanding of the software design and architecture process. Testing: Experience with unit testing and Test-Driven Development (TDD). Emerging Tech: Knowledge of AI/ML, Generative AI, Data Science, and Machine Learning. Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

jobs.title: Forward Deployment Engineer
jobs.description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role At Kyndryl, we deploy AI innovation where it creates the greatest real-world impact. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will collaborate directly with customers to solve complex challenges, shaping solutions that redefine industries. You will be empowered to work at speed, supported by a global AI ecosystem, and play a pivotal role in delivering outcomes that matter. This position operates within our triad delivery model, where engineering, consulting, and product expertise come together to drive transformative results for customers. This is not traditional consulting or pure software engineering; it is a hybrid role designed for the complexities of real-world AI deployment, with accountability for outcomes not just code. You will blend deep engineering expertise with consultative engagement to deliver tailored solutions that drive measurable business value. Operating in dynamic environments and working closely with customer teams - often on-site - you will scope, prototype, and deploy solutions at pace. Technologies include Generative AI, Agentic AI architectures, and multi-agent ecosystems, with insights continually fed back into Kyndryl’s platforms and frameworks to accelerate future deployments. If you are motivated by solving complex problems, excel in direct customer engagement, and aspire to shape the future of enterprise AI, this role is designed for you. Key Responsibilities Owns client relationship, scoping, delivery assurance, escalation, and team coordination across FDE squads for AI solutions Sets technical direction, advise C-suite, shape strategy, lead multiple squads Interacts with Client teams, understand the requirements, datasets to determine and refine objectives. Contribute to building the solution and own the end-to-end technical delivery of workstreams including Hands-On delivery of Agentic AI solutions Continuously monitor progress and measure alignment with expected customer outcomes. Design agentic AI Solutions and facilitate the orchestration of agents through workflows to automate client processes. Set up agentic ingestion, builder, and catalogue pieces, then operate on customer stacks to cut time‑to‑value. Evaluate and choose the models with respect to client’s requirements. Deploy and support Agentic AI solutions in client environments. Mentor FDEs on potential solutions and contribute to their upskill. Your Future at Kyndryl Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. Required Skills and Experience 8+ years of relevant IT experience in which at least 2 years of working experience in GenAI/Agentic AI Frameworks, Orchestration, Deployment and at least 3 years on AI solutions along with overall 4-5 years experience on software development with delivery/team ownership. Proven experience of client engagement, Solutioning , owning and driving delivery of Agentic AI workstreams and delivering successful production grade systems. Hands on experience with atleast 2 Agentic AI frameworks like Langchain/Langraph, CrewAi, Google ADK or Azure AI Agents SDk and delivering at least 1 Agentic Solution on Production. Hands on experience (Atleast 2 years) in setting up Vector Databases and RAG solutions. Hands on with Python/Java, SQL, API development with at least 3-4 years hands on experience in these technologies. Experience with technical delivery including hands-on contribution of atleast 3 AI projects other than GenAI/Agentic AI. Atleast 1 year experience with Data cleaning, ETL, batch/stream processing, orchestration Solid understanding of SDLC, version control (Git & GitHub) and demonstrated experience of leading 1-2 projects. Experience in deployment and observability of Agentic AI systems and workflows. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Cloud Systems: Experience with cloud AI platforms (AWS, Azure, Google AI). Willingness to travel. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Informatics, Data Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience). Why join us? You will become part of a team that values pace, autonomy, and tangible impact. At Kyndryl, you will have full visibility of the delivery lifecycle, with opportunities to lead engagements and shape strategic direction. Our triad delivery model means you will work alongside experts in engineering, product, and consulting, fostering continuous learning and innovation. Career progression is clearly defined, from Junior to Principal levels, with pathways to influence the evolution of our AI platforms. You will contribute directly to platform development and see the results of your work in real-world applications. If you are seeking an environment where your ideas are valued and execution drives results, this is the place to make a difference. If you want to work where innovation meets execution, apply now. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred! If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

jobs.description: Location: Gurgaon, Haryana Team: Data Science Job Requisition #: R266889 Date posted: Nov. 16, 2026 Job description About this role The Data Science & Artificial Intelligence (AI) team helps transform how technology, data, and AI drive better outcomes for clients and the business. The team partners closely with client-facing teams, product strategists, engineers, and business leaders to develop and scale AI-powered solutions that enhance productivity, improve decision-making, strengthen client engagement, and unlock commercial value. This is a highly impactful team focused on translating innovation into real-world business outcomes and advancing the future of AI-powered client engagement across the firm. Your Role and Impact We are seeking a highly motivated AI Solutions Lead to join the Data Science & AI team. This role combines technical expertise in machine learning, generative AI, and data engineering with the ability to translate business challenges into scalable AI solutions. You will partner with stakeholders across Sales, Product Strategy, Chief Operating Officer (COO) functions, and Technology to identify opportunities, develop AI-driven products, and deploy solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. Success in this role requires intellectual curiosity, analytical thinking, hands-on technical skills, and the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams. Your Responsibilities In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and embrace the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies while challenging outcomes. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities: Develop artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and advanced analytics solutions that drive commercial growth, improve client experiences, and enhance operational efficiency. Design, develop, evaluate, and deploy AI and machine learning solutions in partnership with engineering teams. Build intelligent AI-powered assistants, agentic workflows, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications that deliver measurable business value. Establish experimentation, evaluation, monitoring, and performance measurement frameworks to assess business impact and solution effectiveness. Leverage modern cloud, data, and directed acyclic graph-based workflow orchestration frameworks for data and batch processing to build scalable AI solutions. Champion responsible AI practices, model governance, security, scalability, and reliability standards. Partner across product, engineering, business, and AI teams to advance enterprise AI capabilities and communicate insights effectively. Your Experience Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, or another quantitative discipline; advanced degrees are a plus. Demonstrated ability to build and deploy AI and machine learning solutions in production environments. Strong technical proficiency in Python, Structured Query Language (SQL), data engineering, and analytical platforms. Demonstrated expertise in machine learning, statistics, experimentation, and predictive modeling. Experience developing generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, natural language processing (NLP), and related techniques. Experience in asset management, financial services, fintech, or modern cloud-based AI ecosystems is preferred. Strong communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and responsible AI practices. Our benefits To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. Our hybrid work model BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. Guidance on AI use for candidates At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance (opens in new window) on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. About BlackRock At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com (opens in new window). We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn (opens in new window), Instagram (opens in new window), YouTube (opens in new window), X (opens in new window), and TikTok (opens in new window). BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law. jobs.description: Job Summary Role Title: Generative AI Engineer / Applied AI Developer Experience Required: Minimum 5+ Years in Software / Machine Learning (with 1.5+ years hands-on in LLMs & GenAI) Core Tech Stack: Python, PyTorch, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Vector DBs, FastAPI, Docker, Cloud AI (AWS/Azure) Target Work Model: Hybrid (Enterprise Office / Remote flexibility available) Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent Position We are seeking a talented, technically passionate Generative AI Engineer with 3+ years of professional software engineering and applied AI/ML experience to design, build, and deploy production-grade LLM applications. In this hands-on engineering role, you will turn the latest advancements in generative artificial intelligence into resilient, scalable business solutions. You will specialize in constructing Advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, engineering autonomous agents with deterministic tool-calling capabilities, optimizing prompt workflows, experimenting with parameter-efficient model adaptation (LoRA/QLoRA), and serving high-performance inference APIs via containerized microservices hosted on AWS or Microsoft Azure. Key Responsibilities RAG Architecture & Vector Search Engineering RAG Pipeline Development: Design and implement end-to-end RAG pipelines incorporating multi-modal document parsing, recursive text splitting, and semantic chunking. Vector Store Management: Integrate, optimize, and benchmark vector databases (Pinecone, Qdrant, Chroma, Weaviate, pgvector, Azure AI Search) for sub-second similarity search. Hybrid Search & Re-ranking: Implement hybrid retrieval combining dense vector embeddings with sparse lexical keyword matching (BM25) and cross-encoder re-ranking models (Cohere Rerank, BGE). Context Optimization: Engineer contextual compression, parent-document retrieval, and metadata filtering schemas to eliminate context noise and hallucinations. B. Agentic Workflows & Multi-Tool Integration Agentic Frameworks: Build stateful multi-agent workflows and autonomous task execution loops using LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or AutoGen. Tool Calling & Action APIs: Develop robust, type-safe function-calling and tool-use interfaces connecting LLMs to external REST APIs, relational databases, and enterprise systems. Loop Safeguards & Routing: Implement plan-and-solve agent patterns, multi-step reflection loops, and fallback error-handling to prevent infinite agent recursion. C. Prompt Engineering, Output Validation & Fine-Tuning Prompt Engineering: Design and test systematic prompt templates utilizing Chain-of-Thought (CoT), Few-Shot prompting, ReAct patterns, and directional stimulus prompting. Structured Output Parsing: Enforce deterministic, validated output structures using Pydantic, Instructor, Guidance, or Outlines to guarantee reliable downstream ingestion. Model Adaptation: Conduct Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA) on open-weights models (Llama 3, Mistral, Phi-3/4) for domain-specific tasks. D. Backend API & Inference Microservices Inference APIs (FastAPI): Develop high-throughput asynchronous backend microservices using Python (FastAPI), managing connection pooling, concurrency, and rate limiting. Streaming Latency: Implement low-latency streaming inference pipelines utilizing Server-Sent Events (SSE) and WebSockets for conversational user interfaces. Inference Engines: Optimize inference throughput utilizing modern serving engines like vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or Ollama, minimizing Time-to-First-Token (TTFT). Containerized Deployment: Containerize applications with Docker and configure deployment manifests for Kubernetes, AWS ECS/EKS, or Azure Container Apps. E. Evaluation, Guardrails & LLMOps Observability Automated Model Evaluation: Establish automated evaluation benchmarks utilizing synthetic test datasets and evaluation harnesses (Ragas, TruLens, DeepEval) to quantify faithfulness and recall. AI Guardrails & Safety: Implement enterprise guardrails (NeMo Guardrails, Llama Guard, Azure Content Safety) to proactively mitigate prompt injection, jailbreaks, and toxicity. Observability & Tracing: Integrate comprehensive LLM tracing, prompt versioning, and cost monitoring using tools like Langfuse, Phoenix, or Weights & Biases. Skill Requirements Required Technical Skills & Qualifications Total Experience: Minimum 3+ years of professional software engineering / data science experience, with at least 1.5+ years of dedicated hands-on GenAI / LLM development. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or equivalent technical field. Python & ML Foundations: Advanced Python programming skills (asyncio, type hints, Pydantic, pytest) and deep familiarity with PyTorch or Hugging Face Transformers. GenAI Frameworks: Extensive hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, and commercial/open foundation model APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock). Vector Search & RAG: Proven track record building and deploying production RAG architectures using vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Qdrant, pgvector). Backend & Containers: Hands-on proficiency developing asynchronous REST APIs using FastAPI, Docker containerization, and Git-based collaborative workflows. Core Competencies: Strong analytical problem-solving skills, solid understanding of transformer architecture mechanics, and proactive technical curiosity. 4. Preferred Qualifications & Industry Certifications Inference Optimization: Hands-on experience with model quantization (GGUF, AWQ, GPTQ) and high-throughput inference serving engines (vLLM, TGI, TensorRT-LLM). Cloud Certifications: Cloud AI certifications: AWS Certified AI Practitioner / ML Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102), or Azure AI Fundamentals. Open Source & Portfolio: Demonstrated contributions to open-source GenAI projects, LangChain/LlamaIndex community plugins, or active technical blog/GitHub repository. Agile Collaboration: Experience working in Agile/Scrum sprint environments collaborating with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Frontend Developers. Must Have Skill Advanced Business Analysis - Gen AI Good to Have Skill Other Requirements . Candidate Evaluation Matrix (For Technical Interview Panels) Technical interviewers should evaluate candidates across the following five core technical engineering competencies: Evaluation Area Competency Focus Key Technical Signals RAG Architecture & Retrieval Chunking strategies, vector search, hybrid retrieval, and re-ranking Explains concrete trade-offs between chunk sizes; demonstrates practical experience with hybrid search (BM25 + vector) and cross-encoders to improve recall. Agentic Loops & Tool Calling Function calling, stateful graphs, and error recovery mechanisms Can code and debug an agent with deterministic tool use; understands state management in LangGraph; handles schema parsing errors gracefully. Prompt Engineering & Parsing Few-shot prompting, structured JSON schema validation (Pydantic) Demonstrates advanced prompting techniques (ReAct, CoT); knows how to force LLMs to emit valid JSON schemas reliably using Instructor or Outlines. Backend & Microservice APIs FastAPI, asynchronous streaming, connection pooling, and Docker Comfortably writes async Python endpoints streaming tokens via SSE; explains how to containerize an application and manage GPU/CPU resource constraints. Evaluation & LLMOps Guardrails Synthetic benchmarking, hallucination metrics, and guardrail layers Articulates how to evaluate an LLM app using Ragas or TruLens; explains how NeMo Guardrails or regex/semantic filters prevent prompt injections.

jobs.title: Senior Developer (DPO)
jobs.description: Job Summary We are seeking a talented, technically passionate Generative AI Engineer with 3+ years of professional software engineering and applied AI/ML experience to design, build, and deploy production-grade LLM applications. In this hands-on engineering role, you will turn the latest advancements in generative artificial intelligence into resilient, scalable business solutions. You will specialize in constructing Advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, engineering autonomous agents with deterministic tool-calling capabilities, optimizing prompt workflows, experimenting with parameter-efficient model adaptation (LoRA/QLoRA), and serving high-performance inference APIs via containerized microservices hosted on AWS or Microsoft Azure. Key Responsibilities Key Responsibilities & Core Engineering Mandates A. RAG Architecture & Vector Search Engineering RAG Pipeline Development: Design and implement end-to-end RAG pipelines incorporating multi-modal document parsing, recursive text splitting, and semantic chunking. Vector Store Management: Integrate, optimize, and benchmark vector databases (Pinecone, Qdrant, Chroma, Weaviate, pgvector, Azure AI Search) for sub-second similarity search. Hybrid Search & Re-ranking: Implement hybrid retrieval combining dense vector embeddings with sparse lexical keyword matching (BM25) and cross-encoder re-ranking models (Cohere Rerank, BGE). Context Optimization: Engineer contextual compression, parent-document retrieval, and metadata filtering schemas to eliminate context noise and hallucinations. B. Agentic Workflows & Multi-Tool Integration Agentic Frameworks: Build stateful multi-agent workflows and autonomous task execution loops using LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or AutoGen. Tool Calling & Action APIs: Develop robust, type-safe function-calling and tool-use interfaces connecting LLMs to external REST APIs, relational databases, and enterprise systems. Loop Safeguards & Routing: Implement plan-and-solve agent patterns, multi-step reflection loops, and fallback error-handling to prevent infinite agent recursion. C. Prompt Engineering, Output Validation & Fine-Tuning Prompt Engineering: Design and test systematic prompt templates utilizing Chain-of-Thought (CoT), Few-Shot prompting, ReAct patterns, and directional stimulus prompting. Structured Output Parsing: Enforce deterministic, validated output structures using Pydantic, Instructor, Guidance, or Outlines to guarantee reliable downstream ingestion. Model Adaptation: Conduct Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA) on open-weights models (Llama 3, Mistral, Phi-3/4) for domain-specific tasks. D. Backend API & Inference Microservices Inference APIs (FastAPI): Develop high-throughput asynchronous backend microservices using Python (FastAPI), managing connection pooling, concurrency, and rate limiting. Streaming Latency: Implement low-latency streaming inference pipelines utilizing Server-Sent Events (SSE) and WebSockets for conversational user interfaces. Inference Engines: Optimize inference throughput utilizing modern serving engines like vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or Ollama, minimizing Time-to-First-Token (TTFT). Containerized Deployment: Containerize applications with Docker and configure deployment manifests for Kubernetes, AWS ECS/EKS, or Azure Container Apps. E. Evaluation, Guardrails & LLMOps Observability Automated Model Evaluation: Establish automated evaluation benchmarks utilizing synthetic test datasets and evaluation harnesses (Ragas, TruLens, DeepEval) to quantify faithfulness and recall. AI Guardrails & Safety: Implement enterprise guardrails (NeMo Guardrails, Llama Guard, Azure Content Safety) to proactively mitigate prompt injection, jailbreaks, and toxicity. Observability & Tracing: Integrate comprehensive LLM tracing, prompt versioning, and cost monitoring using tools like Langfuse, Phoenix, or Weights & Biases Skill Requirements Total Experience: Minimum 3+ years of professional software engineering / data science experience, with at least 1.5+ years of dedicated hands-on GenAI / LLM development. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or equivalent technical field. Python & ML Foundations: Advanced Python programming skills (asyncio, type hints, Pydantic, pytest) and deep familiarity with PyTorch or Hugging Face Transformers. GenAI Frameworks: Extensive hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, and commercial/open foundation model APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock). Vector Search & RAG: Proven track record building and deploying production RAG architectures using vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Qdrant, pgvector). Backend & Containers: Hands-on proficiency developing asynchronous REST APIs using FastAPI, Docker containerization, and Git-based collaborative workflows. Core Competencies: Strong analytical problem-solving skills, solid understanding of transformer architecture mechanics, and proactive technical curiosity. 4. Preferred Qualifications & Industry Certifications Inference Optimization: Hands-on experience with model quantization (GGUF, AWQ, GPTQ) and high-throughput inference serving engines (vLLM, TGI, TensorRT-LLM). Cloud Certifications: Cloud AI certifications: AWS Certified AI Practitioner / ML Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102), or Azure AI Fundamentals. Open Source & Portfolio: Demonstrated contributions to open-source GenAI projects, LangChain/LlamaIndex community plugins, or active technical blog/GitHub repository. Agile Collaboration: Experience working in Agile/Scrum sprint environments collaborating with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Frontend Developers. 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) & Success Benchmarks Success and engineering performance in this role will be measured against the following technical benchmarks: 1. Retrieval Accuracy: RAG Faithfulness & Retrieval Relevance: Achieving 90% ground-truth accuracy and minimal hallucination scores on benchmark evaluation datasets. 2. Low Latency: Inference Latency SLAs: Maintaining p95 streaming Time-to-First-Token (TTFT) < 800ms and total request latency within defined application budgets. 3. Security & Safety: System Robustness & Guardrails: Zero critical prompt injection bypasses or unauthorized data leakage incidents in production environments. 4. Engineering Quality: Code Quality & Test Coverage: Delivering modular, well-documented code with 80% automated unit/integration test coverage across API endpoints. 5. Delivery Velocity: Sprint Execution Velocity: Consistently completing committed sprint stories and technical spikes on schedule with minimal defect slippage Must Have Skill Advanced Business Analysis - Gen AI Good to Have Skill Other Requirements

In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape the future of AI technology and make a significant impact on our organization. As the Senior Manager, you will be responsible for designing and implementing innovative AI solutions, from selecting foundation models to engineering agentic loops. Your expertise will be crucial in translating complex business problems into efficient and scalable AI-powered systems. Responsibilities: Own the end-to-end technical architecture of AI solutions, ensuring seamless integration and optimal performance. Select and evaluate foundation models for various AI applications, considering their suitability and potential impact. Design context layers that enhance the performance and adaptability of AI systems in different scenarios. Engineer agentic loops to enable autonomous decision-making and problem-solving capabilities in AI agents. Collaborate closely with product and business teams to understand their needs and translate them into effective AI solutions. Conduct rigorous harness testing to ensure the reliability and robustness of AI systems before deployment. Implement robust production observability practices to monitor and optimize AI systems in real-world environments. Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI (GenAI), and Agentic AI. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to a team of AI engineers, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous learning. Qualifications: A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is required, with a master's degree preferred. Minimum 10 years of experience in AI engineering, with a proven track record of designing and implementing large-scale AI systems. Deep expertise in AI architecture, including foundation model selection, context-layer design, and agentic loop engineering. Hands-on experience with harness testing and production observability practices for AI systems. Strong understanding of cloud technologies and their integration with AI solutions. Familiarity with cutting-edge AI technologies such as LLMs, GenAI, and Agentic AI is highly desirable. Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to translate complex business problems into technical AI solutions. Effective communication and collaboration skills to work closely with cross-functional teams. Ability to lead and mentor a team, fostering a positive and innovative work environment. Passion for staying updated with the latest advancements in AI and a commitment to continuous learning.

jobs.title: Data Engineer – Databricks & dbt
jobs.description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Your Role As a Data Engineer – Databricks & dbt at Kyndryl, you will design, build, and optimize modern data platforms that enable organizations to transform data into actionable insights. You will leverage your expertise in Databricks, dbt, cloud data technologies, and data engineering best practices to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-performing data solutions. You will work with large-scale structured and unstructured datasets, developing robust data pipelines, transformation frameworks, and data models that support analytics, reporting, artificial intelligence, and business transformation initiatives. By ensuring data quality, accessibility, and operational excellence, you will help organizations maximize the value of their data assets. Join Kyndryl and gain the trust, autonomy, and collaboration needed to help build the next generation of data-driven solutions. What You Will Do Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines using Databricks and dbt to ingest, transform, and process data from multiple enterprise sources. Build and optimize ELT frameworks that support enterprise analytics, reporting, machine learning, and AI-driven use cases. Develop and manage dbt models, macros, tests, documentation, and deployment processes to ensure trusted and reusable datasets. Design and implement modern Lakehouse architectures leveraging Databricks, Delta Lake, and cloud-native data services. Create semantic data layers and business-ready datasets that enable self-service analytics and data-driven decision-making. Implement data quality frameworks, automated testing, and monitoring solutions to ensure accuracy, reliability, and consistency across data products. Collaborate with data architects, analysts, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to understand requirements and deliver scalable solutions. Optimize data platform performance, query execution, storage efficiency, and processing costs using Databricks best practices. Build, deploy, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate the development, testing, and release of data engineering solutions. Support production environments through monitoring, troubleshooting, incident resolution, and continuous improvement initiatives. Adhere to engineering best practices, including Agile development, version control, code reviews, testing, and documentation standards. If you are passionate about modern data engineering, cloud technologies, Databricks, and dbt, this is the role for you. You will work alongside talented professionals on innovative projects that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data and accelerate digital transformation. Your Future at Kyndryl As a Data Engineer – Databricks & dbt, you will collaborate closely with data architects, analytics teams, cloud engineers, AI specialists, and business leaders to solve complex data challenges. Whether you aspire to become a Senior Data Engineer, Data Architect, Analytics Engineer, Data Platform Specialist, or Engineering Lead, Kyndryl provides the opportunities, mentorship, and resources to accelerate your professional growth and help shape the future of data and cloud technologies. Who You Are You're good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally important, you have a growth mindset and are committed to continuous learning and professional development. You are customer-focused, passionate about building scalable data solutions, and thrive in collaborative, fast-paced environments. You enjoy solving complex data challenges and delivering high-quality, production-grade data products that drive business value. Required Technical and Professional Expertise 5+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, with a strong track record of designing, developing, and supporting production-grade data platforms and solutions. Expert-level experience with dbt Core , including project structuring, model development, macros, tests, documentation, source management, CI/CD integration, and production troubleshooting. Strong hands-on experience with the Databricks Lakehouse Platform , including Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Workflows, and performance optimization techniques. Advanced proficiency in SQL , including complex transformations, query optimization, dimensional modeling, partitioning strategies, and large-scale data processing. Strong experience designing and implementing data warehouse solutions , including SCD Type 1 and Type 2 dimensional models, fact and dimension tables, and enterprise reporting layers. Proficiency in Python for data ingestion, automation, orchestration, and pipeline development. Experience developing and supporting data ingestion frameworks utilizing REST APIs, SFTP, SQL databases, cloud storage platforms, and various file formats. Experience implementing and enforcing data quality, testing, governance, lineage, and security controls using Databricks Unity Catalog and dbt testing frameworks. Strong understanding of cloud-based data platforms and services, including Azure Storage Accounts, Azure SQL Database, Azure Functions, and Azure Data Factory. Experience building and supporting CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions , including automated testing, deployment, and release management. Strong understanding of cloud fundamentals, including object storage, compute services, secret management, monitoring, and security best practices. Experience collaborating with DevOps, Data Engineering, Analytics, and Business teams in global delivery environments. Preferred Technical and Professional Experience Experience working in multi-cloud environments such as Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Experience with dlt (Data Load Tool) or other modern data ingestion frameworks. Knowledge of modern data governance, metadata management, and enterprise data catalog strategies. Strong understanding of Databricks Lakehouse architecture and enterprise-scale deployment patterns. Experience with advanced Python concepts including Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), decorators, multi-threading, and performance optimization techniques. Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform . Experience integrating Power BI with Databricks and optimizing semantic models and reporting performance. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred! If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

This role is about building, deploying, and operating cloud applications on SAP BTP, and evolving them into intelligent systems through rapid prototyping and production hardening. Build responsive UI components using SAPUI5 (XML views, controllers, MVC approach) and integrate with backend APIs for data display and write-back flows. 3) Data Modeling & Persistence Foundations Design database artifacts and data models (tables/views/entities/relationships) and connect applications to SAP HANA-based persistence patterns used in BTP app development scenarios. 4) Platform Setup & Deployment Engineering Configure subaccounts/service instances/roles and set up development spaces configure connectivity artifacts (e.g., destinations) for integrating external APIs and databases as part of application delivery. Package and deploy applications using multi-target application (MTA) style deployment artifacts where applicable. 5) AI Native Application Patterns (Agentic + LLM Integrated) (Build expectation) Implement LLM-integrated features as part of BTP applications (e.g., assistant in the workflow ), including: tool calling, orchestration, memory/state handling, and safe action boundaries.
