Create evaluation loops (offline test sets + online monitoring) so AI behavior changes are measurable and regressions are caught early. 6) Engineering Excellence (Quality, DevOps, Collaboration) Use Git-based workflows for source control and collaboration, and operate in Agile/Scrum delivery models. Debug and resolve backend/database/service exposure issues encountered during full-stack delivery. Strong software engineering fundamentals (clean code, testing mindset, CI/CD orientation) and ability to move from prototype to production (AI native expectation). Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills Practical exposure to common BTP app-dev tooling and patterns used in delivery environments (e.g., SAP Business Application Studio usage in full-stack build contexts). Familiarity with structured learning paths such as BTP Application Development (training listing) and bootcamp-style enablement. Awareness of platform building blocks and guidelines referenced in community materials like SAP BTP Developer s Guide . What This Role Does Not Center On Not limited to AI-assisted development only this role owns AI behavior in the product (orchestration, grounding, evaluation, safety boundaries) as part of delivery (AI native expectation). Not focused on training foundation models from scratch emphasis is on building agentic applications integrated with enterprise services. Value Delivered Rapid delivery of cloud applications on SAP BTP with full-stack rigor (platform + backend + UI + deployment). Higher-impact solutions by embedding agentic AI capabilities into business workflows while maintaining engineering discipline and operational reliability (AI native expectation). jobs.title: Technology Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Project Role : Technology Platform Engineer Project Role Description : Creates production and non-production cloud environments using the proper software tools such as a platform for a project or product. Deploys the automation pipeline and automates environment creation and configuration. Must have skills : SAP HANA DB Administration Good to have skills : NA Minimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary AI Powered Tech Talent Build and operate AI native, mission critical SAP HANA database platforms by combining deep SAP HANA database administration expertise with agentic AI capabilities (LLMs + tools + retrieval + evaluation). This role focuses on intelligent, autonomous ready database operations—predicting issues before impact, automating corrective actions, optimizing performance continuously, and enabling self healing behaviors—while ensuring security, reliability, and compliance across enterprise landscapes. Core Responsibilities 1) SAP HANA Database Administration & Lifecycle Management Administer SAP HANA databases across development, quality, and production environments. Perform installation, configuration, upgrades, patches, revisions, and database migrations with minimal disruption. Manage database start/stop, system replication, backups, restores, and recovery operations. 2) Performance Tuning & Resource Optimization Monitor and tune HANA memory, CPU, disk, and I/O utilization to meet performance SLAs. Analyze expensive statements, execution plans, and workload patterns to identify and resolve bottlenecks. Optimize data distribution, partitioning, and table management strategies. 3) High Availability, Backup & Disaster Recovery Implement and operate HANA system replication, backup, and recovery strategies aligned with business RTO/RPO objectives. Regularly test failover and recovery procedures to ensure operational readiness. Design resilient database configurations that minimize downtime and data loss. 4) Security, Compliance & Data Protection Enforce database level security: users, roles, privileges, encryption, auditing, and secure connectivity. Support regulatory and compliance requirements through controlled configurations and traceable operations. Implement data protection and privacy controls for sensitive enterprise data. 5) AI Native Database Operations (Intelligent DBA) Build database operations agents that analyze telemetry (metrics, logs, alerts, SQL behavior) to: o Detect anomalies and early warning signs of degradation. o Recommend or execute pre approved tuning and corrective actions (cleanup, reorganization, parameter adjustments). Use retrieval grounded intelligence drawing from runbooks, historical incidents, configuration baselines, and performance guides to ensure AI recommendations are accurate and auditable. Enable conversational diagnostics for DBAs and architects (e.g., why is memory usage spiking , what changed after the last deployment ). 6) Predictive Monitoring & Self Healing Patterns Implement predictive alerting for capacity exhaustion, performance regression, and instability. Design self healing workflows with safeguards: automated remediation, verification checks, rollback logic, and human approvals for high impact actions. Continuously improve detection and remediation accuracy using feedback loops. 7) Quality Engineering & Evaluation Loops (DB + AI) Define KPIs for database health, stability, and AI effectiveness (false alerts, tuning accuracy, MTTR reduction). Establish evaluation harnesses using simulated incidents, golden configurations, and historical workloads. Continuously refine AI prompts, tools, and automation logic based on real production outcomes. 8) Collaboration & Platform Evolution Partner with Basis, application, integration, and infrastructure teams to ensure end to end system reliability. Support platform modernization initiatives including cloud, hybrid, and multi region HANA deployments. Maintain clear operational documentation and enablement for sustainable operations. Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have) Strong hands on expertise in SAP HANA database administration. Deep understanding of HANA internals: memory management, persistence, performance tuning, and replication. Proven experience operating high availability, business critical database environments. AI native capability: tool augmented automation, retrieval grounded diagnostics, evaluation loops, and safe action boundaries. Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills Experience with SAP HANA on cloud and hybrid infrastructures. Familiarity with monitoring, observability, and automation frameworks used in enterprise database operations. Knowledge of enterprise security, compliance, and data protection standards. Scripting or automation skills to support operational tooling. What This Role Does Not Center On Training or fine tuning foundation AI models. Reactive, manual database administration without intelligence or automation. Value Delivered Highly available and high performance SAP HANA databases through predictive, AI driven administration. Faster incident resolution and reduced operational effort via intelligent automation and grounded diagnostics. Scalable, future ready database platforms supporting enterprise and AI workloads with strong governance. Additional Information A 15 years full time education is required 15 years full time education

jobs.title: Custom Software Engineer
jobs.description: Project Role : Custom Software Engineer Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs. Must have skills : SAP BTP Integration Suite Good to have skills : NA Minimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary AI Powered Tech Talent. Build AI native, enterprise integration products on SAP BTP Integration Suite by combining strong integration engineering fundamentals with agentic AI patterns (LLMs + tools + retrieval + evaluation). The role focuses on creating and operating production-grade integrations across cloud, on premise, and hybrid landscapes—while augmenting the integration lifecycle with intelligent capabilities such as automated iFlow generation, mapping recommendations, anomaly detection, predictive operations, and conversational troubleshooting. This role owns AI behavior in the integration layer (grounding, safety, evaluation), not just AI-assisted development. Core Responsibilities 1) Integration Engineering (Cloud, Hybrid, On Prem) Design, develop, and run end-to-end integration scenarios using cloud integration capabilities, enabling reliable connectivity across SAP and non SAP systems. Build, structure, and manage large integration flows with clear modularity, reusability, and maintainability for enterprise scale. 2) Integration Flow Development (iFlows) & Message Transformation Create and maintain integration flows using routing, splitting, gathering, and other transformation patterns. Implement message mappings and data transformations for common enterprise formats (e.g., JSON, XML, CSV), ensuring semantic correctness and downstream compatibility. Apply canonical modeling and contract-first practices to reduce brittle point-to-point dependencies. 3) Scripting, Persistence & Advanced Flow Control Use scripting (e.g., Groovy) to implement complex transformation logic, enrichment, validation, and conditional execution paths. Implement message persistence patterns (e.g., data stores) to support idempotency, retries, correlation, and resilience. 4) API & Connector Enablement Design and expose secure APIs through API management capabilities (policies, authentication/authorization, throttling, versioning). Integrate with third party applications using connector-based approaches and standardized integration patterns. Enable event-driven integration approaches using messaging/event capabilities for near real-time propagation and decoupled architectures. 5) AI Native Integration Intelligence (Agentic Integration Layer) Build integration agents that can generate initial iFlows from system/endpoint selections and naming conventions, then validate them against enterprise standards. Implement retrieval-grounded assistance that pulls from interface catalogs, mapping specs, standards, runbooks, and known incident patterns to produce verifiable recommendations (no free-form guessing). Apply intelligent recommendations for mapping and configuration, accelerating build and reducing rework. Develop AI-driven anomaly detection and prediction for integration/API behavior (error spikes, latency patterns), with human-in-the-loop controls for remediation actions. Optimize and analyze scripts used in integration flows for performance and maintainability through AI-assisted code analysis techniques. 6) Testing, Quality Engineering & Evaluation Loops Build automated testing strategies for integrations: schema/contract validation, payload regression suites, replay testing, and API testing tool-driven verification. Implement AI evaluation harnesses (offline golden test sets + online monitoring) for generated mappings, generated flows, and operational recommendations. Establish release gates for both integration changes and AI prompt/tool updates to prevent silent degradation. 7) Monitoring, Troubleshooting & Observability Set up monitoring dashboards and alerts for flows, APIs, and event-driven pipelines establish traceability with correlation IDs and end-to-end tracking. Diagnose and resolve integration issues using structured logs, message traces, and failure-mode analysis. Create AI-native operational experiences such as conversational root-cause analysis, runbook-guided remediation, and impact analysis—bounded by role-based access and approval workflows. 8) Integration Strategy & Maturity Enablement Apply integration advisory practices to design hybrid integration platforms and define integration best practices across teams. Use integration assessment approaches to improve integration maturity, standardize patterns, and automate repeatable architectural governance where feasible. Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have) Strong hands-on expertise with SAP BTP Integration Suite concepts and building blocks (cloud integration/iFlows, transformation patterns, monitoring). Proven ability to implement message mappings, routing patterns, and transformation logic across enterprise data formats. Practical scripting capability (e.g., Groovy) for advanced integration flow customization and performance tuning. Solid API design and management fundamentals (security, throttling, lifecycle/versioning, observability). AI-native delivery capability: tool-augmented workflows, retrieval-grounded outputs, measurable evaluation loops, and safe action boundaries. Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills Event-driven integration design and enterprise messaging patterns. Connector-based integrations with third-party SaaS ecosystems. Migration and modernization experience from legacy integration platforms to cloud integration. Integration governance and advisory methodologies for enterprise-wide standardization. What This Role Does Not Center On Training or fine-tuning foundation models from scratch. AI-assisted only integration work this role builds and owns AI behavior in the integration layer (grounding, evaluation, guardrails, observability). Value Delivered Faster integration delivery via intelligent flow generation, mapping recommendations, and script optimization. Higher reliability and lower run cost via anomaly detection, predictive operations, and grounded troubleshooting. Scalable integration landscapes through standardized patterns, governance, and maturity enablement. Additional Information A 15 years full time education is required 15 years full time education

Core Responsibilities 1) Enterprise Integration Engineering (PO/PI Core) Design and deliver end-to-end integrations across SAP and non SAP systems using PO/PI runtime capabilities. Build interface contracts (message types, service interfaces), implement routing, transformation, enrichment, correlation, and exception handling patterns. Develop and maintain integration artifacts in the repository and configuration layers, ensuring consistency and reusability. 2) Adapter & Connectivity Development Implement integrations using common enterprise adapters (e.g., IDoc, RFC, File/SFTP, HTTP/REST, SOAP, JDBC, JMS, Mail) depending on landscape requirements. Engineer secure connectivity patterns (certificates, credentials, encryption) and define transport-level controls aligned to enterprise policies. 3) Mapping & Transformation Engineering Build message mappings and operation mappings for complex transformation needs, including context-based routing, reusable mapping functions, and XSLT where required. Implement advanced transformation logic using Java mappings or script-based approaches when standard mappings are insufficient. Design canonical payloads to reduce point-to-point complexity and support long-term maintainability. 4) API Development & API-Led Integration Design, build, and expose APIs for integration consumption with a focus on contract-first design, versioning strategy, and backward compatibility. Implement policies for security, throttling, validation, and observability enable consistent API governance across teams. Support API testing and lifecycle automation through robust test harnesses and environment promotion practices. 5) Testing, Debugging & Quality Engineering Create integration test strategies covering contract tests, schema validation, payload regression, replay testing, and negative scenarios. Use API testing tools and structured logs/traces to debug and resolve integration defects across layers (connectivity, mapping, runtime, downstream dependencies). Maintain technical documentation (specs, mappings, test cases, runbooks) as part of delivery and handover. 6) Monitoring, Operations & Reliability Monitor interfaces, queues, and runtime health implement alerting and dashboards aligned to SLAs and operational KPIs. Build failure-mode handling (retries, reprocessing, dead-letter/error queues, idempotency patterns) to reduce incident frequency and mean-time-to-recover. Perform root-cause analysis and implement preventive fixes to improve stability over time. 7) AI Native Integration Intelligence (Agentic Integration Layer) Build integration agents that can: o Draft interface specifications and mapping proposals from requirements and standards. o Generate initial mapping logic and routing templates, then validate against enterprise patterns. o Recommend remediation steps grounded in runbooks, prior incidents, and observed runtime signals. Implement retrieval-grounded assistance for integration engineering (interface catalogs, mapping rules, known errors, operational runbooks) so outputs stay verifiable and consistent. Establish evaluation loops (offline golden tests + online monitoring) to measure accuracy of AI-generated mappings, recommendations, and troubleshooting outputs. Enforce guardrails: tool permissions, human-in-the-loop approvals for high-impact changes, and strict handling of sensitive data. 8) Modernization & Transition Enablement Support modernization from legacy or tightly-coupled integrations toward API-led and cloud-ready patterns while keeping business continuity. Refactor legacy mappings (e.g., complex Java mappings) into maintainable equivalents where required, improving performance and operability. API engineering fundamentals: contract-first design, versioning, security policies, observability, and testing. AI-native build capability: tool-augmented workflows, retrieval-grounded outputs, measurable evaluation loops, and safe action boundaries. Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills Java-based mapping development and advanced transformation techniques (including XSLT where applicable). Exposure to hybrid integration landscapes and migration from legacy integration styles to modern API-led approaches. Strong documentation and operational readiness practices (runbooks, knowledge base, incident patterns). Familiarity with cloud integration concepts to support coexistence and transition strategies. What This Role Does Not Center On Training or fine-tuning foundation models from scratch. AI-assisted only integration work this role builds and owns AI behavior in the integration lifecycle (grounding, evaluation, guardrails, observability). Improved reliability through robust testing, observability, and AI-augmented incident response with strict governance. Scalable integration modernization by evolving PO/PI estates toward API-led, reusable, and maintainable integration products. jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description: About the Team The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes , not just a platform. You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how." Role Description As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption. You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production. This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset. The impact you will have C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline. End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against. Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early. Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution. Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering. What we look for Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions. Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome. Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions. Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting. Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery. About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram. Benefits At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. Join Deloitte's Cyber Cloud AI Security team and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide. Work you’ll do As a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant, you will lead and support client engagements focused on securing AI, generative AI, and ML workloads across cloud platforms. You will bring deep experience across cloud security, AI security architecture, governance, compliance, platform controls, and monitoring to help clients design, assess, and implement secure AI capabilities at scale. You will be expected to contribute to solutioning and client delivery, and provide actionable recommendations across the AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, model development, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, and retraining. Responsibilities as a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant will include: Drive the design and implementation of AI security solutions within cloud environments aligned to client business objectives, enterprise architecture, regulatory expectations, and security requirements. Execute AI security assessments for cloud-hosted AI/ML and GenAI workloads, evaluating controls against frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001. Define and implement AI security controls across identity, access, network segmentation, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and secure configuration management. Support threat modeling and security architecture reviews for AI and GenAI solutions, including risks related to prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, sensitive data exposure, model misuse, and insecure tool or connector usage. Design and review secure AI architectures spanning model endpoints, APIs, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, vector stores, plugins, agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and external tool integrations. Support secure deployment and configuration of cloud-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI. Implement and review platform-specific controls such as private connectivity, encryption with customer-managed keys, tenant isolation, access restrictions, content safety controls, and service-native logging and monitoring capabilities. Drive DevSecOps, MLOps, and MLSecOps integration efforts by embedding policy validation, secrets handling, secure model promotion, compliance checks, and security testing into CI/CD and ML pipelines. Define and implement secure AI lifecycle controls across data ingestion, model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, incident response, drift review, and retraining, including protections against data poisoning, model tampering, and supply-chain risk. Support AI governance and compliance activities including model inventory, risk classification, approval workflows, traceability, documentation standards, and control mapping aligned to NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001. Support clients in implementing responsible AI and model governance controls related to data protection, access control, model usage restrictions, prompt security, content filtering, and audit readiness. Execute AI security posture management efforts using cloud-native tooling, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, and related controls to identify misconfiguration, data exposure, anomalous model activity, and policy violations. Support AI-specific monitoring and incident response by helping define detections, alerts, escalation paths, and remediation activities for suspicious prompt behavior, agent abuse, unauthorized model access, and sensitive data leakage. Conduct or support AI security testing activities including misuse-case testing, control validation, prompt attack testing, model guardrail validation, and red-team support for AI-enabled applications. Work directly with client stakeholders across security, cloud engineering, DevOps, data, ML engineering, privacy, risk, and architecture teams to translate requirements into implementable designs and remediation plans. The team Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory’s Cyber Risk Services practice. Required: 7+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity consulting, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or closely related disciplines. Demonstrated experience leading or owning workstreams in client-facing security engagements. Experience designing, assessing, or implementing security controls for cloud-hosted applications, platforms, or AI/ML environments. Strong hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform and working knowledge of the other leading platforms: AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud. Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI security concepts, including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage, secure model access, agent security, and responsible AI fundamentals. Experience implementing cloud security controls across IAM, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement. Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Bash, and PowerShell. Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices, including policy validation, secrets handling, and continuous compliance. Familiarity with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, Mythos, Anthropic, and Vertex AI. Familiarity with AI governance and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Preferred: Experience conducting AI security assessments, architecture reviews, control design, and remediation programs across AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud. Deep hands-on experience with identity and access management, including AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and Google Cloud IAM. Experience designing governance and guardrails for cloud AI environments using services such as AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, Azure Policy, Security Command Center, and equivalent policy enforcement capabilities. Experience with cloud-native monitoring and security tooling such as AWS Security Hub, CloudTrail, AWS Config, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and Google Security Command Center. Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, vulnerability management, container security, and posture management tools supporting AI workloads. Experience with prompt security, content safety, model guardrails, and AI runtime monitoring for generative AI applications. Exposure to AI red teaming, misuse-case testing, prompt attack validation, or adversarial testing of LLM-enabled applications. Experience securing containerized, API-driven, and agent-based AI applications. Knowledge of privacy, legal, and data governance considerations relevant to AI workloads, including data residency, retention, sensitive data handling, and auditability. Experience establishing AI governance processes such as AI inventory, model classification, approval gates, traceability, and documentation aligned to AI risk management practices. Relevant certifications such as: AWS Certified Security – Specialty Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate Google Cloud Certified – Professional Cloud Security Engineer Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate Google Cloud Certified – Professional Machine Learning Engineer AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01) CISSP, CCSP, or comparable senior security certifications Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple client priorities independently. Enhance Monitoring Tools : Build and improve tools for monitoring and mitigating site incidents, and conduct reliability audits and tests to strengthen eBay’s reliability and incident management capabilities. Incident Management : Act as Incident Commander to drive resolution of major incidents, manage alarms, and ensure effective communication with leadership and partner teams. What you will bring: 4+ years of professional experience in software engineering, ideally in backend or platform teams Proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., Java, Go, Python) Strong incident management and leadership skills, with excellent technical triage and troubleshooting abilities, especially during crises. Familiarity with cloud platforms, container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes), and infrastructure-as-code tools Experience with observability stacks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry) Strong interpersonal and communication skills to thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 18 of the Fortune 50 companies, 7 of the 10 top US banks, 9 of the 10 technology companies, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem. We have delivered 26 sequential quarters of growth with $487.6M in Q2 FY27 revenue, up 7.8% Q-o-Q and 20.0% Y-o-Y. Our 29,500+ global team members, located in 21 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We received five awards at the ISG (Information Services Group) Provider Lens™ Awards 2026 and, for the second year in a row, were awarded the Growth Honor of the Year at the Everest Group Elevate 2026. About Position: We are looking for a senior C/C++ systems programming professional with more than 10 years of experience to develop and support security features for Linux-based products. The role will focus on implementing SSL/TLS, IPSec, SAML authentication, PKI, and certificate lifecycle management, along with HTTP/HTTPS REST APIs and core Linux system-programming capabilities. The position also includes reviewing code contributed in these areas and supporting feature development and customer-reported issues. Role: Cybersecurity Engineer Location: Pune, Bengaluru Experience: 10 to 15 Years Job Type: Full-Time Employment What You'll Do: Implement security features including SSL/TLS, IPSec, SAML authentication, PKI, and certificate lifecycle management. Design, develop, and maintain security-related components using C/C++ on Linux operating systems. Develop and integrate HTTP/HTTPS REST APIs for secure communication and management functions. Apply Linux system-programming concepts, including pthreads, inter-process communication (IPC), process management, and synchronization. Review code from all contributors working in these technical areas and ensure adherence to quality, security, and coding standards. Contribute to feature development across security, authentication, certification, and system-programming modules. Investigate and resolve customer-reported issues in these areas, including debugging, root-cause analysis, and delivering reliable fixes. Collaborate with engineering, architecture, QA, and customer-support teams to deliver secure and production-ready solutions. Expertise You'll Bring: Experience: More than 10 years of relevant software development and system programming experience. C/C++ Programming: C/C++ is a mandatory skill, with strong hands-on experience developing production-grade system software. Security Protocols: Strong experience with SSL/TLS and IPSec, including implementation, integration, troubleshooting, and secure configuration. Web Services: Hands-on experience with HTTP/HTTPS and REST APIs. PKI and Certification: Strong knowledge of PKI, digital certificates, certificate validation, and certificate lifecycle management. Linux System Programming: Strong experience with Linux OS system programming, including pthreads, IPC, process management, synchronization, and related concepts. Authentication: Experience implementing SAML authentication. Good to Have: Experience with OAuth, SNMP, Firewall security policy management, and related security or network-management technologies. Code Review and Support: Ability to review code from multiple contributors and support feature development and customer issues in these areas. Educational Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications, or a related engineering discipline. jobs.description: About the Team Data License is Bloomberg's enterprise data delivery platform, powering financial institutions worldwide with reference, pricing, regulatory, and alternative data — covering over 50 million securities across portfolio accounting, risk, compliance, and trading use cases. The DL Analytics Platform is the intelligence and reliability layer of this ecosystem. We build the data ingestion pipelines, embeddings infrastructure, AI agents, and MCP tool servers that give engineers and LLMs structured, query able access to operational data. Our systems power incident triage, semantic search over tickets and documentation, pipeline health analytics, and self-service data onboarding for partner teams across Data License. We are expanding our engineering presence into Pune and the broader APAC region — a greenfield initiative where engineers will collaborate closely with colleagues in Dublin, London, and New York, helping shape the culture and technical direction of this hub from day one. What's the role? Reliability Engineering: GenAI-powered tooling for incident triage, root-cause analysis, and blast radius assessment — exposing live pipeline data to LLM agents via MCP tool servers. Data Analytics & AI: Ingestion pipelines into Apache Iceberg, semantic search over operational data using vector databases and embedding models, and automated KPI tracking to surface platform health and anomalies. We'll trust you to: Build GenAI tools and AI agents — RAG pipelines, contextual embedding systems, and MCP tool servers that give LLM agents structured access to live pipeline data Build and maintain data ingestion pipelines into Apache Iceberg, orchestrated via Apache Airflow Develop semantic search capabilities using vector databases and hosted embedding models Build self-service ingestion APIs enabling partner teams to onboard to the platform without managing Iceberg or storage infrastructure Design microservices and backend APIs — with opportunities to contribute to React/TypeScript interfaces embedded in production tools Instrument systems with OpenTelemetry and contribute to anomaly detection capabilities on the near-term roadmap Technologies Languages & Frameworks: Python (3.11 / 3.12 / 3.13), TypeScript, FastAPI, React Data & Orchestration: Apache Iceberg, Apache Airflow, PyArrow, PyIceberg, Spark, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Parquet Databases: PostgreSQL, vector databases, Redis, Solr, distributed SQL Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, NGINX, OpenTelemetry Cloud: GCP, AWS (S3, Redshift), Snowflake, Databricks AI & ML: RAG frameworks, embedding models, contextual chunking, semantic search, LLM integration Agent Frameworks: MCP (Model Context Protocol), Agent-to-Agent (A2A) You'll need to have: 6+ Software engineering experience in production environments Proficiency in Python or a similar language Familiarity with relational databases and SQL Interest or experience in data engineering — pipelines, batch processing, or data lake technologies Understanding of distributed systems and service architecture Interest in AI/ML — particularly LLMs, RAG, or embedding-based search We'd love to see: Experience with Apache Iceberg, PyArrow, or data lake engineering Familiarity with Apache Airflow or workflow orchestration Experience with vector databases, embedding models, or semantic search Background in anomaly detection or data quality frameworks Exposure to MCP, A2A, or agent communication protocols Experience with observability tooling — tracing, metrics, structured logging Curiosity about financial data and reliability jobs.title: Software Development Engineer , PaySec, StoreSec
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Come build the future with us! In Payments Security (PaySec), we protect the foundational systems and products that allow Amazon to accept payments for all goods, content, and services that people buy at Amazon and around the world. International Emerging Stores Payments (IESP) brings Amazon's payments products to customers in some of the fastest-growing markets in the world, across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), Asia Pacific (APAC) including India, and South America. These markets run on real-time payment rails such as UPI, on local wallets, cards, bill payments, and lending products, and on regulatory regimes that differ from one country to the next. Every one of those transactions depends on customer trust, and IESP Payments Security exists to earn and keep it. Payments Security owns full-stack Product Security for Payments across Amazon and its business units. We are part of Amazon's broader Stores Security organization, responsible for protecting Amazon's global information assets. We partner with Payments builder teams to make applications and infrastructure secure-by-design from concept to launch and into continuous operations, and we build the mechanisms, guardrails, and automation that let thousands of engineers do the right thing by default. As a software engineer on IESP Payments Security, you will build the software that makes security automatic for Amazon's payments businesses in MENA, APAC including India, and South America. Imagine writing the code that stops a vulnerability before it is merged, or an AI agent that scans hundreds of production applications and finds payment data stored where it should not be. You will work on three kinds of problems. First, controls-as-code: security rules and guardrails that run on every code change, including code written with AI assistance. Second, detection agents: AI-assisted services that find sensitive data, vulnerable patterns, and risky configurations across production. Third, onboarding acquired stacks: tooling that brings newly acquired businesses onto Amazon's standard engineering and security platforms. You will work side by side with security engineers, and your work will show up directly in fewer vulnerabilities and less time builders spend fixing them. You will own features and components end to end, from design through operation, and help mentor newer engineers. Key job responsibilities Design, build, test, deploy, and operate secure, highly available services that handle sensitive payments data. Build controls-as-code and code-creation security rules that catch common vulnerability patterns before code is merged. Build AI-assisted detection agents that find sensitive payment data and vulnerable code patterns across production applications, with high precision. Build tooling that onboards acquired businesses' code, cloud accounts, and pipelines onto Amazon's standard security tooling. Build automated remediation that proposes or writes the fix for a finding, not just flags it, so builders spend minutes instead of days. Meet directly with security engineers and service teams to understand their requirements, and design solutions that make them more productive. Estimate engineering effort, plan implementation, and roll out changes that meet requirements for performance, scalability, and reliability. Work with security engineers to turn threat models and findings into automated mechanisms. Contribute to operational excellence through code reviews, testing, monitoring, and on-call. Mentor other engineers and interns on the team. A day in the life You will spend most of your time building: designing services, writing and reviewing code, and shipping. You will pair with security engineers who bring a threat model or a class of findings, and together you will decide what can be automated and how to measure that it works. You will meet the service teams who use our tools, hear where security slows them down, and fix it. The team runs regular architecture reviews and knowledge shares, and you will learn security from people who do it every day. About the team IESP Payments Security is a single-threaded Business Security Team for all of International Emerging Stores Payments. We are security engineers, technical program managers, and software engineers working as one team. We own security for regulated payments and lending businesses, for acquired companies joining Amazon, and for new markets as they launch. We believe security scales through mechanisms and automation, not headcount. As AI writes more of the code our builders ship, we move security into the moment code is created and replace episodic reviews with continuous assurance. We invest in each other's growth as much as we invest in protecting our customers. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience Experience programming with at least one software programming language 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent, or 3+ years of computer science fundamentals experience (object-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, problem solving, and complexity analysis). PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Master's degree in computer science or equivalent 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language 4+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience Experience with any combination of the following: application security frameworks, identity and access controls, incident response, mobile security, cloud computing and security, AI security, threat intelligence, and penetration testing Knowledge of customer experience, listening to customers' voice and work backwards to improve business process and operations Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further. HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist QORE (Quantitative Oversight Risk and Evaluation) is an internal platform that manages the full lifecycle of quantitative models — from identification and development through validation, approval, and ongoing monitoring. It supports regulatory compliance with the bank’s Three Lines of defense governance model. We’re looking for a engineering lead to design, build, and operate microservices that power critical model risk management workflows used by validators, model owners, and risk committees globally In this role, you will: Design and deliver features across a suite of 8+ Spring Boot microservices using hexagonal architecture (ports & adapters) and CQRS patterns. Build and maintain domain-driven services covering model inventory, validation lifecycle, workflow orchestration, monitoring, and approvals. Implement and evolve BPMN/DMN workflows using Flowable for complex multi-step approval and validation processes. Own inter-service communication via Open Feign clients, ensuring resilience and clean API contracts. Write and maintain database migrations (Liquibase) and optimize PostgreSQL queries across a database-per-service topology. Collaborate with business analysts, model validators, and risk stakeholders to translate regulatory requirements into software. Contribute to platform evolution — service extraction, legacy migration, and architectural improvements. Maintain high code quality through automated testing, SonarQube, and peer review. To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements: 15+ years of backend development in Java (17+, ideally 21). Strong experience with Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, and Spring Cloud. Solid understanding of microservice architecture — service decomposition, API design, inter-service communication patterns. Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL — schema design, query optimization, migrations. Familiarity with CQRS or similar read/write separation patterns.Experience with RESTful API design and OpenAPI/Swagger. Working experience with GCP and GKE — Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, Kubernetes deployments, namespaces, health checks, and Helm charts for release management. Proficiency with Git (trunk-based development, branching strategies, code reviews) and CI/CD pipelines (build, test, deploy automation). Exposure to automated test frameworks such as REST Assured, Playwright, or similar — comfortable writing and maintaining unit, integration, and end-to-end test suites. Experience with Flowable, Camunda, or similar BPMN/DMN workflow engines.Familiarity with hexagonal architecture (ports & adapters) in practice. Exposure to Feign or declarative HTTP clients. Experience with Liquibase or Flyway for schema versioning. Experience with event-driven architecture (Pub/Sub, Kafka). Familiarity with Maven multi-module builds and shared library management. Background in financial services, risk management, or regulatory technology. Understanding of model risk management concepts (model validation, tiering, governance). Experience migrating or modernizing legacy platforms. You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC. www.hsbc.com/careers HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. You Are You have spent the last few years building verification environments that actually close coverage, not just pass tests. Protocols like PCIe, UCIe, or DDR are not abstract specs to you, they are state machines with edge cases you have debugged at the transaction level in Verdi. You write UVM code that other engineers can extend without breaking, and you know the difference between a scoreboard that checks transactions and one that catches the bugs that matter. You think in coverage models and assertions, not just directed tests. When documentation is incomplete or a design decision is still being debated, you ask the right questions and build test plans that close the gaps. At Synopsys, you will work on high-speed interconnect IP that ships in real silicon, and the verification you own keeps bugs out of the lab. What You'll Be Doing Own verification planning and execution for UCIe, PCIe, or DDR IP blocks, translating protocol specs into test plans, checkers, and SystemVerilog Assertions. Build and extend UVM testbenches including agents, sequencers, scoreboards, factories, and coverage models that other engineers will use and maintain. Write constrained-random and directed tests in SystemVerilog, debug failing regressions, and close functional and code coverage using VCS and URG. Perform root-cause analysis on RTL bugs, protocol compliance failures, and testbench issues using Synopsys Verdi for waveform, transaction-level, and protocol debug. Contribute to regression infrastructure, coverage closure strategies, and first-silicon readiness activities. The Impact You Will Have Your verification catches silicon-impacting bugs before tape-out, saving months of respins and lab debug time. The UVM environments you build become reusable across product generations, accelerating time-to-market for future IP releases. Your coverage models and assertions close gaps that design reviews and code inspection miss, improving overall IP quality. The test plans you write become the blueprint for regression suites that run thousands of times across multiple projects. Your debug skills reduce mean-time-to-resolution on critical bugs, unblocking design teams and keeping schedules on track. The protocol expertise you bring strengthens the team's ability to tackle next-generation interconnect standards and customer requirements. What You'll Need B-Tech or M.Tech in Electronics, VLSI, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 2+ years of hands-on ASIC or SoC verification experience with ownership of IP block or subsystem-level verification. Strong working knowledge of at least one high-speed protocol: PCIe, UCIe, or DDR, including link training, state machines, and compliance requirements. Solid UVM methodology experience building agents, sequencers, scoreboards, coverage models, and constrained-random stimulus in SystemVerilog. Proven debug skills using Synopsys Verdi for waveform analysis, transaction-level debug, and protocol-specific investigation. Experience with industry simulators like VCS, Xcelium, or Questa, and familiarity with regression and coverage tools such as URG. Direct experience verifying UCIe PHY, PCIe controllers, or DDR memory controllers is a strong plus, as is familiarity with VIP integration or formal verification. Who You Are You can look at a failing regression, open Verdi, and find the root cause without needing someone to point you to the right signal. You write UVM code that other engineers can read and extend six months later without asking you how it works. You push back when a test plan is too vague or a coverage hole is being ignored, and you do it in a way that moves the conversation forward. within the Systems Solutions Group The Impact You Will Have Enable customers to achieve first-pass silicon success by catching design-for-test issues before tapeout, not during bring-up Reduce production test costs and time-to-market for SoCs powering high-performance computing, automotive, and aerospace systems Build reusable DFT methodologies and best practices that scale across multiple customer projects and design teams Improve test coverage and yield outcomes through architecture decisions that balance area, power, and testability constraints Grow the technical capability of the simulation Influence the development of Synopsys EDA tools and IP by feeding real customer use cases and pain points back to product teams What You'll Need Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field +10 years of hands-on experience in SoC DFT, with proven expertise across scan and ATPG, memory BIST, logic BIST, and analog test Deep jobs.title: Senior Risk Manager, AI Assurance & Inspections, FORGE
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Amazon is seeking a Senior Risk Manager to join the Finance Operations Risk, Governance and Experience (FORGE) team within Finance Operations (FinOps). This is a strategic, high ownership risk leadership role that strengthens Amazon's risk and control environment across complex, global Finance Operations processes. You will operate at the intersection of risk management, internal audit, controllership, process transformation, technology, and business operations. You will assess processes end to end, identify emerging and material risks, evaluate control effectiveness, and partner with stakeholders to design and implement sustainable solutions. This role is built for someone who thrives in ambiguity. The risks are not always obvious, ownership often spans multiple organizations, and the right answer frequently requires connecting data, processes, systems, policies, and controls across the company. You will not just identify problems. You will architect solutions, influence stakeholders, and drive measurable risk reduction. Key job responsibilities Run end-to-end assessments that cover process design, policy, organization structure, systems, AI components, regulatory requirements, and internal controls. Evaluate whether controls are well designed and working, identify control gaps and policy exceptions, quantify their impact, and recommend proportionate mitigation. Assess risks from AI-enabled and agentic automations, including hallucination, model drift, prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agent permissions, bias, and loss of human oversight. Design and test AI-specific controls such as human-in-the-loop approval gates, output validation, least-privilege tool access, traceability, and model performance monitoring. Inspect AI solutions against Amazon security, privacy, and controllership requirements (such as security, privacy, SOX, ITGCs etc.,), and confirm that AI-driven steps have clear ownership, evidence, and auditability. Design, build, and maintain audit agents that continuously monitor process controls, test full transaction populations, and flag anomalies and control failures in near real time. Build and use AI capabilities across the audit lifecycle, and set validation and governance standards so that AI-generated findings are reliable, explainable, and defensible. Own cross-functional risk programs from problem definition through closure, defining success criteria and risk reduction metrics, including coverage and detection metrics for automated monitoring. Partner with Finance, Controllership, Technology, InfoSec, GFRC/SOX, and Internal Audit to drive remediation, support external audit requests, and influence leaders to adopt scalable, AI-enabled controls. A day in the life You will start your morning reviewing overnight alerts from the audit agents that monitor SOX and operational controls, separating true exceptions from noise and escalating confirmed control failures to process owners. Much of your day involves moving between deep analysis and hands-on building. You might lead a pre-launch risk review of a new agentic automation, checking its data access, tool permissions, and human approval points before it goes live. Then you might work with Technology partners to tune an audit agent or extend it to cover a new control. Later, you could walk through a complex process with business owners, using generative AI to speed up documentation and testing, or challenge a remediation plan that fixes the symptom but not the root cause. You will also carve out time to write a concise narrative for senior leadership on emerging AI risks and inspection results, and to look for the next control that can move from periodic sampling to continuous monitoring, so FinOps assurance scales as fast as the business automates. About the team Our team is dedicated to building and scaling risk management programs that keep Amazon's customers and operations protected. We work at the intersection of business, technology, and compliance, partnering across the organization to identify emerging risks and implement practical solutions. We value curiosity, analytical rigor, and collaboration, and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where every team member can grow and contribute. If you want to shape how Amazon approaches risk at scale, this is the team for you. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 7+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level Bachelor's degree or equivalent Experience within financial services and payment institutions Experience managing multiple competing priorities simultaneously and driving goals to completion PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience at consulting firms or equivalent Experience building cross-functional partnerships and influencing stakeholders across the organization to act without having a direct reporting relationship Master's degree or equivalent Experience working with or evaluating AI systems Experience assessing or auditing AI/ML or agentic systems using standards such as NIST and ISO Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

DXC does not make offers of employment via social media networks and DXC never asks for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process, nor ask a job seeker to purchase IT or other equipment on our behalf. More information on employment scams is available here .

Job Summary: Zettle India, part of PayPal's Payment Services and Crypto organization, is hiring a Senior Software Engineer in Test (Sr. SDET). Our POS platform moves real money for merchants every day across mobile apps, cloud services, and card readers. In this hands-on role, you'll lead test strategy and native automation with Espresso and XCUITest for a product that small businesses use every day to take payments. You'll help shape how test engineering works on this platform, with scope that goes well beyond what the title usually buys. If you want the mandate without waiting in line for it, read on — the best is yet to come! In this role, you will work with Android, iOS, and backend developers and product managers to define the test strategy, build and scale automation, set quality gates for releases, and guide the team on testing best practices. The ideal candidate has 5-8 years of experience in test engineering, strong hands-on mobile automation skills, solid Java and framework design skills, and a keen eye for risk in payments products. Meet our team: Zettle is PayPal's point-of-sale and payments product for small businesses. Zettle India is part of the Payment Services and Crypto organization, and our test engineering team supports the Zettle mobile app on Android and iOS and the services behind it. We are a centralized Test and Quality Engineering function actively moving to an automation-first, shift-left culture. You will be joining a growing team and help shape its test strategy, automation framework, and quality standards. You will partner closely with developers and product managers, and mentor engineers in the team. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, with three days a week onsite. Your way to impact: You will be the test engineering voice inside POS feature teams from the earliest stage, authoring journey-level test strategy before development starts and influencing designs before they harden. You'll own suites that gate real merges and keep them trusted, and triage that reaches root cause. When a defect escapes to production, you'll run the escape analysis and land the change that closes the loop between outcome and design. Your impact will be felt in the reliability of the POS product, the maturity of the teams around you, and the standard the whole function is measured against. In your day-to-day role you will be responsible for: Own domain test suite end to end: in CI/CD, gating merges, flake held under target. Lead manual and exploratory testing on real devices, emulators, and simulators across OS versions, screen sizes, and network conditions. jobs.description: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Job Summary: Under summary section Zettle India, part of PayPal's Payment Services and Crypto organization, is hiring a Software Engineer in Test (SDET). Our POS platform moves real money for merchants every day across mobile apps, cloud services, and card readers. In this hands-on role, you'll turn designs into written risk models before code exists, build automated checks that gate real merges, and encode how the payments domain behaves so the knowledge outlives any one person. You'll help shape how test engineering works on a platform where quality is built in, not bolted on. If you'd rather build the thing than maintain it, read on — the best is yet to come! Job Description: Essential Responsibilities: Implements tasks within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), receiving structure and oversight from more experienced staff Follows well-established internal conventions and standard procedures Understands internal standards & processes an applies them to make technical decisions Collaborates with peers, manager, and project lead to gain understanding of tasks and review solutions May contribute to code & design reviews Minimum Qualifications: 1+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications : What you need to know about the role: PayPal POS sits at the heart of how many SMBs run their businesses every day. Card payments, card readers and hardware variance, acquiring, payments SDKs, ledger and financial flows, onboarding and checkout across web and mobile. As a Test Engineer here, you won't hand down verdicts after the fact; you'll build the capability that lets verification happen without you in the room. The engineering discipline bar is the same as any software role: version control, review in both directions, CI, design before implementation, and root-cause debugging by the owner. The Test Engineer will be integral part of the team and takes pride in advocating for the quality of the Zettle mobile app on Android and iOS, along with the backend and web services behind it. Meet our team: Zettle is PayPal's point-of-sale and payments product for small businesses. Zettle India is part of the Payment Services and Crypto organization, and our test engineering team supports the Zettle mobile app on Android and iOS and the services behind it. We are a centralized Test and Quality Engineering function actively moving to an automation-first, shift-left culture. You will be joining a growing team and help shape its test strategy, automation framework, and quality standards. You will partner closely with developers and product managers, and mentor engineers in the team. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, with three days a week onsite. Your way to impact: As a Test Engineer, you will help make sure that merchants can take payments without problems on any device. You will own testing for the features you work on, from test planning to release, and you will help move our testing from manual to automated over time. Your work will reduce production defects, speed up releases, and improve the experience of small businesses that use Zettle every day. You will grow toward a Senior Test Engineer role as you build your technical depth and ownership. In your day-to-day role you will be responsible for: Understand requirements and design test cases, test scenarios, and end-to-end tests for Zettle mobile app features on Android and iOS. Write and merge automated cross-service / interop tests into CI/CD pipelines that gate real merges; debug every failure to root cause. Perform manual and exploratory testing on real devices, emulators, and simulators across OS versions, screen sizes, and network conditions. Test APIs and backend services using Postman or RestAssured and validate data using SQL queries. Run tests on BrowserStack and in CI/CD pipelines (Harness) and analyze failures to find the root cause. Log clear, reproducible defects in JIRA with logs (Logcat, Xcode), screenshots, and screen recordings, and follow them through to closure. Maintain test cases and test runs in TestRail, and report test status and risks to the team. Reduce flaky tests and suggest ideas to improve test coverage, speed, and quality. Exposure to contract testing, mutation testing, or AI-assisted quality practices (AI-generated test case review, test gap analysis) What do you need to bring: 2-4 years of experience in software testing, with at least 1-2 years in mobile (Android and/or iOS) testing. Hands-on experience with Espresso and/or XCUITest, with willingness to learn the other. Good Java programming fundamentals and basic knowledge of data structures. Experience with API testing (Postman, RestAssured) and writing SQL queries. Good understanding of SDLC/STLC, test design, and defect management using JIRA and TestRail. Familiarity with Jenkins, BrowserStack, and debugging tools such as Logcat and the Xcode console. Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work with developers and product managers. Ownership, curiosity, and a willingness to learn. Nice to have: Appium, Kotlin or Swift reading ability, mobile performance testing (Android Profiler, Xcode Instruments), JMeter, AWS, and experience in payments or FinTech. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. Key Responsibilities: 1. Platform & Protocol Architecture. 2. Stablecoin/Tokenization Design & Treasury. 3. Trading, Liquidity & Market Connectivity. 4. Security, Custody & Key Management. 5. Compliance, Risk & Controls. 6. Interoperability & Bridges. 7. Reliability, Observability & DevOps. 8. Leadership & Collaboration. . ͏ Key Responsibilities: 1) Platform & Protocol Architecture Own end-to-end architecture for stablecoin issuance, treasury, and lifecycle (mint/burn, reserves, redemptions, fee mechanics). Select and justify chains/L2s (EVM, Cosmos SDK/IBC, Solana, enterprise/permissioned) and interoperability approaches (native deployment, IBC, cross-chain messaging/bridges). Define smart contract patterns (upgradeability, access control, pausability, circuit breakers), token standards (ERC‑20/677/777/4626), and event schemas. 2) Stablecoin/Tokenization Design & Treasury Design reserve backing model (fiat-backed with custodial attestation, crypto-collateralized, or hybrid) and proof-of-reserves/attestation workflows. Integrate oracles (price, FX, interest rates) with anti‑manipulation controls (deviation thresholds, TWAPs, circuit breakers). Build treasury operations: issuance/redemption flows, fees, rebalancing, settlement windows, liquidity waterfalls, reconciliation. 3) Trading, Liquidity & Market Connectivity Architect connectivity to exchanges (CEX REST/WebSocket/FIX), DEXs (AMM/RFQ), and liquidity providers. Design/guide Smart Order Routing (SOR), execution policies (VWAP/TWAP/IOC), slippage/latency thresholds, fee optimization, and gas-aware routing. Define data pipelines for ticks, order books, trades; ensure market data integrity and replay/simulation environments. 4) Security, Custody & Key Management Lead wallet architecture (hot/warm/cold segregation), MPC/HSM strategy, and key ceremonies with dual control and audit trails. Mandate secure SDLC: threat modeling, formal verification targets, static/dynamic analysis, fuzzing, dependency provenance. Own incident response plans: kill‑switches, circuit breakers, pause & recovery, and post‑mortem processes. 5) Compliance, Risk & Controls Embed KYC/AML, sanctions screening (OFAC), Travel Rule flows, and transaction risk scoring (on-chain analytics). Align with applicable frameworks (e.g., MiCA, FATF recommendations, local VASP regimes). Coordinate with Legal/Compliance on policy-as-code controls. Design auditability (immutable logs, merkleized state proofs, attestations) and data retention. 6) Interoperability & Bridges Evaluate IBC, generalized messaging (e.g., LayerZero), and bridge options (trust assumptions, validator sets, light client models). Define patterns for cross-chain mints/burns, canonical token mapping, replay protection, and exit/rollback strategies. 7) Reliability, Observability & DevOps Establish SLOs/SLIs (issuance latency, confirmation finality, reconciliation accuracy). Set up observability (metrics, logs, traces, on-chain event monitors, MEV/sandwich detection). CI/CD for contracts and infra, env promotion (dev/test/stage/mainnet), canary releases, infra as code (Terraform). 8) Leadership & Collaboration Partner with Product, Treasury, Compliance, Security, and Trading to roadmap delivery. Mentor engineers on smart contracts, cryptography basics, and blockchain performance trade-offs. Vendor/platform evaluation & build-vs-buy decisions. ͏ Qualifications: 12–15+ years in software engineering with 4–6+ years building blockchain systems at scale. Hands-on smart contracts in Solidity (EVM) and/or Rust (Cosmos SDK/Solana); deep knowledge of token standards, proxies, and upgrade patterns. Proven architecture of stablecoin/tokenization components (issuance, reserves, oracles, attestation) or trading systems (exchange connectivity, SOR, market data). Strong grasp of custody/MPC/HSM, wallet segregation, and key lifecycle management. Security-first mindset: threat modeling, audits, formal methods/fuzzing exposure. Experience with cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), containerization, infra as code, and event/data pipelines (Kafka/PubSub). Practical knowledge of KYC/AML/Travel Rule, sanctions screening, and blockchain analytics tooling. Nice to Have Experience with interoperability (IBC, Axelar, Wormhole, LayerZero) and rollups (OP Stack, Arbitrum, zk). Knowledge of market microstructure, MEV dynamics, gas strategies, simulation/backtesting. Payment rails, on/off-ramps, fiat treasury ops, reconciliation with ledgers/ERP. Certifications: CFA/FMI (for treasury), CAMS, CISM/CISSP, CKA, or Ethereum Developer credentials. Prior work in highly regulated fintech/FSI environments. Education Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience. ͏ Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA - as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention. Come to Wipro. Realize your ambitions.
